title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People 

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts 

About the Role 

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars. 

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design. 

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design. 

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. 

What You Can Expect 

- 
Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars. 

- 
Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction. 

- 
The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking. 

- 
Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes. 

- 
A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers. 

- 
A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively. 

What We Are Looking For 

- 
7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable. 

- 
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution. 

- 
Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing. 

- 
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality. 

- 
Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams. 

- 
Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions. 

- 
Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows. 

- 
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers. 

- 
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft. 

- 
Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work. 

In This Role, You Will 

- 
Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery. 

- 
Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps. 

- 
Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes. 

- 
Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale. 

- 
Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment. 

- 
Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt. 

- 
Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction. 

- 
Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity. 

How You Work 

- 
You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you. 

- 
You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution. 

- 
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer. 

-

About Ambio: 

Ambio is the world’s first AI-native physical commodity trader. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to sustainable materials, and this mission is progressing fast in our first domain, recycled plastics.

We work closely with industrial manufacturers through the full procurement cycle, making sustainable material options an easy choice. With our AI-native approach and proprietary trading technology, we can offer the widest selection of recycled plastics on the market.

We’re a Helsinki-based startup with 19 employees in Helsinki, Berlin, and Stockholm, and funding from e.g. Lifeline Ventures, b2venture, and SpeedInvest.

More information about Ambio: https://ambiomaterials.com/

Position

Join Ambio’s Supply team to find, validate, and deliver recycled plastics to our growing customer base across Europe! We make sure our customers get the best recycled plastics to manufacture new products.

We do whatever it takes to drive customers’ success, and to grow our delivered volumes and our positive impact. We are continuously looking for great new materials and suppliers to complement our current offering - to then match them to new and existing customer needs.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work at the forefront of sustainable materials and operational-AI applications, and to make a difference in how circularity becomes reality. You will own and drive supplier cooperation, grow our supplier pool and build strong relationships, and ensure efficient delivery of high-quality materials. You also get to develop our software (the Ambio Platform) with our Product team to help us grow faster.

In your work, you will be given full ownership of what is in your responsibility, and the full support of the team to succeed in it.

- Growth & Pace: You are the main driver together with our Sales team to drive our revenue growth - you are Supply owner for key accounts and projects.

- Sourcing: You source suppliers and build business and long-term relationships between Ambio and them. You make sure we know the partners’ team, materials and production operations inside-out, ensuring high two-way trust and efficient sales and delivery.

- Purchasing & Negotiation: You will ensure both high standards of service and quality assurance as well as a competitive price for Ambio’s customers. Your role is to excite partners to go the extra mile to meet our standards and service our demanding customers.

- Product management: The whole Ambio team provides their expertise and context understanding of their function to the benefit of our Product team. You will support our software developers to make our service to our customer’s even more stellar, our pace of growth even faster, and your life easier.

Requirements

To excel in this role, we believe the ideal candidate: 

- Takes initiative, drives things forward without waiting for instructions, and turns ideas into action even when everything is not fully defined

- Has a strong will to build, improve our company, and grow with it

- Is excited to face new things daily and open to jump into new things, to meet new people and build a relationship with them

- Likes to work with and talk to people, can communicate effectively and make our partners laugh and love working with us

- Learns new things quickly, doesn’t hesitate in front of uncertainty, and adapts to situations

- Can work independently and take full ownership of their work

- Can keep their head cool and move forward steady even when adversity or problems arise

- Is native in French & Dutch, and able to work in English . Other language skills are viewed as an asset (German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Slavic and Baltic languages)

title: IT-Security-Auditor / ISMS-Spezialist (gn)
description:
Deine nächste Projektperspektive mit New Monday

Wir sind New Monday und bringen erfahrene Spezialist in Kundenprojekte entlang des digitalen Produktentwicklungsprozesses. Unsere Wurzeln liegen im UX- und UI-Design. Diesen Fokus erweitern wir um Softwareentwicklung, Architektur, Cloud, Data und AI. So begleiten wir die Entwicklung digitaler Produkte ganzheitlich – von Websites und Apps bis hin zu komplexen Plattformen und Anwendungen.

Dabei verbinden wir fachliche Expertise mit einem klaren Verständnis für Nutzerbedürfnisse, technische Anforderungen und die Ziele unserer Kunden. Wir arbeiten remote und legen Wert auf Eigenverantwortung, offene Kommunikation und eine Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe.

Deine Aufgaben

- Interne und externe Audits zur Informationssicherheit vorbereiten, durchführen und nachbereiten

- Sicherheitsmaßnahmen, Prozesse und Nachweise anhand relevanter Standards wie ISO/IEC 27001 oder BSI IT-Grundschutz bewerten

- Auditfeststellungen verständlich dokumentieren und mit den Verantwortlichen geeignete Maßnahmen abstimmen

- Die Umsetzung vereinbarter Maßnahmen nachverfolgen und Fachbereiche bei der Vorbereitung weiterer Prüfungen unterstützen

Das bringst du mit

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in IT-Security-Audits oder in der Prüfung von Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystemen (ISMS)

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in ISO/IEC 27001 und/oder BSI IT-Grundschutz

- Erfahrung mit Auditinterviews, der Bewertung von Nachweisen und der Erstellung von Auditberichten

- Eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Prüfergebnisse gegenüber Fachbereichen, IT und Management verständlich zu vermitteln

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

- Eine Qualifikation als Auditor oder Lead Auditor ist willkommen.

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

- Flexibles Arbeiten passend zum Projekt: In diesem Projekt arbeitest du überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Gelegentliche Teamtreffen finden vor Ort in Essen statt.

- Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du organisierst deine Arbeit eigenständig und stimmst dich dabei mit deinem Kundenteam ab. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen.

- Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen.

- Persönliche Begleitung im Projekteinsatz: Auch wenn dein Arbeitsalltag überwiegend im Kundenteam stattfindet, bleiben wir mit dir im Austausch und begleiten dich bei Fragen, Herausforderungen und deiner Entwicklung.

- Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte New-Monday-Team zusammen.

- Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung.

- Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir regelmäßig mit dir.

- 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events.

Dein Weg zu uns

Kommt das Projekt zustande, wirst du bei New Monday zunächst für 1 Jahr festangestellt und bringst dann deine Expertise beim Kunden ein. Arbeitsort, Remote-Anteil und weitere Rahmenbedingungen stimmen wir passend zum jeweiligen Projekteinsatz gemeinsam mit dir ab.

Zum Kennenlernen freuen wir uns auf deinen aktuellen Lebenslauf, aussagekräftige Projektbeschreibungen oder vergleichbare Arbeitsnachweise. Teile uns außerdem deine Verfügbarkeit beziehungsweise Kündigungsfrist und deine Gehaltsvorstellung als Bruttojahresgehalt mit. So können wir bei passenden Projektanfragen gezielt auf dich zukommen.

New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt.

title: Senior Consultant Konzernkunden / Strategieberatung (m/w/d)
description:
Worum geht's? 

Du hast bei KPMG, BCG, McKinsey, Bain oder einer vergleichbaren Beratung gelernt, wie man auf Vorstandsebene überzeugt, komplexe Transformationen strukturiert und unter Druck liefert.

Und du hast gemerkt: Die Decks werden größer, die Hierarchien länger, dein Impact auf die eigentliche Entscheidung wird kleiner. Up-or-out, 60-Stunden-Wochen für die Marke eines anderen, drei Freigabeschleifen bevor du mit dem Mandanten überhaupt sprechen darfst.

Bei SC Ventures drehen wir das um: Du übernimmst eigene Mandate bei etablierten Unternehmen mit wachsender Komplexität und sprichst direkt mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Vorstand. Keine Pyramide dazwischen. Keine drei Partner, die sich vorher abstimmen müssen.

Was du bei einer Big4/MBB-Beratung an Struktur, Methodik und Executive-Kommunikation gelernt hast, bringst du zu uns – und wirst gleichzeitig daran beteiligt, was du aufbaust: Sobald deine Bestandskunden verlängern, bekommst du eine vertraglich geregelte Umsatzbeteiligung. Kein Bonus-Pool, keine Politik – dein Ergebnis, deine Beteiligung.

Wir sind kein Konzern. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team, das im Bildungssektor bereits über 100 Träger jährlich betreut – Mandate, die von etablierten Bildungsträgern mit mehreren Standorten über wachsende Mittelständler bis hin zu Konzernmandaten reichen. Du gestaltest mit, wie dieser Bereich strukturiert wird, nicht nur, wie er ausgeführt wird.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet: 

- Du verantwortest eigenständig Beratungsmandate für Unternehmen mit wachsender Größe und Komplexität – von der Ansprache auf Geschäftsführungs-/Vorstandsebene bis zur Umsetzungssteuerung

- Du entwickelst Geschäfts- und Betriebsmodelle für Vertriebs- und CRM-Transformation und verantwortest deren Umsetzung – nicht nur die Folie dazu

- Du führst Strategie-Workshops und Steering-Committees auf C-Level-Niveau

- Du baust gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die methodische Basis für den Enterprise-Bereich mit auf: Angebotsstruktur, Delivery-Standards, Qualitätssicherung

- Du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von SC Ventures im Enterprise-Segment

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ab Senior Consultant / Berater-Level) bei einer Top-Strategieberatung (MBB, Big4-Consulting o. ä.) oder vergleichbarer Inhouse-Strategiefunktion

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Vorständen/Geschäftsführungen von Unternehmen relevanter Größenordnung

- Fähigkeit, komplexe Transformationsprojekte eigenständig zu strukturieren und zu verantworten – ohne engmaschige Freigabeprozesse

- Executive Presence: Du überzeugst auf Augenhöhe, ohne dich hinter einer großen Marke verstecken zu müssen

- Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung und Beteiligung, nicht nur ein Gehalt

- Branchenkenntnis Bildungssektor/AZAV von Vorteil, aber kein Muss – die Beratungslogik zählt mehr als die Sektor-Historie

Benefits

Was du davon hast: 

- Umsatzbeteiligung auf deine Bestandskunden – vertraglich geregelt, ohne Politik

- Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – du gestaltest den Enterprise-Bereich mit, statt ihn nur auszuführen

- Schnelle Entscheidungswege – keine drei Freigabeschleifen zwischen dir und dem Mandanten

- Kein Up-or-out – dein Wert bemisst sich an Ergebnissen, nicht an Politik oder Tenure

- Attraktives Fixum plus Beteiligungsmodell

- Eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget und klare Perspektive Richtung Partner-Modell/Teamleitung

- Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs, MacBook & iPhone

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gründern statt anonymer Konzernstruktur

Wen wir wirklich suchen 

Du kommst aus der Top-Beratung und willst nicht mehr für die Marke eines anderen liefern. Du willst eigene Mandate, echte Beteiligung und Entscheidungen, die auch wirklich deine sind.

Wenn du lieber baust als verwaltest und lieber mit einem kleinen Team etwas Großes aufziehst, als in einem großen Team ein kleines Rädchen zu sein – dann bist du hier richtig.

title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications. 

Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives. 

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts. 

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment. 

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations. 

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks. 

What You Will Do 

- Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay. 

- Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa. 

- Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC). 

- Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation. 

- Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates. 

- Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions. 

- Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers. 

- Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements. 

- Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications. 

What We Expect of You 

Essential Skills & Experience 

- Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices. 

- Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments. 

- Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages. 

- Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols. 

- Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules. 

- Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications. 

- Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting. 

- Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations. 

- A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus. 

Valuable Experience 

- Practical knowledge of Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC), Infor ION Framework and Infor OS, including their integration with Infor M3 and the routing of EDI documents into core applications. 

- Familiarity with Mapping Manager and Business Document Mapper within the Infor integration environment. 

- Onboarding customers, suppliers and 3 PLs via EDI. 

Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position. 

About Intersnack IT: 

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. Our goal is to provide a common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services, and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG . 

About Intersnack Group: 

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. For further company insights, please visit the following link: Intersnack Group Overview 

If you want to be part of our dynamic food industry success story, you’ll find all sorts of opportunities at Intersnack. Join our team, help us grow, and celebrate our successes together!

So geht’s weiter

About Product Management: 

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. title: Head of Operations (m/f/d)
description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies and we work with SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.

The role

As Head of Operations, you make sure what we sell actually goes live, and that the company behind it runs without friction. Your job is to make our customers successful and to free up the founders, sales and engineering to do the work only they can do.

We are growing from a small founding team into a company that runs several enterprise rollouts at once, works with SAP consultancy partners, and is hiring across engineering, sales and product. That growth needs one person who owns how it all fits together.

You report directly to the founders and our diffrent department Heads. This is not an admin role. Half of it sits right next to the customer.

What you'll own

- Customer delivery and onboarding. From signature to live. You run the rollout plan with our Forward Deployed Engineers and solution architects: kick-off, access and security onboarding, milestones, steering meetings. You make sure every customer reaches value on time, and you spot the risk before it becomes an escalation.

- Commercial operations. Contracts, order forms, framework agreements, procurement and supplier onboarding at enterprise customers, invoicing and collections. You make the paper process predictable so deals close faster and cash comes in on time.

- Partner operations. We work with SAP consultancies and system integrators who use Qorelo in their own client projects. You set up and run how that works in practice: agreements, enablement, joint delivery, reporting.

- Finance and planning. Budget, burn and runway tracking, monthly reporting, board and investor material, together with our external tax advisor and accountants. You know the numbers and can explain them.

- People operations. Hiring process, onboarding, contracts, payroll setup, equity administration, tools. Every new joiner is productive in their first week.

- Systems and process. You decide what we build, what we buy and what we outsource, and you use AI to keep the team lean.

What you need

- 4+ years in operations, delivery or customer-facing project roles, with at least 2 years at a B2B software startup or scale-up.

- Hands-on experience running enterprise rollouts or implementations: you have taken software through enterprise IT, security, procurement and works council onboarding.

- Commercial and financial fluency: you can read a contract, build a budget, track runway and explain the numbers to a board.

- You build process only where it helps, and you are just as happy doing the work yourself as designing the system for it.

- You use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about what else they can automate.

- Business-fluent German and English. Most of our customers are in DACH.

You might be a fit if

- You have worked in or around the SAP ecosystem, at a consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor, and know how a transformation programme runs.

- You have been an early operations, chief of staff or COO hire at a startup and built the operating backbone from scratch.

- You have worked with partners or resellers and know what it takes to make a channel deliver.

- People call you when something has to get done and nobody owns it.

What we offer

- Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo is built. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

- Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior operations leaders in Berlin.

- The scope. You build the operating backbone of a company selling to Fortune 500 and DAX 40 customers.

- The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the founders.

- 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

- Company offsites with the whole team.

- An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg, and the flexibility to work where you are most effective. The fridge is stocked.

- Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

- Intro call (30 min)

- Deep dive on your operations and delivery background with Louis, our CEO (60 min)

- Offer

How to apply

Send us your CV at ----- or apply on our careers page. No cover letter needed, but we would love two or three sentences on the messiest rollout or operational problem you took over, and how you fixed it.

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

title: PR Manager DE
description:
A fight lasts minutes. A great story travels much further. 

The comeback nobody saw coming. The rivalry that divides an arena. The person behind the fighter, with a story that deserves to reach people who have never watched MMA.

At OKTAGON, those stories are everywhere.

We’re building a sports brand with international ambitions, passionate fans and events that bring thousands of people together. Germany is a major part of that journey. And we’re looking for a PR Manager who knows how to make our stories matter to German media. 

Someone who can earn the trust of a sports editor, spot an angle for a business title and understand why a digital format might reach an audience a traditional press release never will.

You’ll help decide which stories we tell, who we tell them to and how far they go. 

Your stories need to travel beyond the cage.

Sports media will be your home ground. But your curiosity should take you further.

A fighter’s journey can belong in a mainstream interview. Our growth can start a business conversation. Training, personality and culture can open doors to fitness and lifestyle coverage.

You’ll find those opportunities and turn them into pitches that give each outlet a reason to care.

Here’s what you’ll take ownership of: 

- Build real relationships with German media. Develop and maintain a network across sports, digital and mainstream outlets. Get to know the journalists, their audiences and the stories they actually want.

- Earn coverage for OKTAGON, our events and our fighters. Create opportunities around upcoming fights and recognise stories that deserve attention outside the event calendar.

- Find new routes to our audience. Follow how the media landscape is changing, from digital publishers and podcasts to emerging editorial formats. Know where a story will work and adapt it accordingly.

- Create sharp German press materials. Write press releases, translate and localise event Media Info Cards, research fight cards and prepare tailored angles for individual outlets.

- Make interviews happen. Connect journalists with fighters, coordinate opportunities and prepare written interviews when needed.

- Get the right assets into the right hands. Distribute photos, video and relevant information, including captioned fight photography for dpa-picture alliance and Imago.

- Keep the foundations organised. Own accreditations, maintain the media database and keep fighter information accurate and up to date.

- Show what your work achieves. Monitor online and offline coverage, prepare monthly reports and summarise results after German events. Use what you learn to improve the next campaign.

- Keep our communication connected. Work closely with the PR lead, Marketing DE and Social Media so our messaging stays consistent, including across German-language video content.

When fight week starts, you’re in the middle of it.

The plans are ready. The journalists arrive. Interview requests change. A result creates a new headline.

You’ll be the person who keeps media operations moving. 

At German events, that means overseeing accreditations and the media room, coordinating interviews, supporting weigh-ins and press conferences, and making sure journalists have what they need before and after the fights. Where needed, you may also moderate a press conference.

You’ll handle post-fight releases, follow-ups and coverage reviews. During selected events outside Germany, you’ll be available for relevant German media requests and breaking stories.

And when a sensitive situation comes up, you’ll be the first point of contact for German media, working closely with the PR lead on the response.

This role includes travel and weekend work. Fight weeks can run from Thursday through Sunday, and you need to be comfortable with the pace and responsibility that come with live events.

What you bring into the team

You already know how a newsroom works. You understand deadlines, editorial judgement and the difference between a story we want to tell and a story someone will want to publish.

We’re looking for:

- At least 2–4 years of relevant experience in PR or sports journalism. You’ve pitched stories, worked with journalists and delivered under pressure.

- An existing network in German sports newsrooms. Relationships you can build on, alongside the initiative to open new doors.

- Native-level German and very good English. Your German writing is precise, natural and adaptable. You’re comfortable collaborating with an international team in English.

- Strong editorial instincts. You can spot an angle, ask the useful question and turn a complicated story into a clear pitch.

- Digital confidence. You understand how people discover and consume stories today and stay curious about what is changing.

- Independence and ownership. You can organise your work remotely, follow through on commitments and keep colleagues informed.

- Willingness to travel and work weekends. You want to be there when the action happens.

An interest in MMA or combat sports, experience with press conferences and crisis communication, and a driving licence are all advantages.

You don’t need to know every fighter’s record on day one. You do need the curiosity to learn the sport and understand the people in it.

Ready to tell the next story?

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and a few examples of your work: coverage you secured, a campaign you helped deliver or journalism you’re proud of.

Tell us what you contributed and why it worked. 

We’d also love to hear what interests you about bringing OKTAGON’s stories to German audiences.

Let’s talk.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
Team description

The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day. This role owns the Engagement domain — covering merchant engagement, product activation, support responses, and navigation across the SuperApp and web dashboard — and is the primary analytics partner for the Engagement product team. It's a genuine opportunity to take full ownership of a domain, build the measurement foundations from the ground up, and shift the team from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-led decision-making.

What you'll do

- 
Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one

- 
Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions

- 
Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders

- 
Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst

- 
Partner with product managers to develop and map out KPI trees, identify measurement gaps, and improve the quality and accuracy of engagement tracking across the domain

You'll be great for this role if…

- 
Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.

- 
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.

- 
Strong knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and experience with data warehousing platforms like Snowflake, Postgres, or Redshift.

- 
Comfortable designing and analysing end-to-end experiments, including A/B tests and feature flag rollouts, with a solid understanding of statistical validity.

- 
Ability to communicate complex data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong written and verbal English skills.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days 
🏋️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing 

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will… 

- Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions

- Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis

title: Full-stack Engineer (f/m/d)
description:

- Design, build and own internal web applications end to end, covering frontend, backend, data model and deployment 

- Develop tooling that supports our manufacturing, where clarity and correctness in the user interface directly affect hardware outcomes

- Extend our ML and data tooling so that operational data flows reliably from the field into datasets, models and back into our systems 

- Integrate heterogeneous systems (PLM, ERP, version control, device fleet, data platform) through robust APIs and clean interfaces 

- Work directly with the engineers, operators and test teams who use your software, and translate their day-to-day problems into simple, durable solutions 

- Take ownership of the reliability of what you build, as these applications are part of our production and development critical path 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field 

- 4+ years of professional experience building and operating production web applications, with clear depth in at least one half of the stack and solid competence in the other 

- Strong backend engineering in a modern language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, TypeScript/Node or comparable. We care more about engineering strength than about prior exposure to a specific language, and expect strong engineers to pick up an unfamiliar stack quickly 

- Practical frontend experience with a component-based framework (React, Angular, Vue or similar) and the judgement to design an interface that people can use under time pressure 

- Sound relational data modelling and practical experience with relational databases 

- Confident with containerisation, version control workflows and CI/CD; able to deploy, monitor and debug your own services 

- Proven ownership of an internal tool or platform: gathering requirements from colleagues, scoping them realistically, and maintaining the result over time 

- A pragmatic engineer who builds robustly where correctness matters and deliberately simply everywhere else 

- Structured problem solver with a hands-on mindset and a bias toward shipping 

- Eager to work closely with a multidisciplinary team of software, hardware, production and flight test engineers 

- Fluent in English, German is beneficial 

Nice-to-Have 

- Experience with manufacturing, MES, PLM or ERP systems, or with software used on a production floor 

- Background in robotics, automotive, aerospace or other hardware-related engineering environments 

- Experience with data pipelines, data versioning or MLOps tooling 

- Working knowledge of container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code 

Why TYTAN? 

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security 

- Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale 

- Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors 

- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback 

- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact 

- Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company 

- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe 

Our Benefits 

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation 

- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit 

- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us 

- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team 

- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together 

- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands 

- Flexibility : Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration 

About us 

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

title: Senior Creative Concept/Copy (Social) (gn)
description:
Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social 

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. DEINE ROLLE 

Wir bauen für einen unserer Hero Accounts eine Creative Unit auf – als Senior Creative Concept/Copy bist du ein elementarer Teil dieses Teams, das mit vollem Fokus die unterschiedlichsten Briefs löst. 
Du bist dabei nicht einfach nur Copywriter:in – du lässt Briefs zu Big Ideas und plattformübergreifenden Kampagnen werden und denkst nicht in einzelnen Postings, sondern in kreativen Welten. Social-First-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Auch mit einem eher klassischen Kreativ-Background bist du bei uns richtig. 

WAS DU MACHST

- Von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Feinkonzept entwickelst du eigenständig und in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Creative Lead Kampagnen für unseren Hero Account: durchdacht, plattformgerecht und im Idealfall mit Award-Potenzial 

- Du schreibst starke Skripte und Copy für unterschiedlichste Themen und Formate – immer trennscharf innerhalb der jeweiligen Brand-Identity 

- Du bringst deine Ideen eigenständig in überzeugende Präsentationsform und stellst sie sicher vor Kund:innen sowie internen Stakeholdern vor 

- Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Junior- und Mid-Level-Creatives im Team und trägst mit deiner Arbeit aktiv zur kreativen Weiterentwicklung des Accounts und der Creative Unit bei 

- Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Departments innerhalb der Agentur zusammen 

WAS DU BRAUCHST

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Copywriter:in oder Concept Creative – ob in einer Social-First-Agentur, einer klassischen Werbeagentur oder einem gemischten Umfeld 

- Teamgeist und die Motivation, Ideen sowie Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben 

- Ein starkes Portfolio, das deine konzeptionelle Stärke, dein Gespür für Sprache und deine Fähigkeit, Big Ideas zu entwickeln, beweist 

- Ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie man auf Social spricht und kommuniziert – oder die Bereitschaft, dir dieses Gespür bei uns anzueignen 

- Ein weitreichendes Verständnis für Markenwelten und die Fähigkeit, innerhalb dieser Welten überzeugenden, konsistenten kreativen Output zu liefern 

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN 

- Onboarding & Support 

No one likes to be the new kid. Mit strukturiertem Onboarding, einem persönlichen Mate und Zugang zu Lernmaterialien bist du ab Tag eine:r von uns. 

- Erstklassige Ausstattung 

Can’t work without my iPhone. Mit MacBook, iPhone und aktueller Apple-Tech arbeitest du flexibel und effizient. Das gilt für unsere Altbau-Offices genauso wie zuhause oder unterwegs. 

- Wachstum & Weiterentwicklung 

Rise & shine, darling! Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget gibt dir die Freiheit, in Workshops, Seminare, zertifizierte Kurse oder Coachings zu investieren. So entwickelst du dich genau in die Richtung, die zu deinen Zielen passt.

„Ob das bei euch gerade genauso ist? I doubt it!” Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du innerhalb der EU remote arbeiten. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle machen es leicht, Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Bei einem Umzug oder in besonderen Lebenssituationen wie einem Trauerfall erhältst du zusätzliche freie Tage.

„It’s my birthday, I’mma spend my money.“ An deinem Geburtstag heißt es: Laptop zu und genießen. Zusätzlich sind der 24. Dezember und der 31. Dezember frei. Jubiläen und Geburtstage feiern wir mit kleinen Überraschungen.

Hot girl walk or heavy lift? Mit der Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft entscheidest du selbst, ob Yoga, Pilates, Schwimmen oder Krafttraining zu deinem Glow Up passt. nilo.health sorgt für mentale Stärke und bietet Sessions mit Psycholog:innen oder Coaches. Über deinen Zugang können auch bis zu fünf Familienmitglieder mitmachen.

It’s giving… perks! Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten bei Partnern wie plantclub, FutureBens und vielen mehr. Zusätzlich kannst du eines dieser drei Benefits wählen: 

- Givve Card – 50 € Guthaben pro Monat, frei einsetzbar für alles, was du liebst.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Hi 👋 we’re Genio. We create beautifully simple learning tools that boost knowledge, skills, and confidence. 

- We’re a SaaS scale up and one of the fastest growing tech companies in the North.

- There’s 90+ of us around the UK with our HQ in Leeds.

🚀 About the role 

Career track: IC4

Unit: Shared services

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you help set the strategy for Genio's infrastructure end-to-end — from design through to running it in production. You work with squads on feature work to advise/set direction, and ensure reliability, security, and cost efficiency. You drive the design and implementation of best-practice cloud infrastructure, automation frameworks, and tooling that enable scalability, reliability, and efficiency for engineering teams in both business units. Responsibilities: 

- Evolving Genio's cloud infrastructure: Architect and optimise cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability, security, and resilience. Shape long-term infrastructure strategy and apply Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD best practices.

- Maintaining and improving observability of Genio's applications: Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing capabilities. Champion the adoption of SLOs, SLAs, and SLIs.

description:

About Nscale 

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Nscale are working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is an opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond.

Role Overview 

The Senior Project Manager will play a leading role in managing the construction of Nscale’s data centre facilities, with a particular focus on fit-out / partnered projects. Reporting to the Project Director, this role may be sat across individual projects or multiple concurrently depending on scale and scope of project pipeline, and will be responsible for ensuring projects are delivered successfully by coordinating design, engineering, and construction activities through each stage of project execution.

You will manage scope, schedule, progress, quality, and risk, ensuring consistency with Nscale’s standards, governance, and delivery objectives.You will coordinate with internal team members and external partners to deliver on time, safely, and to specification.

You will maintain visibility of project budgets, forecasts, and reporting to ensure informed and proactive decision-making. Collaboration across internal teams — including Engineering, EH&S, Finance, and Operations — will be key to delivering world-class, sustainable infrastructure that supports Nscale’s AI mission.

Key Responsibilities 

- Lead data centre project delivery from design through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

- Manage project scope, schedule, and quality, ensuring alignment with design intent and business objectives.

- Coordinate and lead discipline Project Management (MEP, CSA) when required and ensure all packages of work integrate smoothly.

- Maintain oversight of project budgets and schedules in coordination with the Commercial Manager, reporting progress and highlighting key risks.

- Work closely with Design for design reviews, approvals, and documentation control.

- Collaborate with general contractors to assess and manage local construction capabilities, resource planning, and performance.

- Drive adherence to program milestones, identifying potential delays and developing recovery plans.

- Build and maintain a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance through active engagement and auditing.

- Chair regular status meetings, issue reports, and maintain clear communication between stakeholders and leadership.

- Support compliance with building codes and regulatory requirements, advising on design implications or alternative solutions.

- Lead risk identification and resolution, ensuring issues are captured, tracked, and addressed early.

- Work collaboratively with internal departments (Engineering, EH&S, Finance, Operations) to ensure seamless project delivery and transition to operations.

Experience & Qualifications Required 

- Over 8 years of experience managing large-scale, mission-critical construction projects, including expertise in data centre developments and fit-out works

- Ideally you will have delivered projects integrating TCS loop liquid cooling networks

- Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline.

- Proven ability to manage complex, multi-discipline delivery teams 

- Strong knowledge of construction sequencing, scheduling, and coordination.

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to lead effectively in fast-paced environments.

- Proficiency in project management and reporting tools

- Understanding of commercial and contractual principles sufficient to ensure alignment with cost and schedule targets

title: Senior Product Manager, App o11y | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management: 

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. 

The opportunity: 

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences. 

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

- Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap

- Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points

- Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities 

- Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers. 

- Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

What makes you a great fit: 

- A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

- 5+ years of experience in Product Management

- 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product 

- Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers

- A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top

- Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Bonus Points: 

- Experience with OpenTelemetry, application instrumentation, SDKs, and telemetry collectors

- Experience with distributed tracing or continuous profiling systems, such as Grafana Tempo or Grafana Pyroscope

- Experience with eBPF and/or automatic instrumentation

- Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies

- Experience defining or evolving pricing and packaging for consumption-based or product-led SaaS offerings

- Experience operating applications in production, being on call, or troubleshooting performance and reliability issues

- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

title: VP Data Centres
description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD 

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY 

Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.

This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:
- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment
- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them
- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site
- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers
- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs
- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high
- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it

ABOUT YOU 

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential: 
- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role
- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale
- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure
- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors
- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms

Nice to Have: 
- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space
- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction
- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs
- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability

WHAT WE OFFER 

- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
- Employee wellbeing benefits
- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
- Private Medical Insurance
- Enhanced Pension Scheme
- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
- Clear career progression in a high-growth company
- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY 

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION 

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

title: Senior Engineer - IAM and Workplace Technology
description:
An Introduction to Primer 

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase > 

Read up on our $100m Series C 

Learn more about our culture > 

Which team will you be joining?

You'll join Tech as a Senior Engineer. Tech owns identity and access, IT and workplace technology for the whole company. Today it's a Workplace Tech engineer and an IAM engineer, and you'll be the most senior engineer on the team.

This is a hands-on role. You'll work the access and IT queue with the team, and you'll lead the technical work that shrinks it: the automation, the identity platform and the roadmap. As Primer grows and the team grows with it, there's room for the role to grow too, including into leading the team for the right person.

Tech is an enablement team. It sits alongside Security Engineering, not inside it, and owns the request queue and the tools that keep everyone at Primer productive. Primer is growing fast, and access requests are growing even faster. Our job is to make getting the right access quick, safe and mostly automatic, so people can get on with their work and our security engineers can get back to security.

What you'll be doing

- Work the IAM, IT and Workplace Tech queue alongside the team, and set the bar for turnaround and quality.

- Lead the technical roadmap for Tech and deliver it, starting with SCIM day-1 provisioning, Okta, automated access reviews and device enrolment.

- Automate the routine. Use identity tooling, scripting, workflow automation and AI to take repetitive access requests off people's plates.

- Run joiner, mover and leaver processes so new starters have what they need on day one and access is removed promptly when it should be.

- Keep access controls audit-ready. Work with Security and GRC on access reviews, least privilege and evidence for PCI DSS and SOC 2.

description:

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. 

About the role 

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

- Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
- Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
- Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.

The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities 

- Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
- Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
- Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python .
- Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
- Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
- Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
- Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
- Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
- Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.

What you need to be successful 

- Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering , or a related technical field.
- Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python .
- Good understanding of: - Fluid mechanics
- Thermodynamics and heat transfer
- Numerical methods and computational modelling

- Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
- Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
- Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
- Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
- Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems .
- Fluent written and spoken English.

Soft Skills 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
- Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
- Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
- Good technical communication and documentation skills.
- Attention to detail and critical thinking.

Nice to have 

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required :

- Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
- Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
- Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
- Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
- Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
- Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
- Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
- Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
- Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
- Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
- Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.

Expected internship outcomes 

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

- A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
- An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool .
- A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads .
- Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
- Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.

Supervision and collaboration 

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.
