title: Lead Acquisition B2C
description:
Green-Got en bref

Green-Got est une alternative complète et moderne aux grandes banques, du paiement à l'investissement.

En finance, on ne construit pas à côté du système. Nous y prenons du pouvoir pour en changer la direction.

- Ce que nous refusons : nous excluons strictement l'expansion fossile, sur tous nos produits. Et notre assurance-vie et notre PER, c'est zéro financement d'entreprise dans le pesticide.

- Ce que nous dévoilons : ce que les banques traditionnelles font de l'argent de leurs clients. Et nous sommes transparents jusque sur nos propres limites.

- Ce que nous construisons : les paiements de nos membres financent des enquêtes, du lobbying et du plaidoyer qui s'attaquent aux causes. Les banques ont des lobbyistes ; nos membres en ont un aussi.

Quelques repères :

- Plus de 3 milliards d'euros déjà passés par les comptes et les cartes de nos membres

- 150 M€ d'épargne sous gestion

- 15 millions d'euros levés auprès de notre communauté, à chaque fois en un temps record

Pourquoi ce poste compte autant. Chaque compte ouvert envoie un message aux grandes banques : le marché a changé. Et plus nous grandissons, plus nous pesons. Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail.

Le poste

Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir.

Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics.

Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de milliers d'euros.

On cherche un doeur, pas un stratège qui délègue. Tu mets les mains dans le cambouis, tu testes, tu shippes, et tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi lancer.

Ce que tu vas faire

- Site et trafic : tu es autonome sur le site. Landing pages, SEO, GEO, CRO, A/B tests.

- Acquisition payante : Google Ads, Meta et autres réseaux sociaux. Ciblage, créas, landing, tests, optimisation, toujours pilotés par le chiffre d'affaires final.

- Affiliation : tu trouves, négocies et pilotes nos partenaires. Tu contrôles ce qu'ils font, tu mesures ce qui marche vraiment et tu arbitres le budget, sans tout miser sur un seul levier.

- Budget et rentabilité : tu répartis le budget entre les canaux selon ce qu'ils rapportent, et tu le réorientes quand il le faut.

- Tracking : tu t'assures que tout ce que tu lances est mesuré correctement. Tu peux te faire aider sur la partie technique.

- Opérations avec l'équipe Wealth Management : tu lances avec elle les opérations sur nos produits d'investissement.

- Nouveaux leviers : tu imagines et testes des canaux auxquels personne n'a encore pensé.

Une personne, des agents IA

Pendant des années, une règle a joué contre nous : pour rivaliser avec une banque, il fallait ses effectifs, ses agences et ses milliards. Cette règle vient de tomber.

L'intelligence artificielle ne récompense pas la taille. Elle récompense les organisations alignées, rapides et capables de décider. C'est l'asymétrie du renard, et pour la première fois elle joue pour nous : elle nous permet d'avoir dans dix ans l'impact que nous devions avoir dans cent. Pendant ce temps, les quatre grandes banques françaises portent 260 milliards d'euros d'actifs fossiles, et chaque mois que nous perdons est un mois qu'elles gagnent.

C'est pourquoi tu seras une personne autonome, épaulée par un agent IA pour chaque canal (site, GEO, affiliation, ads…). Notre stack est très moderne, car nous n'avons pas d'autre choix que de nous décupler pour peser.

L'équipe autour de toi

Chez Green-Got, l'acquisition est une boucle complète portée par des profils complémentaires :

- Awareness : l’équipe qui fait connaître Green-Got au plus grand nombre

- Acquisition haut de funnel : toi

- CRM et Product Growth : ceux qui transforment et activent les personnes que tu amènes

Tu travailles main dans la main avec le CRM, avec le Product Growth et avec l'équipe Wealth Management.

Tu es rattaché au Head of Growth, qui est là pour te mentorer, t'aider et te guider.
Notre Head of Growth, Clément Jaunault, fait de la growth depuis dix ans, de la legaltech au SaaS. Arrivé chez Green-Got avant le lancement, il l'a fait passer de 0 à 100 000 utilisateurs et de 0 à 300 M€ d'encours, et il mentore déjà de jeunes growth hors de l'entreprise.

Ton profil

Indispensable 

- Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en acquisition, growth ou traffic management (tes side projects comptent)

- Tu es un faiseur : tu livres, tu shippes, tu passes vite d'un sujet à l'autre

- Tu es data driven. Tu as de l'instinct, mais tu valides tout avec la data.

- Tu utilises l’IA au quotidien et tu as déjà construit des outils ou des automatisations avec.

- Tu es autonome, débrouillard et problem solver : face à un problème, tu trouves une solution

- Tu as un mindset business : tu raisonnes en chiffre d'affaires, pas en vanity metrics

- Tu t'intéresses vraiment à la finance.

- Tu es sensible aux enjeux d'écologie, de transition à l'échelle française et européenne, et de santé

- Tu es créatif, proactif, organisé et rigoureux

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

Profil recherché 

- Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

Process de recrutement 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Johan Chrzanosvski - Head of Customer Care, et Maxime Leclercq - Head of Financial Services (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu 

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: 

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). 

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- . 

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. 

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement ." 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

Profil recherché 

- Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

title: Account Executive - Mid-market - €60–80K + BSPCE
description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect 

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us ! 

- Discover our company culture and values 

- Here is a product teaser 

- Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle 

- Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest 

- Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog )

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, triage emergencies, and free up administrative staff so care teams can focus on care. The product is live and used daily in hundreds of healthcare facilities, just a few months after launch.

We are scaling fast: our target is €1M of signed ARR per month by the end of December 2026. The liberal segment (private practices and groups, ~€10–30k ARR per account) needs to contribute heavily.

This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory.

Your mission

Generate €400k ARR in year one in new business on the liberal segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals.

Expected outcomes

1 month: 

- Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…)

- Make your first prospecting calls , demos , and initial sales conversations

- Close your first simple deals independently.

3 months: 

- Build a stable pipeline , with at least 30 active opportunities at different stages

- Improve our call scripts and email sequences

- Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments 

- Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap

- Full autonomy by month 3 on pitch, product, ICP, and qualification

6-12 months: 

- Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders)

- Contribute to structuring our sales playbook 

- Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings)

What the role looks like day to day

Build your own pipeline 

- Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking

- Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers

- Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one

Own the full sales cycle 

- Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with practice and group decision-makers

- Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage

- Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments (~1 month post-signature)

Make the engine better 

- Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking

- Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences

What sales look like on the liberal segment 

- Deal size from 15K to 30K

- 1 month sale cycle

- ICP : group of independent practitioners

This role is for you if

The prerequisites: 

- You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets : people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers.

- You've run SMB/mid deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 6 months, on fast, slightly pushy cycles (€10–20k average basket). You listen actively, you're convincing and assertive, and you're comfortable being pushy.

- You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with doctors: they need to be won over, so we want sharp closers. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to individual practitioners with the same professional posture.

What we'll evaluate in interviews: 

- Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego : you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet.

- Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work.

- Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable.

Requirements: 

- 1–3 years of B2B SaaS sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience

- Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication

- Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company

- Entrepreneurial mindset

Nice to have: 

- Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints

- Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals)

- Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo

This role is NOT for you if

- You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only "sold" by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch.

- You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes.

Perks and Benefits

- Equity (BSPCE)

- Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

- Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

- MacBook provided.

- Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

- EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

- Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

- Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

- Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Hiring process

- Discovery interview (30 min, video) — Talent Acquisition Manager

- Manager fit interview (30 min, video) — Alexandre, Head of Sales

- Track record + case study (1h) — Alexandre and Nathan (Senior AE)

- Founders / culture fit (1h, on site) — Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

- Reference checks

- Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days . You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca? 

- An entrepreneurial adventure , with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

- A product already live , with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

- A true scaling phase , with everything still to build

- Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles. 

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

description:

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us ! 

- Discover our company culture and values

- Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog )

Vocca in a few words 

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

- $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

- Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

- Opening the US market

The problem 

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding.

What you will own 

- The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

- Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

- The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed.

- The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. The hard integrations are the ones nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

- The team. You define how this scope works (reviews, documentation, technical decisions), you take part in hiring the next engineers and you help them ship in their first week.

How we build 

- Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

- Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

- AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

- Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves.

Stack 

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here 

- 6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run.

- You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. You can tell us who it was for, what problem it solved and which number moved.

- You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world.

- Strong in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the stack.

- You think about the product and the business as much as the code. You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

- You are at ease with clients and partners, in French and in English.

Probably not for you if you want to manage without coding, or if you need a stable, fully specified environment before you move.

What we expect from you 

- First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first fix on a live integration is in production.

- First month. You own one integration end to end, from the software vendor to production, and show what it changed. You write down how our booking layer should evolve.

- First 3 months. The unified booking layer in TypeScript is the standard. Adding a new software takes days, not weeks. We detect a booking failure in any clinic within 24 hours.

- 6 to 12 months. Our first US integrations run in production. You have hired at least one engineer and they ship on their own.

- 45 min with Nans (Talent).

- 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

- 2h in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about architecture.

- 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical 

- Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

- Hybrid, 3 days at the office.

- BSPCE.

Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. 

VOTRE RÔLE 

En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus.

· Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour leur offrir une expérience exceptionnelle. 

· Découvrir et partager votre expertise sur nos produits auprès des clients. 

· Faire preuve de proactivité en suggérant des produits complémentaires. 

· Contribuer à la fidélisation de notre clientèle en développant des relations privilégiées. 

· Assurer la bonne tenue du point de vente en collaboration avec l’équipe. 

· Participer aux missions opérationnelles : Visual merchandising, réassort, gestion des stocks, SAV. 

· Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines. 

· Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence. 

PROFIL 

· Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de mode ou de management, avec une forte sensibilité pour l’univers de la mode et du luxe.

title: Principal Design Engineer - Mechanical Equipment (80-100%)
description:
Lead technically by doing. 

Join our Design Engineering team as a highly experienced individual contributor. You will take on challenging mechanical design problems yourself, from concepts and CAD models to manufacturing drawings, prototypes and tested hardware, while helping the wider team make strong technical decisions. 

As a Principal Design Engineer, you are a hands-on member of our Design Engineering team, designing Climeworks’ CO2 collectors, the heart of our direct air capture plant. Improving how they perform, are manufactured and scale is central to the future success of DAC. 

- Mechanical concept & product design: You personally turn new concepts into robust physical products: developing mechanical concepts, creating CAD models, designing components and complete collector assemblies, producing manufacturing drawings, and supporting hardware through fabrication, assembly and testing. 

- Engineering problem-solving & risk reduction: Your experience helps you find the right solutions faster, anticipate problems early and reduce risk before issues reach manufacturing or testing. 

- CO2 collector design: You take mechanical systems from requirements and concepts through to detailed, manufacturable designs. You develop solutions, perform engineering calculations and make the decisions needed to create robust industrial hardware. 

- First-principles engineering: You use experience and first-principles reasoning to identify risks early, evaluate alternatives quickly and converge on simple, robust solutions. You apply calculations, tolerance analysis, design reviews and testing to reduce uncertainty. 

- Own design from concept to commercialisation: You work directly in SolidWorks to create and modify parts, assemblies and system layouts. You manage complex interfaces, packaging constraints and design changes so the complete system works together. You produce and maintain high-quality 2D manufacturing drawings, including appropriate GD&T, tolerances, materials, finishes and manufacturing requirements. 

- Prototype fabrication, assembly & testing: You stay closely involved after the CAD work is complete. You support prototype fabrication, assembly and testing, investigate issues and incorporate the learning back into the design. 

- Technical leadership & design reviews: You act as a senior technical reference for the team, supporting the Design Engineering line manager with design reviews, engineering standards and approval of critical designs. You support the extended team with technical judgement on complex mechanical design decisions, help maintain strong engineering practices and share your experience through everyday collaboration, mentoring and constructive challenge. 

- Cross-functional engineering collaboration: You work with manufacturing, testing, process engineering, procurement, suppliers and other engineering disciplines to ensure mechanical designs work as part of the complete product. You integrate external design resources where needed. 

What makes you stand out 

Your experience makes your engineering more effective: you spot promising solutions early, expose weak points before they become expensive, and deliver designs that are clear, manufacturable and ready to perform in the real world. 

- Mechanical Design Experience : You bring 15+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience, ideally developing complex industrial equipment from concept through manufacture, assembly and testing. 

- Sheet Metal Design & Manufacturing : You have deep practical experience designing sheet-metal parts, structures and assemblies for manufacture at scale. You understand bending, welding and joining methods, forming, tolerances, material and thickness selection, and how design choices affect tooling, cost, assembly and quality. 

- CAD & Drawings : You are an expert SolidWorks user and remain hands-on with CAD. You personally create high-quality manufacturing drawings and are confident with GD&T and tolerance chains. 

- System Design & Engineering Judgement: You have experience designing from components and mechanisms through subsystems, interfaces and complex assemblies. You understand how decisions at one level affect the complete collector and can balance structures, airflow, movement, sealing, process interfaces, manufacturability, reliability and cost to arrive at robust solutions. 

- Manufacturing & DFMA : You have strong knowledge of machined parts, welded structures, materials and manufacturing processes, and apply DFMA to create robust, cost-effective designs. 

- Collaboration & Technical Leadership : You work effectively with engineers, technicians, manufacturers and suppliers. You share your experience, challenge constructively and help others make better technical decisions. 

- Education:  You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar. 

This job is not for you, if… 

- you mainly want to manage people or projects. 

- you mainly do simulation, concept work or system-level engineering without your own CAD work. 

- you have no experience with sheet metal, welded structures or manufacturing at scale.

title: Product Frontend Engineer
description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. 

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. 

Where this is going 

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. 

Why this role exists 

Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

That is the opening. 

How we work 

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.

Tasks

What you will own 

Everything on the screen:

- The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.

- The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.

- The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.

- Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.

- The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

Where design ends, engineering begins. 

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.

Requirements

Who we are looking for 

You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.

You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.

Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.

The Team 

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.

title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer - Switzerland
description:
About CoLab 

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C , been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte ( Fast 500™ ), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier , and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role 

This is a high-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works.

In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale.

You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer.

We are looking for a candidate in Switzerland to work regularly on-site with local CoLab customers.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better.

You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you’ve championed internal tools or created automation or scripts.

You also know a process that makes sense on paper won’t get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don’t want to change.

You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you.

Job Responsibilities

- Mapping a customer's current-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target-state process their teams will actually adopt.

- Deploying and tuning CoLab's AI capabilities against a customer's own standards, drawing checklists, and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't.

- Providing mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI-generated results and ensure engineering rigor.

- Investigating and solving complex engineering data and integration challenges across PLM, ERP, QMS, and traditional design feedback tools.

- Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits.

- Collaborating with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview.

Qualifications

Must-haves: 

- Background in mechanical design engineering, ideally in a medium- to large-sized organization.

- Strong understanding of PLM & ERP systems and enterprise engineering data architecture.

- Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional collaborations.

- Experience working directly with customers or internal stakeholders to solve technical problems.

- Comfort working in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.

- Strong written communication and documentation skills.

- Working knowledge of high-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs.

- Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts.

- Located in Switzerland 

Nice-to-haves: 

- Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation.

- Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows.

- Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale.

Travel Expectations 

While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are two primary types of travel you can expect:

- Team Weeks: Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows.

- On-sites: This role will work closely with a local customer with expectations to be on site with that customer, so there will likely be far less travel than our typical MFDE roll. That being said, in the event the local customer were to no longer work with us, the following is our standard MFDE travel expectations: “For most of our large deployment customers, we will visit on-site during kick-off and key expansion opportunities. Most on-sites involve 2-3 days with the customer, with travel on either side. Travel is primarily within North America, and you can expect 4 customer on-sites per quarter.”

Extra Details

- This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure: 

- Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

- Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

- Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

- Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

- Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

- Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

- Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

- Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

- Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

- Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices: 

- Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

- Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

- 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

- Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

- Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

- Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

- Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

- Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

- Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

- Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

- Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

- Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

- Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

- Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

- State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

- Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

- Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

- Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

- Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

- Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

description:
Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. 

Your responsibilities: 

- Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

- Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

- Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

- Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

- Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

- Dutch fluency is a must 

- Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

- Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory 

- Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

- Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

- Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

- General technical proficiency with software

- Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus

What’s in it for you? 

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience…. 

- Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

- Uncapped commission

- Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

- An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

- Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry: 

- Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

- Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

- Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

- People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

- LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

- Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office 

- Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. 

Where to from here? 

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here .

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are: 

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

title: Data Engineer

description:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT 

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

- Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

- Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

- In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

- Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

- Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

- Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

- Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.

DIT ZOEKEN WIJ 

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

- Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen.

- Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

- Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract.

- Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille.

- Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

- Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR 

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

- Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen.

- Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting.

- Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert.

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager.

- Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur.

- Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris.

- 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris.

- Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

- Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling.

- Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag.

MEER WETEN?

Who you are

- You tinker with electronics, FPV, embedded software, or robotics.

- You like fast iteration and getting your hands dirty.

- Linux doesn’t scare you.

Please include photos/links of:

- your drone builds

Requirements

driver’s license, drone pilot license, CAD, 3D printing, soldering, or flight experience.

title: Stage Bouw
description:
Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! 

Dit wordt jouw stage 

Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer 

Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. 

Hier zit je goed! 

Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie. 

Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen. 

Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie. 

Dit breng je mee 

- Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde); 

- Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij! 

Dit bieden wij jou 

- Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; 

- Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; 

- De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; 

- Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! 

Meer weten? 

Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens. 

Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

title: (Senior) Product Marketing Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager based in Netherlands. 

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will take full ownership of product marketing strategy in a fast-growing, international AdTech environment. You will shape how innovative advertising technology products are positioned, communicated, and brought to market. Working closely with product, sales, customer success, and other cross-functional teams, you will translate complex technical capabilities into compelling value propositions. You will play a key role in developing go-to-market strategies, enabling commercial teams, and strengthening customer engagement. By combining market intelligence, customer insights, and data-driven storytelling, you will help drive business growth and product adoption. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative, remote-first team and contribute to the evolution of programmatic advertising across mobile and connected TV.

Accountabilities 

You will lead product marketing initiatives from strategy development to execution, ensuring consistent positioning and effective communication across customer-facing teams.

- 
Develop and execute product marketing strategies to promote products and solutions to existing and prospective B2B customers.

- 
Create compelling marketing content and bold narratives that clearly communicate product value, differentiation, and competitive advantages.

- 
Collaborate closely with product teams to ensure marketing messaging accurately reflects product features, capabilities, and developments.

- 
Lead go-to-market initiatives for new product launches and equip sales and customer success teams with effective messaging and enablement materials.

- 
Engage regularly with customers and internal stakeholders to collect feedback, understand market needs, and identify emerging industry trends.

- 
Partner with sales and customer success teams to align marketing execution with business objectives and customer insights.

- 
Monitor campaign and product marketing performance against key performance indicators, using data to identify opportunities for improvement.

- 
Leverage MarTech platforms and AI-powered tools to streamline content creation, improve reporting, optimize segmentation, and deliver personalized marketing experiences.

- 
Anticipate market developments and emerging advertising trends, translating them into relevant product positioning and forward-looking marketing narratives.

Requirements :

You are a proactive and strategic marketing professional with strong expertise in B2B advertising technology, excellent communication skills, and the ability to influence teams across a dynamic international organization.

- 
At least 5 years of experience in B2B AdTech, ideally within a startup or scaleup environment, with a proven track record in product marketing.

- 
Strong understanding of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, particularly mobile advertising trends, challenges, and opportunities.

- 
Solid knowledge of AI tools and demonstrated ability to integrate them into everyday marketing workflows.

- 
Experience with marketing platforms and tools such as HubSpot and WordPress is a plus.

- 
Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to develop engaging stories and compelling messaging for B2B audiences.

- 
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data and insights into differentiated marketing narratives.

- 
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

- 
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

- 
Outstanding organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

- 
Genuine passion for mobile marketing and app advertising, with a strong interest in emerging technologies and industry developments.

- 
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, remote-first, and international environment.

- 
Proven ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority, particularly across sales, customer success, and product management.

Benefits :

- 
Exceptional opportunities for career growth and professional development.

- 
The opportunity to work alongside experienced industry experts and entrepreneurs shaping the future of AdTech.

- 
Direct, day-to-day collaboration with the leadership team.

- 
A fun, ambitious, and multinational team distributed across Europe, India, Argentina, and soon the United States.

- 
Flexible work-from-home arrangements.

- 
A $500 home-office setup budget.

- 
A $1,000 annual learning and development budget.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

title: Senior Scrum master
description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken. 

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen, wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol 

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. 

Wat ga je doen? 

- Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

- Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

- Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

- Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

- Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

- Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

- Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.

- Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

- Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

- Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

- PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

- Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

- Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

- Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team 

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. 

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst 

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen 

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons? 

- Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

- 8% vakantiegeld;

- Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

- Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

- 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

- €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

- Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

- Goede pensioenregeling;

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

- Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.
