title: Marketing & Communicatie Stage
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)
description:
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)

Assen | 38 uur | Schaal 10 

Het mooie van werken bij Univé

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening? Ben jij een ervaren businessanalist die complexe processen doorgrondt, inhoudelijk richting geeft en graag zelf met beide benen in de praktijk staat?

Binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies werken we aan de migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics. Een uitdagende verandering waarbij niet alleen technologie, maar vooral onze bedrijfsprocessen en de dienstverlening aan onze leden centraal staan.

Als Senior Business Analist krijg jij de ruimte om deze verandering inhoudelijk vorm te geven. Je voert zelfstandig complexe analyses uit, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat businessbehoeften worden vertaald naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren businessanalist die overzicht houdt in complexe verandertrajecten. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen, informatievoorziening en IT-systemen samenhangen en weet deze kennis te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.

Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om collega's verder te helpen.

Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen.

Wat breng je mee?

- Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe business- en procesanalyses binnen een IT-omgeving.

- Kennis van en ervaring met zowel Synergy als Microsoft Dynamics.

- Ervaring met het analyseren en vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen naar functionele requirements.

- Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig uit te werken en anderen daarin mee te nemen.

- Ervaring met het inhoudelijk begeleiden en coachen van collega-analisten.

- Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van business en IT.

- Kennis van Agile/Scrum en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams.

Ervaring met systeemmigraties, juridische dienstverlening of de verzekeringsbranche is een pré.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Business Analist werk je binnen het Rechtshulp Synergy-team aan de vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap voor onze juridische dienstverlening.

De migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden.

Je brengt bestaande processen en informatievoorziening in kaart, onderzoekt welke verbeteringen mogelijk zijn en vertaalt deze naar heldere requirements voor de nieuwe omgeving.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt welke impact veranderingen hebben op medewerkers, processen en uiteindelijk onze leden.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

- Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe business- en procesanalyses.

- Het analyseren van bestaande Synergy-processen en het vertalen hiervan naar de gewenste inrichting binnen Dynamics.

- Het ophalen, uitwerken en valideren van businessrequirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria.

- Het inzichtelijk maken van afhankelijkheden tussen processen, applicaties en andere IT-teams.

- Het adviseren van de Product Owner en businessstakeholders over oplossingsrichtingen en verbeterkansen.

- Het inhoudelijk begeleiden van andere businessanalisten en bewaken van de kwaliteit van analyses.

- Het ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding en acceptatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

- Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en de verdere professionalisering van businessanalyse.

Wat verwachten we van jou? 

Binnen de eerste zes maanden heb je de belangrijkste Rechtshulp-processen geanalyseerd en vertaald naar bruikbare requirements voor Dynamics.

Daarnaast heb je inhoudelijk richting gegeven aan de migratie en een zichtbare bijdrage geleverd aan de kwaliteit en zelfstandigheid van de andere analisten.

Je team

Je komt terecht in het Rechtshulp Synergy-team binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies.

Het team maakt onderdeel uit van IT Distributie, waar we nauw samenwerken met onze businesscollega's om de dienstverlening van Univé continu te verbeteren.

Je werkt in een team waarin medewerkers veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgen. We verwachten dat je zelfstandig kunt werken, initiatief toont en actief de samenwerking opzoekt.

Als senior krijg je een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol, zonder dat je formeel leidinggevende bent.

Je bent iemand bij wie collega's terechtkunnen voor complexe vraagstukken, maar die ook zelf graag de inhoud induikt.

Je standplaats is Assen.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Univé krijg je een uitdagende functie waarin je direct bijdraagt aan de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening.

Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je vakinhoudelijke kennis in te zetten en collega's verder te helpen.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10 .

Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar , op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.

Daarnaast bieden we onder andere:

- Een variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris.

- Een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd.

- 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek.

- Een goede studiekostenregeling en mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling.

- Een goede pensioenvoorziening.

- Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.

- Korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatie zonder winstoogmerk. We helpen onze leden risico's te voorkomen, gevolgen te beperken en problemen op te lossen.

Binnen Juridisch Advies ondersteunen we leden bij juridische vragen en problemen. Goede digitale ondersteuning helpt onze collega's om deze dienstverlening persoonlijk, toegankelijk en efficiënt te houden.

IT Distributie speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. We ontwikkelen en verbeteren de IT-oplossingen waarmee onze collega's hun werk kunnen doen en onze leden goed geholpen worden.

Daarbij geloven we in eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de ruimte om zelf verbeteringen aan te dragen.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met Synergy en Microsoft Dynamics inzetten om onze juridische dienstverlening toekomstbestendig te maken?

En krijg je energie van een rol waarin je complexe analyses combineert met het begeleiden van collega's?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
description:
Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development.
Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer.
Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau.
Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m.

WAT GA JE DOEN? 

Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink!

Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes.

Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay.

Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken.

Intern werk je nauw samen met onder andere Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations en IT. Daarnaast vorm je samen met collega’s die zich meer richten op ontwikkeling en data een sterk team: jij richt je primair op de externe relaties en strategische partnerships.

Waar ga je dagelijks mee aan de slag: 

- Je bouwt en onderhoudt strategische relaties met Visa, Mastercard, Nederlandse banken, issuers en andere relevante partijen binnen payments.

- Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders en vertegenwoordigt Translink in strategische en inhoudelijke gesprekken.

- Je ontwikkelt een duidelijke partnershipstrategie en meerjarige agenda voor de samenwerking met card schemes en banken.

- Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink.

- Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven.

- Je verbindt externe marktontwikkelingen met interne technische, financiële en datagedreven inzichten.

- Je adviseert management en directie over kansen, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en ontwikkelingen binnen het paymentecosysteem.

- Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance.

- Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink.

WIE ZOEKEN WE? 

We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen.

Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen en weet de vertaalslag te maken tussen de buitenwereld en de interne organisatie. Tegelijkertijd ben je pragmatisch. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat.

Voor een ervaren professional biedt deze rol bovendien iets bijzonders: je werkt aan een maatschappelijk relevant betalingssysteem dat dagelijks door miljoenen reizigers wordt gebruikt.

WAT ZIT ERIN JOUW TAS? 

- Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships, business development of relatiemanagement.

- Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met partijen zoals card schemes, banken, issuers, acquirers, paymentnetwerken of andere organisaties binnen het betalingsverkeer.

- Je hebt kennis van onderwerpen zoals scheme rules, scheme economics, fees, incentives en ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer.

- Je bent gewend om complexe relaties en onderhandelingen op senior niveau te voeren.

- Je kunt marktontwikkelingen, financiële belangen en inhoudelijke vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere voorstellen en concrete resultaten.

- Je communiceert overtuigend met zowel inhoudelijke experts als senior management en externe bestuurders.

- Je bent organisatiesensitief, analytisch en zelfstandig en weet mensen mee te krijgen zonder formele hiërarchie.

- Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels uitstekend.

WAT BIEDT TRANSLINK JOU? 

Translink is een leuke, uitdagende werkplek. We werken in een dynamische, veelzijdige omgeving met een hoog ontwikkeltempo. Samenwerken, Wendbaarheid en Zelfregie zijn onze kernwaarden en dat proef je op de werkvloer.

Translink biedt een prettige kantooromgeving met fijne werkplekken. Onze werksfeer is informeel, open en behulpzaam. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn aantrekkelijk. Vrij bewegen is ons motto. Je kunt in goed overleg hybride werken en we bieden bewegingsruimte om balans aan te brengen tussen je werk- en privéleven. Zo kun je met onze thuiswerkregeling ook thuis een fijne werkplek inrichten.

Voor je eigen ontwikkeling bieden wij de GoodHabitz online leeromgeving aan. Zo kun je jezelf continu blijven ontwikkelen. We hebben bij Translink ook de mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen, dit kan zowel voor privé als woon-werkverkeer.

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. Dit is afhankelijk van je ervaring en kwalificaties, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Daar bovenop ontvang je een keuzebudget van 6,94% van je salaris, dit is gemiddeld € 500,- p/m. Daarnaast krijg je 8% vakantiegeld, reiskosten en een goede pensioenregeling. Deze functie is voor minimaal 32 uur per week.

· Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie.

IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. title: Senior System Test & Validation Engineer
description:
As a Senior System Test & Validation Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for defining and driving system-level verification and validation for complex multidisciplinary products.

You develop a strong understanding of the product, customer use cases, system architecture, operating environment, and technical risks, and translate these into effective validation strategies, test setups, and test campaigns.

The systems you validate combine sensing hardware, embedded software, Edge computing, networking, cloud software, data processing, algorithms, and customer-facing applications. Your role is therefore focused on validating the complete system and ensuring that critical customer workflows work reliably before release.

You work closely with Product, Systems Engineering, Software, Embedded, Hardware, Algorithms, Operations, Manufacturing, and other IVVQ engineers.

This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role, combining system-level thinking, test design, technical investigation, and practical validation.

Qualifications

- BSc or MSc in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

- 7+ years of relevant experience in system testing, verification & validation, integration testing, or product qualification.

- Experience validating complex multidisciplinary products combining hardware and software.

- Strong understanding of system-level test strategy, risk-based testing, requirements verification, and product qualification.

- Experience translating requirements and customer use cases into practical validation approaches.

- Experience designing system test setups and representative test environments.

- Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across subsystem boundaries.

- Working knowledge of Linux and networking.

- Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and modern engineering workflows.

- Experience with requirements traceability and verification evidence.

- Strong communication skills in English and a collaborative working style.

- Eligible for required EU/NATO/security screening or clearance, where applicable.

Nice to have

- Python experience for test automation, analysis, or tooling.

- Hardware-in-the-Loop or automated system-level testing experience.

- Experience with Edge systems, Docker, or cloud-connected products.

- Experience with environmental, reliability, lifetime, or mechanical testing.

- Experience with industrial sensing, condition monitoring, photonics, energy systems, or similar technologies.

- Experience with FAT, commissioning, or field validation.

- Experience with requirements-management tools such as Jira, Polarion.

Why Join Us?

- Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

- Work on complex multidisciplinary products combining photonics, hardware, software, cloud, and algorithms.

- Shape how system-level validation is done within a growing R&D organization.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Regular team activities, company events, and fresh team lunches.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

The Role 

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life.

You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment.

You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product.

Responsibilities 

- Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle.

- Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation.

- Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product.

- Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible.

- Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records.

- Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development.

- Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability.

- Perform engineering analyses and testing to evaluate structural integrity, lifting loads, fatigue performance, hydrodynamic behaviour, and environmental robustness.

- Join design reviews, DFMEA sessions of submodules. Give input to improve overall system performance / to meet system requirements.

- Support Verification & Validation by providing technical expertise during structural verification and qualification activities.

- Support fabrication suppliers and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities by providing technical expertise and assessing structural assemblies against engineering specifications.

- Share engineering knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability and improve future engineering execution.

- Provide constructive feedback and support peers in solving technical challenges.

- Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing engineering culture.

What we offer 

- Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

- Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

- A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

- A competitive salary and benefits package.

- 30 days of holiday per year.

- Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.

Requirements 

- BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

- Minimum 5 years of experience developing mechanical systems that are used in harsh environments.

- Hands on design experience for systems / products that requires qualification against military (environmental) standards.

- Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

- Experience designing marine products or subsea mechanical systems.

- Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design.

- Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners.

- Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams.

- Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred 

- Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design.

- Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings.

- Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects.

- Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management.

Screening 

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

Wat ga je doen?

title: Backend Engineer - Payments Team

Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger.

- Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code 

- Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop; 

- Taking ownership from discovery to post-production; 

- Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis; 

- Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices 

Who we are looking for

Additionally, you tick the following boxes: 

- You have 3+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience. 

- You have previous experience in the payments domain. 

- You have experience working in agile teams within an international, multicultural environment. 

- You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases. 

- You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka. 

- You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build. 

- You spot opportunities and problems and pick them up yourself instead of waiting for a ticket. 

- You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement. 

- You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission. 

Nice to have 

- Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain. 

Join us in building a better future 

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place. 

Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry! 

As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure. 

Our benefits package includes: 

- Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation. 

- Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned). 

- A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities. 

- In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use. 

- 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you two mission days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you. 

- Going the extra mile for parents: We provide you with personalised coaching support before, during, and after parental leave, facilitated by Foundree.

- Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations. 

- Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees.

Interested in making an impact? 

We would love to have a conversation with you! 

Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your motivation letter why you’re excited about joining Fastned. 

Here’s the next steps of the hiring process: 

- Screening call with Recruiter

Then, it’s time to welcome you on board to Fastned! 

Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique.

ABOUT INSIFY 

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

About the role 

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.

What you'll be doing 

- Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business

- Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines

- Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

What you'll need 

- 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership

- Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend

- You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt

- Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture

Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

Nice to have 

- Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech

- Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets

- Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

Our stack 

TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.

We offer 

- Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000.

- Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves.

- Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days.

- Pension. We contribute 6% for you.

- Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it.

- Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them.

- A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks.

- Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating.

title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

- Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

- Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

- Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

- Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives. 

- Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

- See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

- Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

- Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

- Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.

It's Important to Us That You Have

- Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

- Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

- Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

- Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

- Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

- Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

- History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI

Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.

1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations 

Mastery of Core Concepts 

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways 

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing 

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.

2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation 

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks 

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice 

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source 

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.

3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems 

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines 

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training 

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.

4. Hardware & Systems Understanding 

Efficient Implementations at Scale 

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints 

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details 

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.

5. Rigorous Experimental Design 

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations 

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics 

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases 

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rig

title: Senior Product Analyst / Data Scientist
description:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

In Token Factory analytics there is no split into product analysts, ML engineers and data engineers. Each person owns a question end to end: builds the data, runs the analysis, and comes back with a recommendation that changes a decision.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Define core product and business metrics and build a single source of truth that Product, Finance, and Sales can rely on.
- Build a comprehensive view of self-service customers, including usage patterns, customer health, satisfaction, retention risks, unmet needs, and growth opportunities.
- Translate customer demand and commercial plans into capacity forecasts and support capacity allocation decisions.
- Measure effective capacity utilization and identify opportunities to improve the commercial value of available capacity.
- Develop and evaluate pricing and packaging models, including guaranteed capacity, on-demand pricing, commitments, clawback mechanisms, and provisioned throughput units.
- Provide data-driven recommendations for the self-service and managed offerings, including customer segmentation, pricing, and capacity.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Finance, and Sales to turn insights into concrete product and operational improvements.

We expect you to have:

- 5+ years of experience in analytics or data science.
- Strong Python, SQL, and statistics: you understand the code and the methods you use.
- Hands-on experience analysing large-scale customer, product, and usage datasets using statistical / analytical or distributed data-processing tools.
- AI-assisted coding as your default way of working: you guide it, verify it, and own the result.
- The ability to go from a question to a production-ready solution.
- The ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations.
- Strong commercial and product judgment, with the ability to balance customer value, monetization, growth, and profitability.
- Experience with pricing, packaging, monetization, or commercial analytics for technical or consumption-based products.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Sales, and Operations.

Nice to have:

- Competitive compensation

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Medical Data Intern (x/f/m)
description:
Medical Data Intern (x/f/m) 

Set a new pulse for healthcare! 

We are looking for a Medical Data Intern to join the Terminology and Ontology team within the Medical Excellence department at Doctolib in Berlin .

At Doctolib, we're setting a new pulse for healthcare. We create AI-powered solutions that help health professionals focus on care and help people prevent, detect, and treat health problems earlier. In this role, you will contribute to making medical information clear, structured, and usable across products for patients, healthcare professionals, and technical teams.

What you'll do 

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Collect and format sets of terms describing pathologies, allergies, treatments, and other medical concepts, based on standard medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT.

- Adapt medical labels to create versions that are understandable to patients and healthcare professionals.

- Translate labels from English into German.

- Map medical lists of terms across different products.

- Select and filter terms, then validate your choices with medical experts.

- Share your work and methodology with the Terminology and Ontology team and product teams.

- Deliver sets of terms to technical teams in the correct format.

About our data environment 

- Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements.

- Our stack is composed of Dagster, dbt, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and other technologies.

- We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here and learn about our first AI hackathon here !

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles !

Who you are 

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next teammate if: 

- You have medical skills gained through a diploma or degree that includes medical-domain learning.

- You have knowledge of data management.

- You are familiar with medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT.

- You have strong spreadsheet skills, including Google Sheets or Excel and the use of formulas. 

- You are attentive to detail and demonstrate rigour in your work.

- You speak German and English, which is a must have for this role.

Nice to have: 

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude.

- Python programming skills.

- Additional depth of medical knowledge.

- Dutch language skills.

What we offer 

- A structured and personalized onboarding program through our Doctolib Academy , as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities and masterclasses throughout the internship.

- Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping .

- A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket .

- A flexible workplace policy offering up to 2 days of hybrid work per week.

The interview process 

- An interview with our Talent Partner (30 minutes).

- An interview with the hiring manager (30 minutes).

Job details 

- Contract Type: Internship (Mandatory/Voluntary)

- Working Time: Full-time

- Duration: 6 months

- Work model: Hybrid

- Location: Berlin, Germany.

- Expected start date: January 2027 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This commitment is reflected in our hiring process, where we assess applications based solely on qualifications, potential, and motivation, without discrimination of any kind.

We believe that diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences help us build better healthcare products. We welcome applications from all candidates, regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To support equal opportunities, we encourage candidates not to include unnecessary personal information, such as a photo or age, in their application. If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know and we will do our best to support you.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Node.js/TypeScript (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare! 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the DIAL team in the Phone Assistant domain.

Your mission will be to design, build, and scale the AI-powered features that transform how practitioners and patients connect over the phone — making care more accessible for patients and reducing administrative burden for health professionals. You will work in a feature team developing the Phone Assistant, Doctolib's solution that combines LLM reasoning, speech recognition, and real-time backend systems, launching first in Germany and expanding to France and Italy. 

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do 

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Build and operate backend services in Node.js/TypeScript (with Python exposure), designing for reliability, scalability, and real-time performance

- Design, evaluate, and ship LLM-based features end-to-end: prompt engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, guardrails, and fallback strategies

- Own AI feature quality: build evaluation datasets and scorers (e.g., in Braintrust), track regressions, and make evidence-based ship decisions before each release

- Deploy and operate cloud-native services on Kubernetes across major cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP), and evolve CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions 

- Design data models and drive database migrations and performance tuning for real-time workloads ( PostgreSQL : connection pooling, indexing, query optimisation)

- Maintain a high testing bar (unit, integration, e2e), debug distributed systems in production with strong observability, and contribute to pragmatic, secure architecture decisions

Who you are 

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you: 

- Have 5+ years of backend engineering experience building scalable, resilient systems in Node.js/TypeScript (with some Python)

- Have hands-on production experience building LLM-based features: prompting, tool calling, structured outputs, eval frameworks, and handling real-world failure modes

- Have proven experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes within at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with solid CI/CD practices

- Have a strong testing culture (unit/integration/e2e), sharp debugging skills for microservices and distributed systems, and a focus on code quality

- Are fluent in English, with a collaborative mindset and the drive to own problems end-to-end — from design to production

It would be fantastic if you: 

- Have experience with speech pipelines (ASR, TTS, streaming audio) or voice agents

- Are familiar with event-driven architectures and message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or Redis Streams), and have hands-on PostgreSQL experience (EXPLAIN/ANALYZE, indexing strategies, connection pooling)

- Have an interest in telephony and real-time communication (SIP, RTP, WebRTC) — no prior experience needed, we will teach you

Life at Doctolib Tech 

- Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

- Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

- We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here .

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site . 

What we offer 

- A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

- 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

- Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

- Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

- Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

- The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

- Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

- Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

- Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

- A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

- Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

- For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

- Relocation support in case of international mobility

- Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process 

- Recruiter Interview

- Live Coding Interview

- System Design Interview

- Behavioral Interview

- At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page .

Job details

- Full-time

- Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

- Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
description:
Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.

Doctolib is becoming an AI-native company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a Senior AI Specialist , you will be the technical builder and AI Ops Owner behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.

You will work in founder and product mode : you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.

Your Responsibilities

- Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them: You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.

- Build and operate AI agents as products: You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.

- Knowledge and context management: You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.

- Evaluation and quality assurance: You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.

- CRM and data integration: You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.

- Central interface and enablement: You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.

- Impact and measurement: Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.

Your Profile

Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize potential over years of experience alone . What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect. 

What Really Matters to Us, Regardless of the Specific Tool:

- Learning speed and a production mindset: You have taught yourself a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used. You can describe precisely what went wrong, such as hallucinations, prompt drift, outdated data, or costs, and how you solved it.

- An instinct for evaluation: You do not rely on something merely “looking good”. You define a quality bar and measure against it. For you, automation and quality go hand in hand.

- Ownership and communication: You take ownership of a problem end to end, prioritize rigorously, feel comfortable with ambiguity, and make technical topics understandable to non-technical stakeholders.

- Technical and data understanding: You can read and adapt scripts, understand APIs, webhooks, and automation tools such as Make, n8n, and Zapier, and know how CRM data, ideally Salesforce data, flows into AI systems.

- Strong communication skills: You have a confident command of English and can operate at the highest level in our international environment. German at B1 level is sufficient.

We Are Particularly Interested in:

- Expertise with agent platforms: You have practical experience with systems such as Dust, Claude, or LangChain. Since tools evolve quickly, we primarily rely on your process understanding and evaluation skills as a sustainable foundation.

- Technical depth and data fluency: You are proficient in languages such as Python or JavaScript and can confidently navigate Salesforce architectures or BI environments such as Tableau and Metabase to manage data flows effectively.

- Operations experience: You have solid experience working with scaled Customer Success or Operations teams and understand their specific dynamics.

- A Germany-wide public transport pass sponsored by Doctolib if you work from the office or in hybrid mode

- Company-sponsored health insurance with excellent additional benefits

- 28 days of paid vacation, plus one additional day for every full calendar year of employment, up to a maximum of 30 days

- For caregivers and employees with disabilities, we offer support that includes more flexible working hours, additional leave for medical reasons, and psychological support

- Own cross-team ML architecture decisions, from model selection to production deployment patterns and strategic build vs. buy decisions

- Define and drive adoption of rigorous evaluation frameworks across all AI teams, setting the standard for how Doctolib measures model and agentic performance

- You are expert in Python, PyTorch/Transformers for training, and vLLM for inference with a track record deploying ML systems in production (AWS/GCP)

Now it would be fantastic if you have:

- Publications in top-tier ML/AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL) or medical informatics venues

- Experience with EU healthcare regulations (GDPR, MDR, AI Act)

- Prior work with clinical data or healthcare applications

- Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform supporting web and mobile interfaces across multiple languages and healthcare specialties.

- Our stack includes Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

- A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

At Doctolib, we believe in improving access to healthcare for everyone - regardless of where you come from or what you look like. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination. We respect and celebrate diversity!

description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $6M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize their content and promote it online. The next target is a $15M run rate.

We're hiring our first product engineer focused on growth. You'll own our marketing pages and the surfaces that turn attention into revenue: free tools, landing pages, signup, onboarding, paywalls, and pricing. You'll also ship on the core product itself. Wherever the biggest lever is, that's where you build.

This is a builder role. You'll ship production code daily, look at the results, decide what to test next, and be one of the people most directly responsible for taking us from $6M to $15M and ultimately to $100M.

As a profitable company, there is no VC drama. We are a small, ambitious group of people striving to build something creators love.

Tasks 

- Own our marketing pages: build, maintain, and continuously improve the landing pages and site experiences that bring people into Neural Frames, and keep them fast, high-converting, and visible in traditional search, Google AI Overviews, and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

- Turn our free tools into real product entry points, where users get immediate value and then continue into Neural Frames without losing their song, lyrics, artwork, or progress

- Run conversion experiments across the whole funnel: landing pages, calls to action, signup, onboarding, paywalls, packaging, and pricing

- Ship on the core product when that's where the growth lever is, especially product-native loops: shareable creations, templates, embeds, referrals, and public pages that give creators a reason to spread Neural Frames for us

- Run programmatic SEO experiments without creating low-quality pages, index bloat, or content that exists only for search engines

- Build lifecycle experiments tied to real product behavior: activation, abandoned projects, paywall recovery, feature discovery, re-engagement

- Make sure our Conversion Tracking is set up correctly

- Own growth measurement and data quality across PostHog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and our backend payment data: build funnels and dashboards you can trust, investigate unexpected movements, and turn them into decisions

Requirements 

- You're a product engineer who can independently ship production experiences with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and you sweat the details that make pages convert: speed, layout, copy, polish

- You're comfortable moving into backend and data work when necessary. Our backend is written in Python, and you can work with APIs, SQL, event data, and attribution logic

- You think like a marketer as much as an engineer: you have real opinions about headlines, page structure, and pricing pages, and you'd rather be measured on signups and revenue than on tickets closed

- You think through the complete funnel. A page that ranks is not a win if visitors don't activate, pay, and stick around

- You understand experimentation: hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, and a decision threshold defined before the test goes live

- You have strong product and editorial judgment. You build useful experiences for humans rather than filling the internet with generic AI-generated pages

- You use AI tools as a genuine extension of how you work, with a high bar for accuracy, originality, and brand quality

- You have high agency: you identify the bottleneck, gather the evidence, ship a solution, and communicate results without waiting for a perfectly specified ticket

- You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

- You've personally built something that produced meaningful organic or product-led growth: a startup, a free tool, a programmatic SEO engine, or growth ownership at a product company. We care more about attributable revenue than impressive traffic screenshots

- You know technical SEO well: crawling, indexing, structured data, internal linking, canonicalization, and safe migrations

Benefits 

VSOPs & Profit Sharing. Bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, a one-time headphone budget, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

title: Senior Software Developer:in (m/w/d)
description:
KI verändert unseren Job gerade nicht jährlich, sondern monatlich. Und vielleicht merkst du, dass dein Umfeld da nicht mitkommt: KI ist verboten, wird ignoriert oder läuft als „mach mal KI“ nebenher. Bei uns ist das anders. Wir wollen KI nicht irgendwie in den Alltag kippen, sondern wirklich verstehen und als Werkzeug nutzen, das unsere Fähigkeiten erweitert, statt sie zu ersetzen. Wer die Veränderung gestalten will, muss schneller lernen, als sie passiert.

Das heißt auch: Umsetzen ist kein Hexenwerk mehr. Früher war der Job 70, 80 % Entwickeln, das dreht sich gerade. Umsetzung kann man delegieren, Entscheidungen nicht. Darum bist du bei uns der Übersetzer zwischen Fachlichkeit und Technik, und die Ownership für eine Entscheidung trägst du, keine KI.

Das machst du nicht in einem Bodyshop, der dir einen Stuhl beim Kunden besorgt. Und auch nicht in einer Beratung, die nach drei Monaten ein 200-Seiten-Dokument hinterlässt. Wir sitzen über Jahre als tragendes Element in den Entwicklungsteams unserer Kunden, meist in Digitalisierungsteams im Konzern, und schieben dort das ganze Team nach vorne.

Wie du startest 

Du kommst in ein bestehendes Projekt mit einem von uns, gehst mit in die Termine und kommst schnell ins Doing, statt ewig Sachen zu lesen. Am Anfang hast du einen Paten, der dich im Team mitnimmt, und einen fachlichen Ansprechpartner. Nach etwa sechs Monaten führst du Termine alleine, setzt Themen eigenständig um und gehst in die Architekturplanung. Stück für Stück übergeben wir dir den Staffelstab, bis du in deinem Bereich die Verantwortung für den Kunden trägst. Leadership heißt bei uns: technische Führung nach außen, nicht nach innen.

Aufgaben

- Du arbeitest bei einem Kunden, nicht bei dreien gleichzeitig. Mindestens einer von uns ist mit im Projekt, und ihr seid fester Teil der Routinen vom Kundenteam.

- Du redest direkt mit dem Fachbereich und den Entscheidern. Keine Proxy-POs, kein Projektleiter dazwischen.

- Du lernst die Fachsprache vom Kunden, modellierst die Domain und setzt sie um, im Backend mit Node/TypeScript, vorne mit React.

- Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand eine Aufgabe gibt. Du findest die Aufgaben, stimmst sie ab und übernimmst die Ownership dafür.

- Ein Ticket ist schön. Und dann reden wir nochmal drüber, wie die Fachlichkeit wirklich ist.

- Wir sagen nicht Ja und Amen zu allem. Wenn was keinen Sinn macht, sagst du das. Diplomatisch, aber klar.

- Es geht um den Wert, der beim Kunden entsteht. Dafür baust du sauber und sagst dem Kunden transparent, was der nächste Schritt bringt und was er kostet.

Dein Profil

Was du mitbringst 

- Du bist eher in Fachlichkeiten und im Backend zu Hause als beim nächsten abgespacten UX-Feature. Denn sind wir ehrlich, das bekommt man mittlerweile gut automatisiert.

- Du willst eine Fachdomäne durchdringen und im Großen mitdenken.

- Du laberst keinen Bullshit, du stehst zu dem, was du sagst.

- Offenheit und Interesse für die Chancen mit KI.

- Rund 6 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung, das meiste davon im Backend mit einer typisierten Sprache, am liebsten Node/TypeScript.

- Node/TypeScript steht bei dir in einem echten Projekt, nicht nur in der Skill-Liste. Und dein letzter Backend-Einsatz in Produktion ist nicht ewig her.

- Du hast Architektur nicht nur gesehen, sondern auch verantwortet und gestaltet.

- Du kennst dich in einer Cloud aus, AWS, Azure oder GCP, und kannst sagen, welche Dienste du wofür genutzt hast.

- Du hast Anforderungen selbst mit dem Fachbereich geklärt, Epics geschnitten und Aufwand mit Risiko benannt.

- Du hast PoCs gebaut, Technologien ausgewählt und als ADR dokumentiert, Konventionen eingeführt und technische Schulden abgebaut.

- Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, denn Deutsch ist unsere Domänensprache.

- Du tickst nicht alle Boxen? Wenn dich das hier anfixt, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Nice to have 

- Du kennst die Baustoffbranche schon von innen. Einer unserer Kunden ist ein Baustoffhersteller.

- Kubernetes löst bei dir keinen Angstschweiß aus.

- Domain-Driven Design und hexagonale Architektur begeistern dich.

- Du denkst eine API vom Vertrag her: OpenAPI, sauberes REST-Design, Backend for Frontend.

- Du hast KI-Werkzeuge in einem Team eingeführt und weißt, wie man motiviert.

- Du hast Leute gementort oder ein Projekt schon alleine verantwortet.

- Du teilst gerne Wissen: Vorträge, Blog, Open Source oder ein Thema außerhalb vom Stack.

Wenn du nicht zu uns passt 

- Du willst ein Team führen. Wir sind zu sechst und planen keine mittlere Führungsebene.

- Du nutzt KI, um Verantwortung abzugeben, statt deine Entscheidungskraft zu erweitern.

- Du willst lieber am eigenen Produkt arbeiten als beim Kunden, oder lieber Konzepte malen als selbst bauen.

- Du willst deine Arbeitsweise durchdrücken, statt aktuelle Praxis zu verstehen.

- Der Teamtag alle 4 Wochen ist für dich eine lästige Pflicht.

- Für dich ist es am Ende halt ein Job, und dich treiben vor allem Gehalt und Titel.

- Du suchst eigentlich das nächste Freelance-Projekt und keine Festanstellung.

Der Prozess

Kurz und ohne fünf Gesprächsrunden.

- Erstgespräch mit mir , 30 Minuten remote. Du prüfst uns dabei genauso wie ich dich. Am Ende sage ich dir direkt, wie ich es sehe, und nicht hinterher in einer kalten Mail.

- Kennenlerntag mit dem Team , remote, 4 Stunden mit Pausen. Das ist keine Prüfung. Du reviewst Code und erklärst, was dir auffällt. Du baust mit deinem eigenen KI-Setup einen Fix, so wie du wirklich arbeitest. Und du führst ein Kundengespräch im Rollenspiel und lernst das Team in 1:1s kennen. Danach können wir beide klar sagen: passt oder passt nicht.

- Referenzen und Angebot. Wir entscheiden gemeinsam als Team und machen dir ein Angebot. Persönlich sehen wir uns spätestens beim Angebotsgespräch oder beim ersten Teamtag.

Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in ein, zwei Tagen von uns. Und wenn es nicht passt, sagen wir dir das persönlich und mit Begründung. Unser Ziel: höchstens zwei Wochen für den ganzen Prozess.

Benefits

Wie wir zusammenarbeiten

- Wir arbeiten full remote, niemand sitzt im Büro. Alle 4 Wochen treffen wir uns in Darmstadt zum Teamtag. Das klappt gut, wenn du in etwa 4 Stunden bei uns bist.

- Wir sind keine Family, wir sind gute Kollegen.

- Warum wir suchen: Wir haben mehr Anfragen, als wir aktuell umsetzen können. Wir wollen nachhaltig wachsen sehen aber in unserer Größe in der aktuellen Zeit eine Stärke.

Unsere Formate

- Check-in , jeden Morgen: nicht fachlich, sondern sozial. Und es ist voll okay zu sagen: Gerade ist echt nicht cool.

- AI-Catchup , jede Woche: Wir schauen was letzte Woche in der KI-Welt passiert ist und wie wir unseren Workflow verbessert haben.

- Weekend Checkout , jeden Freitag: 15 Minuten zum Abschluss der Woche.

- 1:1 mit deinem Chef , alle 2 Wochen.

- Retro , alle 2 Wochen, abwechselnd remote und am Teamtag. Daraus setzen wir Experimente mit klaren Zielen und Deadlines um. Dabei gilt Fail Fast: Wenn wir falsch lagen, feiern wir das eher, als uns drüber aufzuregen.

- Pizzalounge , alle 4 Wochen remote: Pizza bestellen, Wissen austauschen, quatschen.

- Teamtag in Darmstadt , alle 4 Wochen: am Vorabend ein Social Event, mal Minigolf, Kart fahren oder Axtwerfen. Am Tag selbst Retro und interne Themen.

- Entwicklungsgespräch , jedes halbe Jahr: Wir setzen Ziele. Wenn du Zeit, Geld oder Ressourcen dafür brauchst, bekommst du sie.

Was wir dir bieten

- Dein Chef ist Entwickler und quatscht kein Business-Blabla, sondern weiß genau, was du meinst.

- Ein starkes Team, das TypeScript und React auf Expertenniveau macht.

- Sicherheit und kein Projekthopping: KI ist wild, aber wir haben all unsere Kunden seit Anfang an und eine gute Basis für die nächsten Jahre.

- 75.000 bis 95.000 € brutto im Jahr. Wo du einsteigst, hängt davon ab, wie vertraut dir unser Stack schon ist und wie erfahren du in Architektur, KI und Kundenkontakt bist.

- Jährliche Gehaltsgespräche: Der Inflationsausgleich ist ein No-Brainer, alles on top ist das Ergebnis aus deinen Entwicklungsgesprächen.

Benefits

- 30 Tage Urlaub und ein unbefristeter Vertrag.

- 3 statt 6 Monate Probezeit.

- Teilzeit ab 80 % geht, nach einem Start in Vollzeit.

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten, solange du beim Job to be done on track bist und keinen hängen lässt.

- Ab zwei Stunden Anfahrt zum Teamtag gehen der ICE in der 1. Klasse und die Nacht im Hotel auf uns.

- Ein top gespectes MacBook. Wenn du der Linux-Gott bist, bekommen wir das auch hin, aber Windows? No way.

- Essenszuschuss, monatlicher Sachbezug als Gutschein und Firmenrad.

- Nach Absprache: Mobiltelefon, Unterstützung bei der Kita, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Urban Sports Club und weitere Leistungen über unsere Benefit-Plattform.

Unsere Werte

- Ownership: Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für die ganzheitliche Lösung, nicht nur für ein Ticket. Wenn du einen Schritt nach vorne gehst, gehen wir alle einen Schritt nach vorne.

- Verbindung: Beim Kunden sitzen wir als Beifahrer vorne statt auf dem Backseat: Wir gucken auf dieselbe Straße und geben uns ab und an das Lenkrad in die Hand.

- Wertschätzung: Wir sagen offen, was gut läuft und was nicht, und supporten uns.

- Entwicklung und Enablement: Was wir lernen, geben wir weiter.

- Exzellenz statt Pflasterarchitektur: Eine KI kriegt vier, fünf Iterationen gut hin, bei der sechsten crasht es, wenn keiner auf die Qualität schaut. Wir schauen hin und intervenieren frühzeitig auf Hochniveau.
