Language requirements: native-level in French & Dutch, and able to work in English

About Ambio: 

Ambio is the world’s first AI-native physical commodity trader. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to sustainable materials, and this mission is progressing fast in our first domain, recycled plastics.

We work closely with industrial manufacturers through the full procurement cycle, making sustainable material options an easy choice. With our AI-native approach and proprietary trading technology, we can offer the widest selection of recycled plastics on the market.

We’re a Helsinki-based startup with 19 employees in Helsinki, Berlin, and Stockholm, and funding from e.g. Lifeline Ventures, b2venture, and SpeedInvest.

More information about Ambio: https://ambiomaterials.com/

Position

Join Ambio’s Supply team to find, validate, and deliver recycled plastics to our growing customer base across Europe! We make sure our customers get the best recycled plastics to manufacture new products.

We do whatever it takes to drive customers’ success, and to grow our delivered volumes and our positive impact. We are continuously looking for great new materials and suppliers to complement our current offering - to then match them to new and existing customer needs.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work at the forefront of sustainable materials and operational-AI applications, and to make a difference in how circularity becomes reality. You will own and drive supplier cooperation, grow our supplier pool and build strong relationships, and ensure efficient delivery of high-quality materials. You also get to develop our software (the Ambio Platform) with our Product team to help us grow faster.

In your work, you will be given full ownership of what is in your responsibility, and the full support of the team to succeed in it.

Key responsibilities

- Growth & Pace: You are the main driver together with our Sales team to drive our revenue growth - you are Supply owner for key accounts and projects.

- Sourcing: You source suppliers and build business and long-term relationships between Ambio and them. You make sure we know the partners’ team, materials and production operations inside-out, ensuring high two-way trust and efficient sales and delivery.

- Purchasing & Negotiation: You will ensure both high standards of service and quality assurance as well as a competitive price for Ambio’s customers. Your role is to excite partners to go the extra mile to meet our standards and service our demanding customers.

- Product management: The whole Ambio team provides their expertise and context understanding of their function to the benefit of our Product team. You will support our software developers to make our service to our customer’s even more stellar, our pace of growth even faster, and your life easier.

Requirements

To excel in this role, we believe the ideal candidate: 

- Takes initiative, drives things forward without waiting for instructions, and turns ideas into action even when everything is not fully defined

- Has a strong will to build, improve our company, and grow with it

- Is excited to face new things daily and open to jump into new things, to meet new people and build a relationship with them

- Likes to work with and talk to people, can communicate effectively and make our partners laugh and love working with us

- Learns new things quickly, doesn’t hesitate in front of uncertainty, and adapts to situations

- Can work independently and take full ownership of their work

- Can keep their head cool and move forward steady even when adversity or problems arise

- Is native in French & Dutch, and able to work in English . Other language skills are viewed as an asset (German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Slavic and Baltic languages)

Typical recruitment process: 

- Intro : get to know each other

- Culture & case interview : practical interview through examples from real work

- Founder round : interview with one of the founders

- Peer calls : with your future teammates

title: Sicherheitsingenieur (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst als Sicherheitsingenieur nicht verwalten, sondern Entscheidungen prägen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. 

Als externer Dienstleister betreuen wir Produktionsbetriebe in Arbeitsschutz, Arbeitssicherheit und Brandschutz. Wir wachsen schneller, als unser Team neue Kunden aufnehmen kann. Deshalb suchen wir für unseren Standort München einen Sicherheitsingenieur, der Betriebe eigenverantwortlich betreut und Arbeitsschutz dort verankert, wo er bisher nur nebenher lief.

Was dich hier erwartet 

Du bist nicht die Stabsstelle, die am Ende einer langen Freigabekette steht. Du bist die Fachperson, die die Geschäftsführung fragt, bevor eine neue Halle eingerichtet oder eine Maschine angeschafft wird. Du betreust mehrere Betriebe parallel, kennst ihre Anlagen, Prozesse und Risiken und setzt die Prioritäten selbst. Deine Aufgaben 

- Du betreust deine Kundenbetriebe als externe Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit nach DGUV Vorschrift 2 und planst deine Einsätze selbst: Woche, Route und Schwerpunkte.

- Du bewertest Arbeitsplätze, Maschinen und Anlagen sicherheitstechnisch, erstellst Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und leitest Maßnahmen ab, die wirklich umgesetzt werden.

- Du berätst die Geschäftsführung bei Neu- und Umplanungen von Arbeitsbereichen, damit Sicherheit von Anfang an mitgedacht wird.

- Du verantwortest den betrieblichen Brandschutz: Brandschutzordnungen, Flucht- und Rettungswegpläne, Räumungsübungen und die Ausbildung von Brandschutz- und Evakuierungshelfern.

- Du moderierst ASA-Sitzungen, analysierst Unfälle und Beinaheunfälle und bist Ansprechpartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Betriebsrat und Berufsgenossenschaft.

- Du hältst Unterweisungen, die hängen bleiben, und dokumentierst so, dass deine Kunden ihre Fortschritte sehen und verstehen.

Was du mitbringst 

- Abgeschlossene Sifa-Ausbildung auf Basis eines Ingenieur-, Techniker- oder Meisterabschlusses.

- Mindestens zwei Jahre Praxis im Arbeitsschutz, idealerweise in der Industrie oder als externe Sifa.

- Sicherer Umgang mit ArbSchG, BetrSichV, ArbStättV/ASR und dem DGUV-Regelwerk, aus der Praxis und nicht nur aus dem Lehrbuch.

- Erfahrung im Brandschutz ist ein Plus. Die Qualifikation zum Brandschutzbeauftragten kannst du im ersten Jahr auf unsere Kosten erwerben.

- Du erklärst technische Risiken so, dass Lagerleiter und Geschäftsführerin gleichermaßen handeln und du bleibst freundlich, aber klar, wenn ein Mangel sicherheitskritisch ist.

- Deutsch auf C1-Niveau und Führerschein Klasse B.

Was du bekommst 

- Sehr gutes Jahresgehalt, unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag.

- Dienstwagen (auch zur Privatnutzung)

- Direkter Einfluss auf die Realität in den Betrieben, ab Tag 1, mit einem Mentor aus dem Team in den ersten 6 Monaten.

- Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir sind im Wachstum. Wer hier gut ist, baut Strukturen mit und bekommt mehr Verantwortung; bis zur Leitung eines eigenen Teams.

- Betriebliche Weiterbildung, die du dir aussuchst: BSB-Lehrgang, BG-Fortbildungen, Umwelt- oder Gefahrstoffqualifikation bekommst du von uns.

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeit, Homeoffice, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Betriebsarzt, kostenloser Parkplatz, Mitarbeiter-Rabatte uvm.

So geht’s weiter 

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Danach folgen ein kurzes Telefonat, ein Fachgespräch per Video mit jemandem, der den Job selbst macht, ein Kennenlernen vor Ort und ein halber Tag bei einem Kunden.

Why this role matters 
In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. title: Senior Tax Analyst
description:
With millions of diners, 60,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job 

The Senior Tax Analyst will join a world-class finance operation to support the daily operations of our global tax function, promoting continuous improvement and high performance. In this role, you will complete critical domestic and international tax initiatives required to support dynamic growth and scale. We are seeking an exceptional teammate with a learning and growth mindset who challenges the status quo to improve processes. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment while driving impact through quantitative problem-solving and collaboration.

Responsibilities 

- Prepare global direct and indirect tax filings while collaborating with outside service providers on sales, use, business, and digital service taxes across various jurisdictions.

- Support the preparation of income tax provisions, including standard calculations, tax account roll-forward schedules, and return-to-provision analyses.

- Develop cross-department tax projections, model income tax scenarios, and conduct strategic research for business initiatives and compliance.

- Identify key areas of improvement throughout the tax compliance process to develop and execute actionable plans.

- Prepare monthly General Ledger account reconciliations and communicate required journal entries for direct and indirect tax accounts.

- Ensure indirect taxes are accurately collected by maintaining global product taxability and exemption certificates, while also supporting tax audits.

Minimum Qualifications 

- 3+ years of experience in Public Accounting or an in-house tax department.

- A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in tax, accounting, finance, economics, or a related field.

- Comprehensive understanding of global direct and indirect tax frameworks and regulations.

- Demonstrated ability to produce timely deliverables and manage shifting priorities in a dynamic environment.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to coordinate with various internal and external groups.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Proven track record of identifying process improvements and executing action plans with high attention to detail.

- Experience researching strategic tax opportunities, risks, and compliance projects.

- Highly analytical mindset with a strong affinity for quantitative problem-solving and financial modeling.

- Results-driven approach with a high level of integrity and professional standards.

Benefits and Perks 

- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

- Focus on mental health and well-being:

- Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

- Company-paid subscription to Headspace

- Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

- Paid parental leave

- 5 weeks paid vacation

- Time off for your birthday

- Paid volunteer time

- Focus on your career growth:

- Development Dollars

- Leadership development

- Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

- Travel Discounts

- Employee Resource Groups

- Private health & dental insurance

- Income protection and life assurance

- Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice

- Pension plan contributions

- Discounted gym membership

- Bike2Work

- Season ticket loan

- Social events & Thursday happy hours

- Free lunch 2 days per week

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Work Environment & Flexibility 

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion 

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

title: Account Executive, MidMarket (German)
description:
Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

As a MidMarket Account Executive, you’ll be at the forefront of growth. You’ll own both sides of your territory: winning new logos and growing a portfolio of existing customers to realize the full power of Fin. We’re building a world-class sales organization that is fast, ambitious and driven, and the road ahead is very exciting.

This is a seat at the center of the biggest shift selling has seen in decades. You’ll be selling AI agents to fast-growing businesses rethinking how their entire customer experience works, so the conversations are strategic, technical and interesting. You’ll also use AI every day to run your own territory, from qualification to research to how you run a deal. You won’t just talk about the technology, you’ll work with it.

At Fin, we do sales differently. We don’t just pitch; we partner. We’re asking customers to make Fin the heartbeat of their business. That takes salespeople who can think bigger, move faster and win with integrity. We invest deeply in every seller’s growth, and development is built into how we promote, learn and lead. In a high-velocity environment that rewards ownership, creativity and ambition, you’ll find room to stretch, influence and make your mark.

What will I be doing? 

- Lead the growth and adoption of Fin across your MidMarket territory, with both new prospects and existing customers

- Manage the full new business sales cycle, from prospecting to close, through a highly consultative approach

- Own and grow a portfolio of existing customers, driving expansion, retention, renewals and long-term loyalty

- Engage key buyer personas to uncover pain points, position AI-driven solutions and tie Fin directly to business impact

- Build data-backed territory and account plans that target new logos, upsell, cross-sell and multi-business-unit expansion

- Manage a high volume of deals, including complex six-figure opportunities across new and existing business

- Articulate Fin’s value and differentiation using Command of the Message and MEDDPICC. If these are new to you, you’ll be trained on them

- Run your business with discipline through QBRs, territory planning, and weekly and monthly forecasting across new business and renewal pipeline

- Track and communicate the metrics behind your growth, including retention, adoption and platform expansion

- Partner with Sales Leaders, Sales Engineers, Customer Success and the wider solutions team to win flagship logos and grow strategic accounts

- Bring the voice of the customer to R&D, Product and Marketing, turning real customer needs into product innovation and GTM alignment

- Stay at the cutting edge of AI using the best internal tooling and enablement in the market

- Raise the bar for the team by mentoring peers and sharing winning plays

What skills do I need? 

- 4+ years in a quota-carrying closing role selling SaaS or DBaaS, with a track record of meeting and exceeding quota

- Business-level fluency in German

- Experience winning new business and managing a book of existing customers through retention, renewals and expansion. Strong experience in one with a clear appetite for the other is also welcome

- Experience, passion and success in outbound prospecting

- Proven success navigating procurement, complex renewals and senior decision makers 

- Experience selling products with technical complexity or thorough implementation

- AI fluency or a deep interest in AI tooling, with the ability to turn technical capability into customer value

- Energized by working in a fast-moving, evolving organization across inbound, outbound and existing customer opportunities

Bonus skills & attributes 

- Experience selling AI-powered products

- Sharp written and verbal communication, adapted to senior stakeholders and technical teams alike

- A trusted-advisor mindset, building long-term partnerships across multiple levels of complex organizations

- Demonstrated leadership and influence within your team and across functions

- A growth mindset, intellectual curiosity and ambition

Unleash Your Potential 

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: VP Data Centres
description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD 

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY 

Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.

This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:
- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment
- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them
- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site
- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers
- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs
- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high
- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it

ABOUT YOU 

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential: 
- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role
- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale
- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure
- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors
- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms

Nice to Have: 
- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space
- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction
- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs
- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability

WHAT WE OFFER 

- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
- Employee wellbeing benefits
- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
- Private Medical Insurance
- Enhanced Pension Scheme
- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
- Clear career progression in a high-growth company
- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY 

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION 

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

title: Senior Engineer - IAM and Workplace Technology
description:
An Introduction to Primer 

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase > 

Read up on our $100m Series C 

Learn more about our culture > 

Which team will you be joining?

You'll join Tech as a Senior Engineer. Tech owns identity and access, IT and workplace technology for the whole company. Today it's a Workplace Tech engineer and an IAM engineer, and you'll be the most senior engineer on the team.

This is a hands-on role. You'll work the access and IT queue with the team, and you'll lead the technical work that shrinks it: the automation, the identity platform and the roadmap. As Primer grows and the team grows with it, there's room for the role to grow too, including into leading the team for the right person.

Tech is an enablement team. It sits alongside Security Engineering, not inside it, and owns the request queue and the tools that keep everyone at Primer productive. Primer is growing fast, and access requests are growing even faster. Our job is to make getting the right access quick, safe and mostly automatic, so people can get on with their work and our security engineers can get back to security.

What you'll be doing

- Work the IAM, IT and Workplace Tech queue alongside the team, and set the bar for turnaround and quality.

- Lead the technical roadmap for Tech and deliver it, starting with SCIM day-1 provisioning, Okta, automated access reviews and device enrolment.

- Automate the routine. Use identity tooling, scripting, workflow automation and AI to take repetitive access requests off people's plates.

- Run joiner, mover and leaver processes so new starters have what they need on day one and access is removed promptly when it should be.

- Keep access controls audit-ready. Work with Security and GRC on access reviews, least privilege and evidence for PCI DSS and SOC 2.

- Partner with Security Engineering on the calls that need them, such as privileged access and policy exceptions, and handle the rest within Tech.

- Mentor the other engineers on the team, review their work and share what you know.

- Track and report on how the queue is doing: volume, turnaround, and how much automation is taking off it.

What we're looking for

- Senior-level experience in IT, IAM or corporate engineering at a fast-growing tech company

- Hands-on with an identity provider (Okta preferred; Entra ID, Google Workspace or similar also welcome), including SSO, SCIM and lifecycle management

- A track record of automating manual IT and access work, with scripting, workflow tools or APIs

- Experience with SaaS administration and endpoint management (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Intune)

- Good judgement about access: you understand least privilege and know when something needs a security review

- Experience owning projects end to end and helping others on the team level up

- Clear, friendly written communication. Much of the job is helping colleagues across the business

Nice to have 

- Experience in fintech, payments or another regulated environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001)

- Experience running access reviews and providing audit evidence

- Using AI tools to speed up support and operations work

- Experience scaling an IT function through a period of fast headcount growth

You may not like it here if...

- You're looking for a management role. This is a hands-on senior engineering role.

- You'd rather follow an established playbook. A lot of this is being set up for the first time, and you'll be the one defining how it works.

- You prefer to fix requests one at a time rather than remove the reasons they come in. We measure success by how much of the queue disappears.

- Shifting priorities frustrate you. We're a growing company and the team's focus will change as we scale.

✅ A typical interview process

- An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

- An interview with the Hiring Manager

- Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

- A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer? 

We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

💰 Competitive share options

🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits ( depending on location) 

Don’t meet every single requirement?

title: Head of Community, EMEA
description:
About the Team 

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Community team focuses on finding exceptional power users of our tools and turning real usage into stories and signals that shape both product direction and how the world understands OpenAI. We do that by learning directly from users, then working together to package insights and use cases into formats that can travel: playbooks, webpages, launch assets, event series, and clear guidance on how people actually use our tools.

The Head of Community, EMEA,will lead OpenAI’s community presence across the region and be responsible for setting and evolving an evidence-based Community strategy in markets, including hiring local community leads and managers .

The role is responsible for how we create trusted relationships with power users and translate those relationships into participation, insight, enablement, and stories across the region. They will partner with senior leadership to recommend where Community can have the greatest impact across EMEA, laddering up to company and country level priorities.

- Publish regular updates and recaps that highlight progress, insights, risks and opportunities and clear recommendations.

- Work cross-functionally to route relevant learnings into product, research, brand and product marketing, education, communications,and global affair teams so that these stories and insights can benefit millions more around the world.

What success looks like: 

- Strong regional and market community team delivering effective community programs, including the Student Collective and emerging SMB and Pro subscriber initiatives. Clear recommendations on which communities and programs to scale, adapt, pause, or invest in, developed with country leads.

- A clear, evidence-based view of which EMEA communities and markets matter most now and next. A practical regional operating model that can scale across markets while preserving local relevance.

Our mission is to enable engineering velocity, quality, and efficiency at significant scale by removing friction from the day-to-day developer loop: spinning up a working environment, getting code building, and getting feedback fast, whether the "developer" is a human or an AI agent.

- Working knowledge of cloud networking, including securely and cost-effectively routing traffic across network boundaries (VPNs, service meshes, etc.)

- Experience integrating LLM/AI tooling into developer workflows - e.g. Claude Code - both locally, and remotely.

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence senior stakeholders and align multiple non-adjacent teams without formal authority over them.

- Experience building close working relationships with the engineering teams who consume your platform, not just the platform team itself.

- Experience in developer platforms or adjacent infrastructure: devcontainers, remote development, remote IDE backends, or developer workstation tooling.

À la suite d’un premier prototype ayant démontré la faisabilité d’une automatisation partielle sur données fictives, le stage vise à confronter les résultats à des données réelles, à qualifier les solutions d’IA et de RPA et à étudier les conditions d’intégration dans l’environnement existant, en tenant compte des exigences de sécurité et de fiabilité.

Évaluer la faisabilité et préparer l’industrialisation 

- Étudier les modalités d’intégration avec la plateforme Convergence et contribuer à la définition d’une architecture cible. 

- Prendre en compte les contraintes de sécurité, d’hébergement, de performance, de passage à l’échelle et de traçabilité.

Als führender Anbieter für Poker und Sportwetten in Frankreich – mit 350.000aktiven Pokerspielern und 600.000 Sportwettern monatlich – sind wir bereits in Spanienund Deutschland vertreten und bald auch in Italien und Portugal aktiv. Unser Anspruch: einaußergewöhnliches Spielerlebnis auf technischem, kreativem und qualitativemSpitzenniveau. Innovation, Zusammenhalt und Zugehörigkeit prägen unsere einzigartige,multikulturelle Unternehmenskultur. 

Und vielleicht liegt deine Zukunft im Gaming? 

STELLENBESCHREIBUNG 

Als Teil des Winamax-Kundenservice, dem Rückgrat der Zufriedenheit unserer Spieler, bist du dafür verantwortlich, ihre Anfragen und Nachrichten zu bearbeiten: Auskünfte, Kontoangelegenheiten, Reklamationen … 

Dein Ziel: das Spielerlebnis optimieren, ein besseres Verständnis unserer Poker- und Sportwettenangebote fördern und die Nutzung der bereitgestellten Systeme erleichtern. 

Deine Hauptaufgabe erstreckt sich über alle Kanäle, auf denen wir mit unseren Kunden kommunizieren: E-Mail, soziale Netzwerke, Online-Events und Live-Veranstaltungen. 

Du bist ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Markenwahrnehmung. Wenn ein Spieler mit dem Service und der Aufmerksamkeit, die er von Winamax erhält, zufrieden ist, dann ist das dein Verdienst - gemeinsam mit deinem Team im Kundenservice! 

GESUCHTES PROFIL 

Interesse an Poker, Sportwetten oder beidem! 

Außerdem bringst du mit: 

- Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (Muttersprache): einwandfreie schriftliche und mündliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit 

- Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Reaktionsfähigkeit und Sorgfalt 

- Sicherer Umgang mit Office-Tools 

Deine Erfolgsfaktoren für diese Position: 

- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung 

- Teamgeist 

Deine persönliche Situation erlaubt es dir, dauerhaft und zuverlässig im rotierendenSchichtsystem des Kundenservice zu arbeiten: 7–15 Uhr, 15–23 Uhr, 23–7 Uhr, inklusive mehrerer Wochenenddienste pro Monat. 

RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN 

- Ideale Einstiegsposition 

- Befristeter 12‑Monats‑Vertrag, Start asap 

- Arbeitsort: Paris (innerstädtisch) 

- Sofortige Verfügbarkeit erwünscht 

- 35‑Stunden‑Woche im Schichtsystem, inklusive Nacht- und Wochenenddiensten 

- Fixgehalt + motivierender variabler Anteil 

RECRUITING-PROZESS 

Ablauf: 

- Erstgespräch per Videocall (15–30 Minuten) 

- Schriftlicher Test (45 Minuten) 

- Persönliches Interview mit Alexis (Head of Customer Support) und Mathieu (Head of Quality Control) – 60 Minuten 

Wir bitten Sie darum, uns Ihren Lebenslauf auf Englisch zu schicken. 

Um eine optimale Candidate Experience sicherzustellen, dauern unsere Recruiting-Prozesse im Schnitt 2 bis 4 Wochen. 

WARUM UNS BEITRETEN? 

Neben unserer Welt aus Poker und Sportwetten bieten wir dir noch viele weitere Vorteile: 

- Eine einzigartige, multikulturelle Unternehmenskultur 

- Eine 4-Tage-Woche für den Großteil unserer Teams 

- Ein modernes, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld im Herzen von Paris (Rooftop mit Blick auf den Eiffelturm, Gaming-Raum, Fitnessstudio …) 

- Attraktive interne Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten 

- Ein lebendiges Unternehmensleben mit regelmäßig organisierten Events (Pokerturniere, Themenabende, Sommer-Barbecues …) 

- Gewinn- und Erfolgsbeteiligung 

- Zugang zu unserem Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter-Programm (Empfehlungsbonus von bis zu 5.000 €) 

- Betriebsrestaurant (oder Essenszuschuss) 

- Eine sehr gute betriebliche Krankenversicherung 

- 6 Wochen bezahlter Urlaub

title: Stage 2 Mois - 35H - Conseiller De Vente (H/F) - Galeries Lafayettes Nice
description:
LA MAISON 

Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. 

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. 

VOTRE RÔLE 

En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus. 

Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits. 

VOS MISSIONS 

· Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente. 

· Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour leur offrir une expérience exceptionnelle. 

· Découvrir et partager votre expertise sur nos produits auprès des clients. 

· Faire preuve de proactivité en suggérant des produits complémentaires. 

· Contribuer à la fidélisation de notre clientèle en développant des relations privilégiées. 

· Assurer la bonne tenue du point de vente en collaboration avec l’équipe. 

· Participer aux missions opérationnelles : Visual merchandising, réassort, gestion des stocks, SAV. 

· Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines. 

· Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence. 

PROFIL 

· Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de mode ou de management, avec une forte sensibilité pour l’univers de la mode et du luxe. 

· Première expérience en vente ou relation client appréciée. 

· Excellentes capacités de communication et sens du service client. 

· Enthousiaste, curieux(se) et doté(e) d’un esprit d’initiative. 

· Adaptable et proactif(ve), avec un fort esprit d’équipe. 

· Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, une troisième langue serait un plus. 

STAGE NON RÉMUNÉRÉ À POURVOIR A PARTIR DE NOVEMBRE

title: Data Quality Analyst - CDI - F/H/X
description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE 
- Au sein de l'équipe Stock data quality, en tant que Data Analyst et amélioration continue, vous serez en charge de monitorer quotidiennement les anomalies de data stock, de mener les actions palliatives, d’améliorer les outils de monitoring et d’identifier les anomalies récurrentes, de reporter votre activité à l’aide de KPI. Cette base permettra la mise en place des actions correctives identifiées au sein de l’équipe stock data quality en collaboration avec les équipes IT et business.

🎯 MISSIONS 
- 

Analyse : 

- Quotidiennement monitorer les outils en place pour s’assurer de la bonne propagation de la donnée stock.
- En cas d’alertes remontées par les outils de monitoring, analyser les origines des alertes.
- Créer des tickets auprès des équipes tech / business et suivre la résolution des tickets.
- Proposer des outils additionnels pour renforcer le monitoring ou alerting.
- Réaliser des compte-rendus journaliers ou bi-hebdomadaires des écarts constatés pour alimenter la réflexion sur des actions correctives plus long-terme.
- Construire les KPIs de suivi de la qualité, les diffuser

Amélioration continue et gestion de projets : 

- Participer à l’identification des actions correctives
- Cadrer le périmètre de ces actions
- Construire un plan projet prenant en compte les delivery IT, la redéfinition des process, la conduite du changement
- Définir des KPIs permettant de mesurer les gains attendus.
- Communiquer sur l’avancement du projet, remonter les alertes 

👉 PRÉ REQUIS 
- Bonne connaissance de Google Sheet / Excel pour la réalisation de TCD, graphiques,...
- Maitrise SQL 
- Anglais courant
- Rigueur et autonomie / curiosité
- Pensée analytique et bon esprit de synthèse
- Force de proposition
- Bonne communication écrit et oral et bon relationnel
- Gestion de projet 

👉 LE PETIT PLUS 
- Metabase (souhaité)
- Power BI Microstrategy (souhaité)
- Machine learning
- Maîtrise d’autres langages de programmation comme Python, R ou SAS.
- Visualisation des données

✅ AVANTAGES 
- 👉 Prime variable 
- 👉 Participation aux bénéfices et plan d'intéressement 
- 👉Télétravail possible jusqu'à 2 jours/semaine 
- 👉Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne 
- 👉Comité d’entreprise CE

❓ EN SAVOIR PLUS SUR L'ÉQUIPE 
- L’équipe Stock data quality a pour objectif de garantir la qualité de la donnée stock tout au du cycle de vie du stock : de sa création en entrepôt jusqu’à son exploitation dans les process aval : valorisation des stocks, inventory management,... et ce, pour l’ensemble des propriétés du stock: que ce soit la quantité, la propriété, l’âge du stock, la typologie des mouvements, …

title: Intern - Chief of Staff to the Group CMO - Paris
description:
Artefact is an AI-native company fusing engineering-grade delivery with strategic consulting to drive high-impact results. We specialize in accelerating end-to-end data and AI transformation, helping enterprises turn marketing into a predictable engine for business growth across the value chain. From strategy to implementation, Artefact delivers bespoke, scalable AI solutions tailored to our clients' core business challenges.

Headquartered in Paris, Artefact operates across 27 countries with a global team of over 2,500 employees, partnering with leading international brands across luxury, retail, FMCG, industry, healthcare, and finance.

To support our rapid expansion, we are looking for a Chief of Staff to the Group CMO (Intern) to join our Global Marketing team starting in January 2027 for a minimum of 6 months.

The Role 

Are you passionate about B2B marketing, tech innovation, and generative AI? Do you want to work in an environment where your contributions directly accelerate business growth?

As the Chief of Staff to the Group CMO (Intern) , you will play a central role in driving Artefact’s flagship initiative: "AI-Augmented Marketing" . This global project reshapes how our international marketing teams operate by embedding analytical rigor, agentic AI workflows, and operational excellence into everyday execution.

Working directly alongside the Group CMO, you will collaborate closely with regional marketing teams, data scientists, and business analysts worldwide. Fluency in English is essential, as you will lead international workshops, align stakeholders, and scale best practices across all Artefact entities.

What you will do 

- Strategic orchestration: Support the Group CMO in executing the global AI-Augmented Marketing roadmap across three core pillars :

- Analytics & strategy: Derive actionable insights from the marketing data platform to guide executive decision-making.

- Agentic content workflows: Automate content operations by building and deploying an AI skill/agent library using tools such as Gemini Enterprise, Claude, and Lovable.

- Global enablement: Scale adoption across international hubs by designing learning modules, documenting playbooks, and running hands-on training sessions in English.

- Go-to-market & revenue operations: Leverage AI tools and skills to optimize inbound and outbound funnels, drive pipeline velocity, and enhance Marketing-Sales alignment for sustained lead generation.

- Performance measurement & reporting: Build, maintain, and optimize full-funnel B2B performance dashboards (awareness, activation, ABM) to measure campaign ROI and surface continuous improvement opportunities.

- Operational excellence: Own and update cross-functional tracking tools, operational dashboards, and meeting cadences to maintain project momentum and organizational alignment.

- High-impact copywriting & editorial: Produce high-converting editorial assets (internal/external newsletters, landing pages, case studies, and thought leadership articles) while safeguarding brand tone and positioning.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications 

- Education: Master’s student from a top-tier Business School ( Grande École de Commerce ) or equivalent university program.

- Analytical mindset: Strong data-driven problem-solving abilities; comfortable working with analytics platforms, data modeling, and reporting frameworks.

- AI & Tech native: A genuine passion for emerging technologies, generative & agentic AI tools, and B2B growth marketing.

- Communication & copywriting: Bilingual or fluent in English (both written and spoken) with exceptional writing skills across long-form, web, and newsletter formats.

- Project management: High organizational agility, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Mindset: Proactive, autonomous, results-oriented, and excited to collaborate with cross-functional, international teams.

Additional Details 

- Start date: January 2027

- Duration: 6 months minimum

- Location: Paris Headquarters (with hybrid flexibility)

- Salary : 1200€

- Opportunity: High potential for conversion into a permanent contract (CDI) based on mutual fit and performance.

Artefact is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit solely based on merit and business needs, fostering an inclusive environment free from discrimination of any kind.

title: CDI - Manager AI Strategist - Paris
description:
Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables 
L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.

Et tout commence par vous.

Missions 

En tant qu’ AI Strategist Manager , vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions AI Strategy : vous les pilotez en autonomie, en garantissez la qualité, les délais et la rentabilité, faites grandir les consultants qui y sont staffés et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous définissez les processus cibles et la roadmap, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.

Activités & Responsabilités 

I. Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA 

Vous définissez la vision IA et la roadmap priorisée des cas d’usage, challengez la pertinence de l’IA et assumez les arbitrages. Lorsque c’est pertinent, vous conduisez des refontes de processus de bout en bout, en pensant lean avant de déployer l’IA et en mobilisant les équipes Engineering et AI Adoption pour les livrer. Vous concevez le modèle opératoire cible et sécurisez ses conditions de succès.

II. Analyses, business cases & prototypage 

Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse de la mission, business cases inclus, afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits, et vous revoyez le travail de l’équipe. Vous prototypez rapidement des cas d’usage pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.

III. Delivery, livrables & collaboration 

Vous dirigez les missions au quotidien en donnant de la visibilité aux sponsors clients : vous découpez chaque mission en streams, anticipez les risques et challengez le client lorsque c’est pertinent. Vous produisez en autonomie des livrables de niveau C-suite et des synthèses exécutives, structurez la storyline et veillez au respect des standards de qualité Artefact. Vous orchestrez les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.

IV. Relation client & développement commercial 

Vous êtes l’interlocuteur de confiance des directeurs métiers et des responsables de projets (Comex-1) : vous cartographiez les rapports de force entre les parties prenantes, animez les restitutions pour emporter l’adhésion et maximiser le NPS client, et gérez les tensions et escalades en préservant la confiance. Vous détectez de nouveaux besoins sur le terrain, construisez le plan de développement du compte avec le Directeur ou le Partner et déclenchez de manière proactive des propositions pour développer les comptes existants, en contribuant aux propositions commerciales et aux soutenances.

V. Équipe & connaissances 

Vous encadrez et faites grandir les consultants juniors et seniors, êtes counsellor de plusieurs collègues et participez au recrutement des futurs talents. Vous contribuez aussi à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des formations internes.

Profil recherché 
Vous vous reconnaissez si … vous aimez piloter des missions exigeantes de bout en bout, faire grandir une équipe et gagner la confiance de dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision.

- 5 à 8 ans d’expérience au sein d’un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, en management ou en transformation data / IA.

- Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.

- Une expérience de pilotage de missions complexes, de la vision aux résultats, avec des business cases qui résistent à l’examen d’un Comex.

- Une solide compréhension des enjeux opérationnels de l’IA (IA générative et agentique, gouvernance, cas d’usage métiers), avec la capacité de l’expliquer simplement à des dirigeants.

- Une expérience de pilotage de projets de refonte de processus métier, avec une maîtrise avérée de certains processus métier.

- Une expérience du développement commercial (propositions, développement de comptes, relation avec des décideurs de haut niveau).

- Une expérience d’encadrement d’une équipe de consultants, avec le goût de faire grandir, de déléguer et de tirer l’équipe vers le haut.

- Un état d’esprit de maker : aisance avec les outils technologiques actuels et capacité à prototyper rapidement des démos fonctionnelles (low-code, no-code, outils agentiques) qui rendent la valeur tangible pour le client.

- Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact 

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement couvre l’intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : AI Strategy (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opératoires), Engineering (industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et AI Adoption (conduite du changement, montée en compétences, usage quotidien de l’IA).

Pour en savoir plus sur Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

- De la stratégie à la réalisation 

Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.

- Une collaboration entre expertises 

Occuper un rôle à la croisée de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (Engineering) et de l'humain (AI Adoption).

- Piloter ce qui compte 

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

- Une trajectoire qui accélère 

Un parcours clair vers Senior Manager puis Directeur, dans un environnement d’apprentissage continu axé sur la transmission des connaissances et le pragmatisme technologique.

Processus de recrutement 

- Un entretien de fit RH (45') avec HR / Talent Acquisition

- Un business case AI-driven (60') avec un AI Strategist Senior Manager ou Directeur

- Un business case de prototypage IA hands-on (60') avec un AI Strategist Senior Manager ou Directeur

- Un jeu de rôle AI Strategist Manager (45'-60') avec un AI Strategist Directeur ou Partner

- Un entretien de fit final (30') avec un AI Strategist Partner ou Managing Partner

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + 10 000€ de variable, selon expérience et séniorité 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the role 

- Integrated Marketing France connects global marketing strategy with local business priorities to deliver impactful marketing campaigns.

- As Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing, you will identify France’s priority marketing moments and translate global direction into a clear, integrated marketing plan. Using business performance, consumer insights and knowledge of the French market, you will recommend what to prioritise, what to adopt from global campaigns and what to adapt to maximise local impact.

- You will bring teams together around clear priorities, challenge recommendations constructively, simplify complex topics and ensure marketing initiatives deliver against France’s business objectives.

Key Responsibilities 

1. Marketing Strategy & Planning 

- 

- Analyse business performance, consumer insights and market trends to recommend France’s priority marketing moments.

- Translate global marketing direction into an integrated France marketing plan, identifying what to adopt, adapt or challenge based on local business needs and market specificities.

- Develop clear, evidence-based recommendations on priorities and trade-offs, balancing expected impact, investment and available resources.

- Build a strong rationale for local adaptations and influence global stakeholders when the French market requires a different approach.

2. Campaign Orchestration & Stakeholder Management 

- 

- Lead campaign kick-offs and align local and global stakeholders around clear objectives, responsibilities and timelines.

- Challenge functional recommendations constructively, asking the right questions to ensure proposed media plans, creative concepts and campaign choices meet France’s objectives.

- Simplify complex, cross-functional topics, clarify dependencies and facilitate decisions to keep initiatives moving.

- Anticipate delivery risks, resolve coordination challenges and ensure campaigns are delivered on time and to the agreed brief.

3. Marketing Plan Consolidation & Executive Communication 

- Consolidate the France marketing plan into a clear, executive-level overview of key priorities, campaign choices, local adaptations and expected business impact.

- Write concise, insight-led strategic memos articulating the rationale behind France’s marketing recommendations, key trade-offs and decisions requiring alignment or approval.

- Build a compelling, evidence-based narrative connecting France’s business priorities and market specificities with global marketing strategy.

- Present and defend France’s marketing recommendations to global executives, ensuring local choices are understood and enabling informed decision-making.

Key Skills & Experience 

- 

- 5+ years of experience in integrated marketing, marketing strategy, campaign planning or marketing programme management.

- Strong business acumen, analytical thinking and the ability to translate data and consumer insights into actionable recommendations.

- Strong critical thinking and sound judgement: able to challenge assumptions, ask the right questions and assess whether proposed marketing choices support business objectives, without needing to be the technical expert in every discipline.

- Ability to balance global consistency with relevant local adaptation, using clear evidence and constructive influencing skills.

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and align teams without direct authority.

- Strong organisational skills, pragmatism and ownership, with a focus on prioritisation and delivery.

- Fluent in French and English, with the confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders in an international environment.

Success Measures 

- 

- A clear, business-led recommendation of France’s priority marketing moments.

- Relevant local adaptations of global campaigns, supported by clear rationale and market insights.

- Strong alignment across stakeholders on priorities, decisions and delivery.

- Campaigns delivered on time and against agreed objectives.

- Clear, actionable performance insights and executive visibility on the France marketing plan.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
description:
Health can’t wait . 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️ 

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies. 

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end : you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan .

About the Enterprise segment 

- Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

- Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

- Total Addressable Market: ~ 7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan 

- Diverse workforce : Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

- Critical challenges : Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

- Company profiles : Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

- HR priorities : Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

- Critical business characteristics : This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐ 

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine .

More precisely, you will:

- Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment .

- Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

- Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

- Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations , rigorous follow‑up , and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

- Be on the field with the team : prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

- Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals : strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

- Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range .

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐ 

You may be a great fit at Alan if you: 

- Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales , with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

- Have experience leading and coaching sales teams , with the ability to set a high bar , give clear direction , and help people grow 

- Have full working proficiency in French , and advanced level in English for internal communication

- Have a very hands‑on mentality : you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

- Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals 

- Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments , and can prioritize ruthlessly 

- Are data‑driven and analytical : you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

- Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

- Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area 

Nice-to-have: 

- Experience selling to HR or Finance 

.

🙌 Perks & Benefits 

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer: 

- Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. 

- Flexible Office . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

- All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

- Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.

- Delightful healthcare insurance . Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only. 

- Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits.

- Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

- Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. 

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply !

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

title: PreSales Engineer
description:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la conformité et à la gouvernance de l'IA.

Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles dans la structuration et le pilotage de leurs enjeux de conformité, avec une ambition : rendre des sujets complexes plus simples, accessibles et opérationnels.

Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement à l'international, nous renforçons notre organisation commerciale et recrutons notre PreSales Engineer pour accompagner nos opportunités stratégiques.

Ton rôle chez Dastra

À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes.

Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients. 

En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision.

Tes missions

- Qualifier les besoins techniques : conduire les phases de Technical Discovery , analyser les environnements IT des prospects et échanger avec leurs interlocuteurs techniques (DSI, RSSI, équipes IT), en complément de la qualification business réalisée par les Sales.

- Démontrer la valeur de Dastra : concevoir des environnements de démonstration personnalisés, construire des cas d'usage pertinents et animer des démonstrations adaptées aux enjeux métiers et techniques des clients.

- Piloter les Proof of Concept (POC) : définir les critères de succès, organiser les validations techniques et apporter les preuves concrètes de l'adéquation de notre solution aux besoins du client.

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.

- Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.

- Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !

title: VP of Product & Engineering - Back of House
description:
Help make the world more hospitable 

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role 

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

This role owns Product and Engineering for Back of House, one of the most complex, multi-service domains on the Mews platform. Back of House covers the operational core that hotel teams rely on every day, and it needs someone who can set the product direction and run the engineering behind it, together. That combined mandate, product and engineering under one person at VP level, is rare, and the scale of hospitality technology right now makes it worth doing well.

You'll own the full domain: strategy, roadmap, and the engineering org that builds it, working closely and collaboratively with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones, and reporting into senior leadership. This isn't a narrow platform mandate. It spans product and engineering together, with the scope to make real calls on both, and the trust to run it as one connected domain.

Back of House software has to stay reliable at all times and keep improving, without ever pausing customer delivery to get there. The next phase of this role is about applying AI directly to the systems that support hotel teams, not just internal tooling, at a scale most engineering leaders never get to work at.

What You Would Do 

- Own product and engineering strategy for Back of House end to end, across a genuinely multi-service architecture.

- Run globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones, building the structures that let them ship together.

- Build out a management team and develop senior ICs, growing a culture that holds up at scale.

- Improve reliability, performance and technical debt as ongoing disciplines, without stopping delivery to do it.

- Decide where AI genuinely belongs in the Back of House product, and ship AI-driven improvements that change how hotel teams work day to day.

AI Fluency Level 4: in this role that means going beyond using AI to move faster yourself. You'll decide where AI belongs in the Back of House product, understand the underlying models and infrastructure well enough to make real engineering calls about them, and have already shipped something where AI was a core part of the product, not a feature added on afterwards.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence. 

What You Would Bring 

- Combined Product and Engineering ownership at VP level, with clear, end-to-end ownership of a complex, multi-service product domain.

- A track record running globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.

- Experience operating inside a scaling SaaS business, ideally Series C through pre-IPO or recently public, as an operator rather than an adviser.

- Effective people leadership: managing managers, developing senior ICs, and building healthy team cultures at scale, plus a track record of improving reliability, performance and technical debt without stopping delivery.

- AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've shipped AI as a genuine part of a product, not just used it to speed up your own workflow.

Nice To Have 

- Hands-on experience in hospitality technology: PMS, POS, channel management, revenue management, or closely adjacent systems.

- Travel tech experience (airlines, GDS, travel management companies), or comparable operationally critical, high-availability B2B platforms.

- Founder or early-stage builder experience, having built products from zero to scale.

What’s in it for you?

Global benefits
