title: Head of Operations (m/f/d)
description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies and we work with SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.

The role

As Head of Operations, you make sure what we sell actually goes live, and that the company behind it runs without friction. Your job is to make our customers successful and to free up the founders, sales and engineering to do the work only they can do.

We are growing from a small founding team into a company that runs several enterprise rollouts at once, works with SAP consultancy partners, and is hiring across engineering, sales and product. That growth needs one person who owns how it all fits together.

You report directly to the founders and our diffrent department Heads. This is not an admin role. Half of it sits right next to the customer.

What you'll own

- Customer delivery and onboarding. From signature to live. You run the rollout plan with our Forward Deployed Engineers and solution architects: kick-off, access and security onboarding, milestones, steering meetings. You make sure every customer reaches value on time, and you spot the risk before it becomes an escalation.

- Commercial operations. Contracts, order forms, framework agreements, procurement and supplier onboarding at enterprise customers, invoicing and collections. You make the paper process predictable so deals close faster and cash comes in on time.

- Partner operations. We work with SAP consultancies and system integrators who use Qorelo in their own client projects. You set up and run how that works in practice: agreements, enablement, joint delivery, reporting.

- Finance and planning. Budget, burn and runway tracking, monthly reporting, board and investor material, together with our external tax advisor and accountants. You know the numbers and can explain them.

- People operations. Hiring process, onboarding, contracts, payroll setup, equity administration, tools. Every new joiner is productive in their first week.

- Systems and process. You decide what we build, what we buy and what we outsource, and you use AI to keep the team lean.

What you need

- 4+ years in operations, delivery or customer-facing project roles, with at least 2 years at a B2B software startup or scale-up.

- Hands-on experience running enterprise rollouts or implementations: you have taken software through enterprise IT, security, procurement and works council onboarding.

- Commercial and financial fluency: you can read a contract, build a budget, track runway and explain the numbers to a board.

- You build process only where it helps, and you are just as happy doing the work yourself as designing the system for it.

- You use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about what else they can automate.

- Business-fluent German and English. Most of our customers are in DACH.

You might be a fit if

- You have worked in or around the SAP ecosystem, at a consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor, and know how a transformation programme runs.

- You have been an early operations, chief of staff or COO hire at a startup and built the operating backbone from scratch.

- You have worked with partners or resellers and know what it takes to make a channel deliver.

- People call you when something has to get done and nobody owns it.

What we offer

- Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo is built. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

- Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior operations leaders in Berlin.

- The scope. You build the operating backbone of a company selling to Fortune 500 and DAX 40 customers.

- The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the founders.

- 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

title: PR Manager DE
description:
A fight lasts minutes. A great story travels much further. 

The comeback nobody saw coming. The rivalry that divides an arena. The person behind the fighter, with a story that deserves to reach people who have never watched MMA.

At OKTAGON, those stories are everywhere.

We’re building a sports brand with international ambitions, passionate fans and events that bring thousands of people together. Germany is a major part of that journey. And we’re looking for a PR Manager who knows how to make our stories matter to German media. 

Someone who can earn the trust of a sports editor, spot an angle for a business title and understand why a digital format might reach an audience a traditional press release never will.

You’ll help decide which stories we tell, who we tell them to and how far they go. 

Your stories need to travel beyond the cage.

Sports media will be your home ground. But your curiosity should take you further.

A fighter’s journey can belong in a mainstream interview. Our growth can start a business conversation. Training, personality and culture can open doors to fitness and lifestyle coverage.

You’ll find those opportunities and turn them into pitches that give each outlet a reason to care.

Here’s what you’ll take ownership of: 

- Build real relationships with German media. Develop and maintain a network across sports, digital and mainstream outlets. Get to know the journalists, their audiences and the stories they actually want.

- Earn coverage for OKTAGON, our events and our fighters. Create opportunities around upcoming fights and recognise stories that deserve attention outside the event calendar.

- Find new routes to our audience. Follow how the media landscape is changing, from digital publishers and podcasts to emerging editorial formats. Know where a story will work and adapt it accordingly.

- Create sharp German press materials. Write press releases, translate and localise event Media Info Cards, research fight cards and prepare tailored angles for individual outlets.

- Make interviews happen. Connect journalists with fighters, coordinate opportunities and prepare written interviews when needed.

- Get the right assets into the right hands. Distribute photos, video and relevant information, including captioned fight photography for dpa-picture alliance and Imago.

- Keep the foundations organised. Own accreditations, maintain the media database and keep fighter information accurate and up to date.

- Show what your work achieves. Monitor online and offline coverage, prepare monthly reports and summarise results after German events. Use what you learn to improve the next campaign.

- Keep our communication connected. Work closely with the PR lead, Marketing DE and Social Media so our messaging stays consistent, including across German-language video content.

When fight week starts, you’re in the middle of it.

The plans are ready. The journalists arrive. Interview requests change. A result creates a new headline.

You’ll be the person who keeps media operations moving. 

At German events, that means overseeing accreditations and the media room, coordinating interviews, supporting weigh-ins and press conferences, and making sure journalists have what they need before and after the fights. Where needed, you may also moderate a press conference.

You’ll handle post-fight releases, follow-ups and coverage reviews. During selected events outside Germany, you’ll be available for relevant German media requests and breaking stories.

And when a sensitive situation comes up, you’ll be the first point of contact for German media, working closely with the PR lead on the response.

This role includes travel and weekend work. Fight weeks can run from Thursday through Sunday, and you need to be comfortable with the pace and responsibility that come with live events.

What you bring into the team

You already know how a newsroom works. You understand deadlines, editorial judgement and the difference between a story we want to tell and a story someone will want to publish.

We’re looking for:

- At least 2–4 years of relevant experience in PR or sports journalism. You’ve pitched stories, worked with journalists and delivered under pressure.

- An existing network in German sports newsrooms. Relationships you can build on, alongside the initiative to open new doors.

- Native-level German and very good English. Your German writing is precise, natural and adaptable. You’re comfortable collaborating with an international team in English.

- Strong editorial instincts. You can spot an angle, ask the useful question and turn a complicated story into a clear pitch.

- Digital confidence. You understand how people discover and consume stories today and stay curious about what is changing.

- Independence and ownership. You can organise your work remotely, follow through on commitments and keep colleagues informed.

- Willingness to travel and work weekends. You want to be there when the action happens.

An interest in MMA or combat sports, experience with press conferences and crisis communication, and a driving licence are all advantages.

You don’t need to know every fighter’s record on day one. You do need the curiosity to learn the sport and understand the people in it.

Ready to tell the next story?

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and a few examples of your work: coverage you secured, a campaign you helped deliver or journalism you’re proud of.

Tell us what you contributed and why it worked. 

We’d also love to hear what interests you about bringing OKTAGON’s stories to German audiences.

Let’s talk.

title: Director Account Management / Client Service
description:
WongDoody creates human experiences! WongDoody schafft menschliche Erfahrungen in 24 Locations auf 4 Kontinenten. Wir glauben, dass die Zukunft gestaltbar ist. Indem wir menschliche Erfahrungen durch Kreativität und Technologie gestalten, arbeiten wir daran, eine Zukunft zu schaffen, an die wir glauben. 

Für uns beginnt dies mit unserer eigenen Kultur. Wir streben danach, ein integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder Mensch sein ganzes Wesen in die Arbeit einbringen kann. Unsere Kund:innen sind Marken, an die wir glauben, von globalen Großunternehmen über lokale Held:innen bis hin zu Start-ups, die wir lieben. Mit jedem unserer Partner:innen begeben wir uns auf eine Reise der Co-Creation, bei der wir die Grenzen des Möglichen ausloten und den Raum erforschen, in dem Kreativität und Technologie aufeinander treffen. 

Unser Team aus gut gelaunten, offenen, werteorientierten und kollaborativen Problemlöser:innen konzentriert sich bei allem, was wir tun auf ein Ziel: menschliche Erfahrungen. Menschliche Erfahrungen sind die Berührungspunkte, an denen Marken mit Kund:innen in Kontakt treten. Wir transformieren Unternehmen, indem wir mit Hilfe von Strategie, Kreativität, Daten und Technologie ansprechende, inspirierende Momente schaffen - unterstützt durch die globale technologische Stärke von Infosys. 

Große Marken. Viel Raum für Deine Ideen. 

Eine Maus, die die ganze Welt kennt. Ein Supermarkt, der Lebensmittel liebt. Und Kaffee, bei dem jede Woche eine neue Welt dazugehört. Klingelt’s? Genau für solche Marken entwickeln wir Ideen, Kampagnen und digitale Erlebnisse. 

Und unsere Kundenwelt geht noch weiter: von Skincare und Interior bis zu Automotive und Technologie, von B2C bis B2B. Unsere Themen: Social & Influencer Marketing, Campaigning & Content und MarTech Solutions. 

Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die mitdenken, eigene Ideen einbringen und Dinge bewegen wollen. Bei uns findest Du den Raum dafür – und ein Team, das Wissen teilt, sich gegenseitig den Rücken stärkt und gemeinsam mit Dir etwas aufbauen möchte. 

Unsere lokalen Benefits 

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Arbeitszeitkonto mit 100 % Überstundenausgleich 
- Arbeiten, von wo es Dir passt – im Homeoffice, in einem unserer Büros (Stuttgart, Berlin, Düsseldorf) oder sogar befristet im EU-Ausland 
- Kostenlose Snacks und Getränke in unseren Büros 
- Ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld mit moderner, technischer Ausstattung – MacBook, dienstliches iPhone sowie alle für deine Arbeit relevanten Tools 
- Weiterbildungsangebote, um stets up-to-date zu bleiben 
- 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr 
- Zuschuss beim Urban Sports Club 
- ﻿Mitarbeitervorteile & Rabatte über Corporate Benefits 
- Ein inspirierendes Team, mit welchem die Zusammenarbeit für starke Marken Spaß macht 
Das erwartet Dich 

Als Director Account Management gestaltest Du die Entwicklung unserer Kundenpartnerschaften und eines unserer Account Management Teams. Du verbindest strategischen Weitblick mit unternehmerischem Denken und einer Führung, die Menschen stärkt. Dabei bekommst Du den Freiraum, eigene Impulse zu setzen, Entscheidungen zu treffen und gemeinsam mit Deinem Team etwas aufzubauen. 

Strategische Verantwortung & Kundenberatung: 

- Du entwickelst eine klare Perspektive für Deine Accounts: Wo wollen unsere Kunden hin, welchen Beitrag können wir leisten und was braucht es dafür? 
- Du berätst auf Augenhöhe, stellst die richtigen Fragen und beziehst Position – auch, wenn eine andere Richtung mehr verspricht. 
- Du übersetzt Marken- und Geschäftsziele in passende Lösungen und verbindest dabei Social & Influencer, Campaigning & Content und MarTech Solutions. 
- Du erkennst neue Chancen, bringst die richtigen Expert zusammen und entwickelst aus ersten Impulsen konkrete Vorhaben mit Mehrwert. 
Kundenbeziehungen & Umsatzverantwortung: 

- Du baust belastbare Beziehungen zu Entscheider auf und entwickelst sie zu langfristigen Partnerschaften. 
- Du bleibst nah an Deinen Kunden, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und treibst die gemeinsame Entwicklung aktiv voran. 
- Du verantwortest Account-Planung, Umsatz, Profitabilität und Forecast und leitest daraus klare Prioritäten und Maßnahmen ab. 
- Du gestaltest Angebote und Vertragsverhandlungen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Kollegen und vertrittst dabei eine partnerschaftliche, wirtschaftlich tragfähige Zusammenarbeit. 
- Du entwickelst Wachstum aus bestehenden Beziehungen und bringst Deine Perspektive in New Business und Pitches ein. 
Qualität, Prozesse, Team & Optimierung: 

- Du führst Dein Account Management Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, gibst Orientierung und unterstützt jede Person dabei, sich weiterzuentwickeln. 
- Du überträgst Verantwortung bewusst, schaffst klare Entscheidungsspielräume und bist als Sparringspartner präsent, wenn Dein Team Dich braucht. 
- Du übernimmst die übergreifende Verantwortung für Deine Accounts – von der strategischen Entwicklung bis zur Qualität der Umsetzung. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team schaffst Du klare Prioritäten, behältst Ressourcen und Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere Zusagen gegenüber Kund einlösen. 
- Du bringst Strategie, Kreation, Social, Media, Data und Technologie zusammen und förderst eine Zusammenarbeit, in der unterschiedliche Perspektiven zu besseren Lösungen führen. 
- Du entwickelst Strukturen und Arbeitsweisen weiter, die dem Team den Alltag erleichtern und Raum für gute Beratung, kreative Ideen und Wachstum schaffen. 
Das bringst Du mit 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management oder Client Service einer Agentur oder eines vergleichbaren Dienstleistungsunternehmens sowie Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams. 
- Freude daran, Kundenpartnerschaften strategisch auszubauen und Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu gewinnen. 
- Unternehmerisches Denken und Erfahrung mit Umsatz, Profitabilität, Forecasts und Vertragsverhandlungen. 
- Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Markenführung, Social & Influencer Marketing, Kampagnen, Content und digitale Plattformen zusammenspielen. 
- Die Fähigkeit, Geschäftspotenziale von MarTech, Daten und Technologie gemeinsam mit unseren Expert in überzeugende Kundenlösungen zu übersetzen. 
- Einen Führungsstil, der Vertrauen schafft, klares Feedback ermöglicht und Menschen Verantwortung zutraut. 
- Den Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen, Prioritäten zu setzen und auch anspruchsvolle Gespräche konstruktiv zu führen. 
- Neugier auf neue Entwicklungen, KI und veränderte Arbeitsweisen – und Lust, sinnvolle Impulse gemeinsam auszuprobieren. 
- Ein souveränes Auftreten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich und überzeugend zu vermitteln – auf Deutsch und Englisch.

title: Senior Value Engineer - Growth & Scale Accounts
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Value Engineer (Scale team) 

The Team: The position of Senior Value Engineer (Scale team) is a trusted advisor responsible for driving value, adoption, and customer success across a portfolio of accounts. In this role, you will collaborate closely with customers, partners, and internal teams to strengthen customer engagement and ensure long-term success with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. Your responsibilities include building scalable engagement strategies, handling critical touchpoints, identifying expansion opportunities, and mitigating renewal risks, all while fostering a strong relationship with partners and driving value realization across your accounts. All while fostering strong partner relationships, customer self-sufficiency and driving consistent value realization across our entire customer base.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer (Scale team), you will play a key role in helping our customers achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value by leveraging the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. You will collaborate with regional partners and customers, strengthening their position in the market while ensuring that they receive the guidance and tools needed for long-term success. Your role will involve driving the coordination of account activities, building structured governance at both the account and portfolio levels, and fostering value-driven relationships. In this highly collaborative position, you will work closely with our partners, customers, and internal teams to provide innovative solutions, manage escalations, and ensure the delivery of value at scale. Through the integration of AI solutions into your daily operations you will drive highly efficient, scalable portfolio management.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops and manage stakeholder interactions in German. 

The role is based in Munich. 

The Work You’ll Do: 

- Drive value, adoption and sponsorship serving as the trusted advisor to customers and partners, ensuring successful adoption and value realization across a portfolio.

- Establish robust Centre of Excellence (CoEs) and coach customers to own their value journey and provide them with self-service offerings. Strategic Partner management orchestrating and coaching partners to deliver operational account work driving customer health. 1:N program management and scalable motions to generate impact across a community of customers (value bootcamps, 1:1 sprint motions, POV development, Value Sprints and new asset and innovation deployments). 

- Build stakeholder trust and drive success across a broad portfolio of stakeholders, maximizing your impact through highly efficient, scaled interactions rather than traditional, high-touch 1:1 relationships.

- Maintain cross-industry fluency to remain conversant across multiple business sectors, leveraging AI-curated industry briefs to accelerate rapid context-switching across a diverse book of accounts.

- Drive AI-orchestrated account plans which leverage platform best practices and partner applications within AI-powered solution designs.

- Utilize auto-generated programmatic content including targeted industry briefs and customer-specific presentations, to manage the portfolio efficiently.

- Work with AI-driven tools to monitor portfolio health using AI-driven tools to proactively surface renewal risks and health signals across all accounts in parallel.

- Operate AI agents to continuously track value realization, adoption signals, and expansion opportunities across the entire portfolio.

- Deploy automated value reports and strategic nudges that empower customers to drive their own business outcomes.

- Act as an AI-fluent operator , utilizing copilots and intelligent agents to produce necessary technical outputs on demand.

- Focus on the big-picture value while partnering with our internal technical teams (CoE and Applied Value Engineers) to tackle the highly complex builds.

The qualifications you need: 

- Experience: 3-5 years of strong programmatic execution and the ability to execute complex products efficiently. You will have worked on end to end post sales customer journeys and value realization for a portfolio of customers 

- Broad Industry & Domain expertise: Understanding of industry-specific business processes and a proven ability to identify opportunities for improvement, with the agility to context-switch and cross-pollinate best practices across industries.

- AI & Technical Fluency: High AI fluency, leveraging copilots and intelligent agents to accelerate workflows, craft business cases, and monitor portfolio health and drive high volume of activities. 

- Strong Stakeholder Management : Able to quickly build trust and inspire action across both technical users and C-level executives.

- Scaled Engagement: An experienced 1:N speaker with proven experience hosting high-energy webinars, leading cohort enablement, and driving community engagement. Passionate about empowering both customers and partners through training, support, and strategic insights.

- Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics, comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

- Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German. 

- The role is based in Munich. 

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day. Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one

Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions

- 
Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders

- 
Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst

- 
Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.

- 
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.

- 
Strong knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and experience with data warehousing platforms like Snowflake, Postgres, or Redshift.

- 
Comfortable designing and analysing end-to-end experiments, including A/B tests and feature flag rollouts, with a solid understanding of statistical validity.

- 
Ability to communicate complex data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong written and verbal English skills.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing 

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will… 

- Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions

- Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis

- Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs

- Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function

- Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants

- Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight

- Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences

- Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed

- Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams

- Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities

- Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network

- Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network

- Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota

- Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework

- Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Our humble expectations 

- Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment

- Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship

- Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments

- A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences

- Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation

- A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other

- Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function

- Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace

- Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams

- Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action

- Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership

- A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment

- Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors

- Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation

- Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities

- Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements

- A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence

- Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams

- Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Full-stack Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. 

At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. 

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Full Stack Engineer to join our Platform Team. In this role you build and own the internal software our engineers and production teams rely on every day: the applications that track what runs on every system we build, support our manufacturing and test processes, and turn operational data into better products. This is not a customer-facing web role: your users sit in the same building, and the tools you build directly determine how fast we can build, test and deliver. 

Your roadmap to make an impact 

- Design, build and own internal web applications end to end, covering frontend, backend, data model and deployment 

- Develop tooling that supports our manufacturing, where clarity and correctness in the user interface directly affect hardware outcomes 

- Build and maintain the configuration and traceability applications that connect our engineering, production and business systems into one coherent chain 

- Extend our ML and data tooling so that operational data flows reliably from the field into datasets, models and back into our systems 

- Integrate heterogeneous systems (PLM, ERP, version control, device fleet, data platform) through robust APIs and clean interfaces 

- Work directly with the engineers, operators and test teams who use your software, and translate their day-to-day problems into simple, durable solutions 

- Take ownership of the reliability of what you build, as these applications are part of our production and development critical path 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field 

- 4+ years of professional experience building and operating production web applications, with clear depth in at least one half of the stack and solid competence in the other 

- Strong backend engineering in a modern language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, TypeScript/Node or comparable. We care more about engineering strength than about prior exposure to a specific language, and expect strong engineers to pick up an unfamiliar stack quickly 

- Practical frontend experience with a component-based framework (React, Angular, Vue or similar) and the judgement to design an interface that people can use under time pressure 

- Sound relational data modelling and practical experience with relational databases 

- Confident with containerisation, version control workflows and CI/CD; able to deploy, monitor and debug your own services 

- Proven ownership of an internal tool or platform: gathering requirements from colleagues, scoping them realistically, and maintaining the result over time 

- A pragmatic engineer who builds robustly where correctness matters and deliberately simply everywhere else 

- Structured problem solver with a hands-on mindset and a bias toward shipping 

- Eager to work closely with a multidisciplinary team of software, hardware, production and flight test engineers 

- Fluent in English, German is beneficial 

Nice-to-Have 

- Experience with manufacturing, MES, PLM or ERP systems, or with software used on a production floor 

- Background in robotics, automotive, aerospace or other hardware-related engineering environments 

- Experience with data pipelines, data versioning or MLOps tooling 

- Working knowledge of container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code 

Why TYTAN? 

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security 

- Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale 

- Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors 

- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback 

- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact 

- Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company 

- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe 

Our Benefits 

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation 

- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit 

- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us 

- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team 

- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together 

- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands 

- Flexibility : Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration 

About us 

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all. 

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

title: Solution Architect (Prototyping)
description:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

We're looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to join our GovDev team. You are the technical counterpart to our customers in the public sector, defence and intelligence space: you run the technical dialogue with incoming leads, turn their requirements into
working prototypes on our platform, and hand what survives over to Product & Engineering in a state they can build on.

This is not a pre-sales or slideware role. Roughly half of your time you build: integrating customer data sources into our platform, wiring up pipelines on our data fabric (ODFF), and shipping demo-grade frontends. The other half you spend with customers and our product teams, making sure what we promise is what the platform can do, and what the platform can't do yet lands on the roadmap.

What you'll do

- Act as technical lead on incoming opportunities: run discovery calls, qualify technical fit against the platform's current state, answer architecture, integration and security
questions, and own the technical part of pitches, demos and workshops.

- Build prototypes yourself: ingest a customer's data (files, APIs, message exports, sensor feeds, geodata) through our ingest layer, model it into our universal record and
entity schema, and expose it in the platform frontend or a purpose-built demo UI.

- Design integration architectures for customer environments: on-premise and air-gapped Kubernetes deployments, identity (OIDC/Keycloak, Kerberos/Ranger), connections to legacy systems and interfaces common in government and military IT.

- Lead technical deep dives with customer architects and IT security: platform architecture, data flow, lineage, classification handling, deployment options.

- Hand over won opportunities to the owning Product & Engineering team: architecture decision records, integration docs, data model, open gaps, customer context. 

- Feed platform gaps and friction found during prototyping back to the product teams as concrete tickets and RFC input.

- Represent the voice of the market to Product: cluster recurring requirements across leads and bring them into roadmap and OKR discussions.

- Maintain reusable demo assets: reference prototypes, scenario data sets, architecture diagrams, integration guides, technical FAQ.

About you

- 5+ years in software or data engineering, of which at least 1-2 in a customer-facing technical role (like solution architect, forward deployed engineer, technical consultant with delivery responsibility).

- You write production-quality code today, in Python and TypeScript or a comparable combination, and can show prototypes or systems you built end to end.

- Hands-on experience with distributed data pipelines (Spark, Kafka or equivalent) and with integrating heterogeneous data sources: files, APIs, databases, message streams.

- Experience deploying and operating software on Kubernetes, including on-premise or restricted environments.

- Comfortable leading technical discussions with customer architects, IT security and executives, in German and in English (C1+).

- Willingness to travel up to 50% (national and international) 

- Authorization to work in Germany

What we offer

- Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.

- Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.

- Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.

- 30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.

- Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.

- Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.

- A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.

- Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.

- A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Large Enterprise
description:
About the Team 

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role 

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Munich/Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees 

In this role, you will: 

- Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

- Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

- Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

- Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

- Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

- Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

- Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

- Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

- Have a demonstrated track record of 5+ years of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. - Are fluent in both German and English

- Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

- Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

- Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

- Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

- Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

- Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

- Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

About us

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude 

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

title: Hands-on Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
description:
Location : 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification : Full-time

Pay Range : 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on :

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza: 

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

- You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

- We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

- We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

- One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

- Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

- 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

- 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

- 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

- 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

- 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

- Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

- Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

- Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

- Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out: 

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities 

- Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

- Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

- Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

- Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

- Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process 

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

- Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

- Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

- Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

- 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

- Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

- Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

- Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

- Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Strategy & Operations Analyst - Germany 🇩🇪
description:
Möchtest du den Alltag von Millionen Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern in Frankreich und Europa nachhaltig verbessern?

Arbeitest du gerne in einem vertrauensvollen und dynamischen Umfeld?

Dann könnte Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich sein und du die perfekte Ergänzung für unser Team 🙂

Unsere Vision 

Wir wollen das beliebteste Finanzbetriebssystem für europäische KMU werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern, den Zeitaufwand für Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu reduzieren. Gleichzeitig erhalten sie Zugang zu wichtigen Informationen, die ihnen helfen, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Steuerkanzleien. Mit Pennylane können sie manuelle und repetitive Aufgaben reduzieren und mehr Zeit darauf verwenden, ihre Mandantinnen und Mandanten zu beraten und zu begleiten.

Über uns 

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen Frankreichs. Derzeit beschleunigen wir unsere Expansion nach Deutschland 🇩🇪

In sechs Jahren haben wir Folgendes erreicht: 

💻 Wir haben uns als innovative Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerkanzleien etabliert.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro an Finanzierung eingeworben, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem bekannten Venture-Capital-Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal investiert hat.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von sieben Mitgründern zu einem Team von über 1.200 zufriedenen Mitarbeitenden gewachsen. Heute gelten wir als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in Frankreich und als attraktiver Arbeitgeber für Remote-Arbeit. Auf Glassdoor haben wir eine Bewertung von 4,6 von 5.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 vertretenen Nationalitäten geschaffen. Unsere Kultur ist stark auf Remote-Arbeit ausgerichtet, und bereits 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden arbeiten aus verschiedenen Ländern Europas.

🤝 Wir genießen das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kundinnen und Kunden sowie Steuerkanzleien und erhalten hervorragende Bewertungen .

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich.

Strategy & Operations bei Pennylane 

Teil des Strategy-&-Operations-Teams bei Pennylane zu sein bedeutet, die operativen Realitäten genau zu verstehen. Während wir unsere deutsche Gesellschaft aufbauen, entwickeln und implementieren wir effiziente und skalierbare Lösungen, die Pennylane dabei unterstützen, seine ambitionierten Expansionsziele zu erreichen.

Deine Rolle wird entscheidend dazu beitragen, lokale Abläufe von Grund auf zu strukturieren, bestehende Prozesse zu skalieren und unser Operating Model an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes anzupassen.

Um diesen Markteintritt erfolgreich zu gestalten, arbeiten unsere Strategy-&-Operations-Teams täglich eng mit den Business-Teams, beispielsweise in Sales und Customer Success, den Tech-Teams, darunter Entwicklerinnen, Entwickler und Product Managerinnen und Product Manager, sowie den Data-Teams, darunter Data Scientists und Data Analysts, zusammen.

Dein Ziel 

Du steigerst die Produktivität unserer Teams deutlich, indem du die Nutzung unserer Tools optimierst, Prozesse vereinfachst und operative Strukturen aufbaust, die den Aufbau und die Expansion unserer deutschen Gesellschaft unterstützen.

Dein täglicher Beitrag 

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bist die zentrale Ansprechperson und treibst Veränderungen in den Business-Teams für den deutschen Markt voran.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den operativen Verantwortlichen aus den Bereichen Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support und Account Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Transformation vorantreiben und den Status quo hinterfragen: Du beobachtest, hörst zu, stellst bestehende Strukturen infrage und schlägst kontinuierlich Optimierungen vor, um den Zeitaufwand für manuelle administrative Aufgaben und die Datensuche zu reduzieren. Du schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum in Deutschland, strukturierst die Abläufe einer neuen Gesellschaft und dokumentierst alle Prozessänderungen.

- Operative Verbesserungen umsetzen: Du setzt lösungsorientierte Initiativen durch die Einführung neuer Informationssysteme, die Anpassung bestehender Anwendungen oder organisatorische Veränderungen um. Dabei leitest du Projekte und nutzt das Know-how verschiedener Teams, darunter Data, Sales und Finance. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört außerdem, eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen, Zeitpläne einzuhalten und die relevanten KPIs der Implementierung zu überwachen.

- Prozesse skalieren und lokalisieren: Du passt globale operative Strukturen an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes an und stellst gleichzeitig sicher, dass sie mit den zentralen Pennylane-Standards übereinstimmen.

- Benchmarking und Innovation: Du beobachtest andere Abteilungen, trittst einen Schritt vom Tagesgeschäft zurück, führst Benchmarks durch und sammelst Erkenntnisse, um unsere operativen Strategien weiterzuentwickeln.

- Teams befähigen und die Akzeptanz neuer Lösungen fördern: Du etablierst klare Kommunikationswege und praxisnahe Unterstützung für die deutschen Teams, damit sie sich reibungslos in neue Methoden und Arbeitsweisen einfinden, beispielsweise durch optimierte Tools, Schulungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen. Du stellst sicher, dass Tools im Alltag genutzt und Prozesse eingehalten werden.

- Die Schnittstelle zwischen Operations und Unternehmensstrategie bilden: Du entwickelst ein übergreifendes Verständnis für die Herausforderungen des Unternehmens, um frühzeitig zu erkennen, wie sie sich auf unsere lokalen Aktivitäten in Deutschland auswirken. Mithilfe datenbasierter Erkenntnisse schaffst du mehr Transparenz über unsere operativen Abläufe.

Dein Profil 

Wir suchen eine ambitionierte Persönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfahrung in der organisatorischen Transformation, der Steigerung der Produktivität, im Projektmanagement und im Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Deine Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten 

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

- Du verfügst über mindestens vier Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Business-Transformation und in der Steigerung operativer Effizienz durch die Implementierung von Systemen und Tools.

- Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit Markteintritten, dem Aufbau neuer Gesellschaften oder der Skalierung operativer Strukturen gesammelt oder bringst eine starke Motivation für diese Themen mit.

- Du zeichnest dich durch natürliche Neugier und den Wunsch aus, einen echten Beitrag zu leisten. Du hörst aktiv zu und beobachtest genau.

- Du verfügst über Erfahrung im End-to-End-Projektmanagement. Du kannst Probleme schnell erfassen, zügig Lösungen umsetzen und iterativ arbeiten, ohne auf Perfektion zu warten.

- Du kannst zwischen detaillierten Einzelheiten und einer übergeordneten strategischen Perspektive wechseln.

- Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Geschäftsverständnis.

- Du besitzt sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zusammenfassen.

- Du interessierst dich für künstliche Intelligenz, No-Code-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung oder hast bereits Erfahrung in diesen Bereichen gesammelt.

- Du verfügst über starke analytische Fähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in SQL sind von Vorteil.

- Erfahrung mit SaaS-Geschäftsmodellen sowie Tools wie Salesforce und Intercom ist von Vorteil.

Was wir dir bieten 

🏢 Diese Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. Du arbeitest an einigen Tagen pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43-45.

💵 Wir bieten ein attraktives Vergütungspaket. Die Details besprechen wir im Laufe des Bewerbungsprozesses.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile und kannst so am Erfolg teilhaben, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Homeoffice sowie eine monatliche Pauschale für die Nutzung eines Coworking-Spaces, wann immer du möchtest.

⛹️ Über unseren Partner Gymlib erhältst du Zugang zu 8.000 Fitness- und Sporteinrichtungen in Europa sowie zu mehr als 300 Wellness- und Freizeitaktivitäten.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu , um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu verbessern.

💻 Du erhältst modernste Apple-Ausstattung.

🎉 Regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen: Wir legen großen Wert darauf, Zeit miteinander zu verbringen, zum Beispiel bei unseren vierteljährlich stattfindenden Tech Days, unserem jährlichen Company Seminar sowie bei Team-Treffen etwa einmal im Monat in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43-45.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

- Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager: 45-minütiges Videogespräch mit Alexandre, Chief of Staff Germany.

- Case Study:

- Finale Runde: Treffen mit dem Team vor Ort, gefolgt von einem 30-minütigen Videogespräch mit Eric Scaramozzino, VP Strategic Initiatives, und Tobias Janiesch, General Manager.

Wir arbeiten zügig. Der gesamte Bewerbungsprozess dauert in der Regel zwischen 15 und 25 Tagen. 

Wir haben versucht, dir so viele Informationen wie möglich über die Ziele, Aufgaben und das Umfeld dieser Position zu geben. Jetzt bist du an der Reihe: Zeig uns, ob du glaubst, dass diese Position dir die Möglichkeit bietet,

a) Spaß an deiner Arbeit zu haben und

b) einen wertvollen Beitrag zu unserem Unternehmen zu leisten.

Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Im schlimmsten Fall investierst du ein paar Minuten, im besten Fall ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten außerdem betonen, dass wir Vielfalt voll und ganz unterstützen und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und inklusives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen ein. Vielfalt macht Pennylane zu einem noch besseren und angenehmeren Arbeitsplatz.

Als konkretes Beispiel für unser Engagement haben wir kürzlich den Pacte Parité unterzeichnet, um in den kommenden Jahren konkrete Ziele für einen besseren und inklusiveren Arbeitsplatz zu setzen.

Pennylane fördert Vielfalt in all ihren Formen und setzt sich für ein inklusives, wertschätzendes und erfüllendes Arbeitsumfeld ein, sowohl in unseren Büros als auch im Rahmen der Remote-Arbeit. title: Customer Care Specialist - Spend - FinTech or Accounting Platform - German Speakers
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Join Perk as a key member of our Customer Care team for our Spend platform. Where you will play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional customer experiences. As a representative of Perk, you’ll help resolve a variety of inquiries, provide insightful support, and ensure every interaction contributes to our commitment to excellence.

Perk Spend is Perk’s spend-management platform, bringing employee expenses, supplier invoices and corporate card payments together in one place so finance teams can manage company spending alongside our Travel product

In this role, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams and learn our ever-evolving product suite, helping customers navigate their needs while upholding our values of transparency, empathy, and efficiency. 

What You’ll Do 

- Respond to customer queries via email and phone in a timely and knowledgeable manner

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues while providing accurate information and following up as needed

- Document interactions and escalate complex cases to the appropriate teams

- Ownership of incoming requests from customers, including the creation of tickets for the internal organization

- Ownership for tracking-to-resolution of recorded incidents or bugs

- Answering and handling customer inquiries for our customers for our German speaking clients.

- Internally, you’re the first point of contact for knowledge on the operational use of our software

What We’re Looking For

- Experience in FinTech, financial or accounting software companies is a must have

- Experience providing technical support and troubleshooting technical issues directly with customers

- A background working in finance and or accounting is a strong plus

- Operational experience with a high volume of external customer inquiries and internal clarifications from the team

- Experience working towards KPIs across multiply channels such as phone, email and chat

- Ability to handle a variety of tasks at a high frequency

- Structured and detail oriented approach to work

- Fluency in English and German , additional languages are a plus

What we offer 

- Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

- Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

- Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

- Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

- Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

- Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

- Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

- Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

- Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

- Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

- Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons

- Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

- Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview Process 

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Assessment + Team manager interview - In person in our Berlin office
Final interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
