You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment 

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development 

- Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues

- Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops

- Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis

- Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets

- Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues

- Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions

Amazon Connect Platform Engineering 

- Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing

- Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)

- Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management

- Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)

- Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting

- Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers

Full-Stack & Portal Engineering 

- Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)

- Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration

- Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements

Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality 

- Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances

- Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring 

- Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage

- Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

Collaboration & Practice Contribution 

- Work directly with customer engineering teams: pair on integrations, run technical working sessions, demo completed workstreams, and lead knowledge transfer so customers can operate what you build

- Contribute to architecture decisions within your workstream; evaluate native Connect capability before custom builds (“configuration over customization”), surface trade-offs to practice leads, and document decisions

- Perform code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and mentor junior and mid-level CX engineers through pairing and review feedback

- Contribute reusable assets back to the practice, shared CDK constructs, skills/plugins, demo environments, and internal tooling, so the next engagement starts further ahead

- Support pre-sales when needed: build proof-of-concept demos and provide implementation-grounded input on estimates and SOW technical scope

Your Qualifications 

- 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 2+ years building on Amazon Connect or comparable CCaaS platforms at enterprise scale

- Strong, current Amazon Connect skills: contact flows, routing, Cases and Tasks, Contact Lens, Customer Profiles, Streams API, and the Connect data/analytics stack

- Hands-on experience with conversational and generative AI, Amazon Lex plus LLM- based development (Amazon Bedrock, Q in Connect, or equivalent), including prompt engineering and tool calling

- Strong TypeScript/Node.js and Python; production React experience; solid AWS serverless engineering (Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Kinesis)

- Infrastructure as code proficiency with AWS CDK or Terraform, including multi- account deployment patterns

- Experience shipping and supporting production systems, testing discipline, observability instrumentation, and incident debugging across the full stack

- Clear communication with customer-facing composure, able to demo your work, explain trade-offs, and run working sessions with client engineers

Preferred Qualifications 

- AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML/Connect-relevant Specialty)

- Contact center migration experience (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, or Salesforce to Amazon Connect)

- Experience in regulated verticals: government/public sector (Section 508, FedRAMP), healthcare (HIPAA), or financial services

- Contact center operations fluency: WFM concepts (forecasting, scheduling, adherence), quality management, outbound compliance (TCPA), and CX KPIs (containment, AHT, CSAT, SLA/TAT)

- Experience with AI observability (trace correlation, token/cost attribution, latency profiling) or accessibility engineering (WCAG 2.1 AA, axe-core automation)

- Consulting or client-delivery background

Benefits

title: Software Engineer - Console
description:
About XBOW 

Build the future of offensive security with XBOW. Attackers are already using AI to move faster than defenders can react—we’re creating the platform that puts security ahead in the arms race. Our AI-powered system autonomously discovers, validates, and even exploits vulnerabilities, giving organizations proof-backed results in hours instead of weeks.

Founded by Oege de Moor, creator of GitHub Copilot, and backed by Sequoia, Altimeter, and other leading investors, XBOW is applying cutting-edge AI to one of the world’s most urgent problems. In just over a year, our AI, built by a world-class AI team and legendary security researchers — has uncovered thousands of real-world zero-days across the software billions rely on, and achieved the #1 ranking on HackerOne’s global leaderboard.

We’re a team of builders, hackers, and researchers who thrive on solving problems others think are impossible. If you want to push the boundaries of AI, reshape how security is done, and join the group defining this new era of defense — we’d love to talk.

Your Role 

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who’s passionate about building reliable and high quality products with robust backend systems. In this role, you’ll design and implement end-to-end features across the stack: from React-based frontends and TypeScript APIs to backend services in Kotlin and Go, all deployed on AWS.

You’ll be joining a small team of superstars that’s shipping quickly and operating with high trust. This is a role for someone who loves to own open-ended problems and figure things out—whether that’s designing seamless API contracts, optimizing database interactions, or building scalable systems that make powerful AI capabilities accessible. If you like being at the intersection of deep tech and real-world impact, you’ll feel right at home.

What You'll Do 

- 
Design and build full-stack systems that integrate frontend and backend seamlessly

- 
Develop scalable APIs and backend services in TypeScript, Kotlin, and Go

- 
Deploy and operate services in AWS and other cloud providers

- 
Own problems end-to-end—from design through deployment to production support

- 
Navigate ambiguity and help define how we build as much as what we build

- 
Collaborate closely with teammates across the stack, including AI researchers, Security researchers and backend engineers

Who You Are 

- 
Experience building and operating full-stack systems

- 
Proficiency with TypeScript

- 
Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST or GraphQL)

- 
Strong backend development experience (Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or similar languages)

- 
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with incomplete information

- 
A thoughtful communicator who values clarity and simplicity

- 
Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment

Bonus If You Have 

- 
Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or async workflows

- 
Experience building scrappy, iterative frontends where speed and feedback loops matter more than polish

- 
Familiarity with AWS or similar cloud platforms

- 
Comfort working with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform or CDK)

- 
A strong appreciation for user experience and design, even if you’re not a formal designer — you care about how features feel as much as how they work

- 
Comfortable prototyping quickly in React/TypeScript and turning ideas into working features fast

- 
Experience designing and optimizing relational databases (we use Postgres), and you know how to structure data for both performance and clarity.

- 
Background in systems programming, networking, or performance tuning

- 
Experience with hybrid deployments (cloud + on-prem) and know how to build resilient systems that handle the complexity of mixed environments.

- 
Experience working in an early stage startup

- 
Prior experience building security products or products for technical users

What We Offer 

- 
Compensation & Equity: Competitive salary and a generous equity package, making you a true owner of the company.

- 
Career Growth: Shape your role, lead the function, and grow with the company as we redefine cybersecurity.

- 
Meaningful Work: You will tackle technically complex challenges and play a pivotal role in the growth of our business, working alongside an amazing team and some of the world’s experts to shape how AI transforms cybersecurity.

What Else You Should Know 

- 
Location: Remote (all team members are remote but we meet regularly and you’re supported to travel to collaborate with colleagues in person)

- 
Contract: Full-time.

- 
Hiring Process: 

- 
45-min introductory chat with our Talent team.

- 
45 minutes with one of our Engineering Leads.

- 
2-3 hour technical deep dive around relevant case study.

- 
30-min final meeting with the Engineering Lead for the assigned team..

We aren't focused on seniority titles at XBOW—so if you’re worried about “leveling,” don’t be. We care a lot more about mission fit, capability, and impact than what’s on your LinkedIn headline.

We believe in people who are driven by curiosity and a willingness to learn. Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply if you're excited about the role and our mission.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique 

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact: 

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Core AI Squad, you'll design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform capabilities that power intelligent product experiences across Cloudbeds. This is a product engineering role focused on production AI systems, agentic workflows, evaluation, and observability - not an internal tooling role. You'll work primarily in Python while collaborating across our broader PHP and Java ecosystem, building systems where correctness, reliability, latency, cost, and model quality are core to the job. Your goal is to help Cloudbeds ship AI-powered customer experiences that are useful, trusted, scalable, and measurable.

Our Core AI Squad: 

The Core AI Squad owns the customer-facing AI platform infrastructure, agentic workflows, and evaluation and observability foundations that enable AI-powered experiences across Cloudbeds products. The team builds the production capabilities that let us evaluate models and providers for specific use cases, orchestrate tools and workflows, measure quality over time, and integrate AI safely into real customer journeys. You'll join a senior, product-minded group that values ownership, pragmatic architecture, fast learning, and strong collaboration across product, design, data, and engineering.

What You Bring to the Team: 

- Design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform services and product features primarily in Python, while integrating with PHP and Java systems as needed

- Build and evolve agentic harnesses, including agent runtimes, workflow orchestration, tool execution, state management, recovery paths, and evaluation hooks

- Integrate agents and LLM-powered workflows into production systems with strong attention to reliability, correctness, latency, scalability, and cost

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code and advocate for engineering best practices, test automation, maintainability, and operational excellence

- Comfort building, debugging, and operating services that interact with PostgreSQL, SQS, gRPC, and REST APIs, including data models, event streams, service contracts, and versioning

- Contribute as a senior individual contributor through technical leadership, architecture input, pair programming, code reviews, and mentorship

What Sets You Up for Success: 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production systems

- Strong proficiency with Python in production environments, including APIs, services, tests, debugging, and operational ownership

- Hands-on experience building, integrating, or evaluating agentic systems, agent harnesses, tool orchestration, or LLM-powered workflows

- Experience with agentic frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph, or similar platforms (PydanticAI, CrewAI, etc) 

- Experience with MCP, vector databases, retrieval patterns, RAG architectures, or AI evaluation platforms

- Comfortable working across a polyglot stack, especially contributing to or integrating with PHP and Java services when the product requires it

- Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerization such as Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, plus experience working with remote-first, globally distributed teams

- Experience with API-driven design, distributed systems, data modeling, and reliable service boundaries

- Strong knowledge of software best practices, design patterns, performance, security-minded development, and testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels

- Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, especially in complex systems with uncertain or probabilistic behavior

- Good product sense, customer empathy, strong communication, teamwork, ownership, and time management

- Business-level English fluency, verbal and written

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $140,000 and $180,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. ( The salary is only for US-based candidates).

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. title: Business Systems Engineer
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Job Summary

As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling.

You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Automation & Agent Development

- 
Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations.

- 
Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows.

- 
Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform.

- 
Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases.

- 
Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team.

Business Systems Integration & Architecture

- 
Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

- 
Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines.

- 
Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies.

- 
Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly.

Platform Development & Tooling

- 
Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead.

- 
Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively.

- 
Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented.

- 
Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement

- 
Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

- 
Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

- 
Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team.

- 
Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- 
Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.

- 
Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution.

- 
Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry.

- 
Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

- 
3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

- 
Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

title: Software Engineer, Data Integration
description:
Software Engineer, Data Integration

In Brief 

- 
We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

- 
Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives.

Who We Are 

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. 

What you’ll do 

You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform to generate real-time lifesaving clinical insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.

Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened.

Responsibilities 

- 
Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes.

- 
Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.

- 
Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.

- 
Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.

- 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort.

Minimum qualifications 

- 
BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

- 
3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred)

- 
Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources.

- 
Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment

- 
Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems

- 
Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.

Preferred qualifications 

- 
Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR.

- 
Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues

- 
Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.

- 
Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity

Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Tools & Al Enablement
description:
At Serve Robotics , we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. 

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are 

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW 

Build practical software that makes Robotics Operations more effective. We are looking for a proactive engineer with a product and entrepreneurial mindset: someone who discovers opportunities, anticipates pain points, and turns them into useful, reliable software. You will deliver improvements quickly and own the tools we rely on, including applications originally built with Al-assisted coding.

You will be an engineer embedded with Operations, taking initiative to understand how teams work and where software can make the biggest difference. You will observe workflows, ask questions, and use feedback and data to uncover unmet needs, including problems users have learned to work around. You will help shape what gets built, rather than wait for a fully defined task list. Think like a product owner and execute as an engineer. Connect everyday friction to the bigger picture: delivery quality, operator effectiveness, and the ability to scale. Choose focused improvements that create meaningful value, test assumptions early, and adapt as you learn. We value initiative, product judgment, and demonstrated impact over the length of an engineering résumé alone. Some solutions will start as lightweight prototypes or Al-generated applications. Your job is to bring the engineering judgment needed to make them dependable: understand the code, fix defects, improve the design where needed, add appropriate tests and monitoring, and support the application as operational needs and underlying systems change. You will personally build, ship, and maintain production code. Al-assisted development is encouraged, but you must be able to evaluate the output, debug it independently, and take responsibility for its behavior in production. You will work across several programming languages. Our primary system is Elixir-heavy. Previous Elixir experience is not required, but you should be ready to learn quickly and become productive developing and maintaining Elixir applications. You will also work with applications and services on Google Cloud Platform (GP). You will work cross-functionally with Operations, Product Engineering, and other technical teams to make sure local improvements work with the wider system. Build shared understanding, surface dependencies early, and drive decisions through completion. You will know when a small Operations tool is the right answer, when an existing solution can be reused, and when a problem requires a coordinated change to shared services or core product functionality.

JOB DUTIES 

- 
Discover needs before they become urgent. Proactively explore workflows with Operations, identify recurring friction and emerging failure points, and propose improvements before teams need to escalate a problem.

- 
Prioritize and deliver quick wins. Connect opportunities to operational goals, assess user impact, effort, and risk, and choose the smallest useful solution. Make clear recommendations about what to build, improve, reuse, or leave alone.

- 
Build iteratively with users. Deliver small, useful changes, gather feedback early, and refine solutions based on how people use them. Keep the scope focused while ensuring the result is safe and fit for its intended use.

- 
Own Operations applications. Maintain and improve internal tools, dashboards, automations, and integrations, including applications initially created through Al-assisted coding. Diagnose issues, resolve bugs, and keep tools working as dependencies and requirements evolve.

- 
Develop across our stack. Contribute in several languages, ramp up quickly on our Elixir-heavy core system, and build, deploy, troubleshoot, and support applications on Google Cloud Platform. &X. Metaview

- 
Bring engineering discipline to Al-built software. Review generated code, understand its dependencies and data access, address security and reliability gaps, and add tests, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable structure appropriate to the application's risk.

- 
Drive cross-functional execution. Align Operations and Engineering on needs, owners, dependencies, and tradeoffs. Anticipate the effects of API, schema, authentication, and platform changes on Operations tools. Bring recommendations to the teams that own shared systems, resolve blockers, and follow through on commitments rather than building fragile workarounds.

- 
Champion practical Al adoption. Help Operations identify useful Al-assisted workflows, evaluate tools, and develop safe, repeatable practices. Help colleagues understand where Al saves time and where human review and engineering ownership are essential.

- 
Stay accountable after launch. Support the software you ship, investigate failures, and verify that improvements reduce operational friction or improve delivery quality. Favor durable fixes over recurring manual intervention.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS 

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

- 
5+ years of professional experience, with substantial software engineering experience and ownership of shipped software. We prioritize what you have identified, built, and improved over tenure alone.

- 
Strong production coding capability. You can independently design, implement, test, debug, deploy, and maintain applications. You can understand and improve an unfamiliar codebase, including code generated with Al assistance.

- 
Google Cloud Platform experience. You have built, deployed, or supported applications and services on GCP and can troubleshoot their behavior in a cloud environment.

- 
Ability to learn and contribute across languages. You can become productive quickly in an unfamiliar stack. Prior Elixir experience is not required; learning it quickly and contributing to our Elixir-heavy system is an expectation of the role.

- 
Experience building useful applications, internal tools, automations, or integrations for business or operational users.

- 
A proactive, self-starting approach. You can find a worthwhile problem, investigate it independently, propose a path forward, and take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions.

- 
Product and entrepreneurial judgment. You understand user needs, challenge assumptions, balance speed with quality, and focus effort on solutions people will use. You can create clarity and momentum when the problem or solution is not yet well defined.

- 
Big-picture thinking. You connect a local workflow improvement to broader operational goals, recognize upstream and downstream effects, and avoid optimizing one tool at the expense of the wider system.

- 
Sound judgment about testing, code review, access controls, sensitive data, dependency management, observability, and production support.

- 
A practical, iterative approach: you can deliver a small improvement quickly without losing sight of reliability, maintainability, or user needs.

- 
Ability to work directly with non-engineering users, clarify ambiguous requests, explain tradeoffs, and turn feedback into working improvements.

- 
Cross-functional leadership through influence: you can bring operational and engineering perspectives together, explain tradeoffs, secure alignment, and keep work moving through release and adoption.

- 
Interest in Al-assisted development and workflow automation, paired with the ability to validate results and recognize limitations.

- 
Previous experience managing an operations team is not required. This role is centered on building and supporting software for Operations, rather than managing a program or coordinating other engineers' delivery.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

- 
Experience with operator-facing applications, workflow automation, dashboards, or fleet and robotics tools.

- 
Full-stack development experience, including user interfaces, services, APls, and data integrations.

- 
Previous experience developing applications in Elixir.

- 
Experience taking a prototype or lightly engineered application into dependable operational use.

- 
Effective use of Al coding assistants, with examples of reviewing, correcting, testing, and maintaining their output.

- 
Experience owning a product or internal tool from discovery through adoption and iteration, or building useful solutions in an entrepreneurial environment.

- 
Experience helping non-technical teams adopt Al tools responsibly.

- 
Robotics, autonomous vehicles, logistics, delivery, or other technology-enabled field operations experience.

What success looks like

- 
Operations receives useful improvements in short iterations, with feedback shaping subsequent work.

- 
Important needs and risks are surfaced early, with solutions initiated before they become urgent requests or recurring incidents.

- 
Tools are adopted and deliver measurable value, with low-value ideas changed or stopped based on evidence.

- 
Cross-functional partners have clear ownership and fewer surprises as tools and underlying systems evolve.

- 
High-value internal applications have clear technical ownership and dependable support.

- 
Al-built tools become easier to understand, test, change, and maintain.

- 
Changes to shared engineering systems cause fewer avoidable disruptions to Operations tools.

- 
Teams spend less time on repetitive work and recurring software issues.

- 
Al adoption produces practical benefits without compromising data handling, reliability, or engineering standards.

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Quality Platform
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers , including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. 

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. 

About the Role:

Remote (Toronto or Montreal) 

As a Senior Engineer on the Quality Platform team, you'll build the shared testing infrastructure, frameworks, and AI-assisted tooling that every engineering team at MaintainX relies on to ship quickly and confidently. Rather than owning testing for a single product area, you'll create the platform, developer experience, and automation that make high-quality software the default across the organization.

You'll partner closely with product engineering teams, Quality Advocates, and SRE to improve developer productivity, increase release confidence, and help shape the future of AI-powered testing at MaintainX.

What You'll Do:

- 
Build and evolve MaintainX's shared quality platform, test automation frameworks, and developer tooling.

- 
Design and develop AI-assisted test authoring infrastructure that significantly reduces test creation time while maintaining high quality.

- 
Own CI integration standards and improve build reliability across engineering teams.

- 
Design test harnesses for AI-powered product capabilities, including health checks, graceful degradation, quota monitoring, and adversarial testing.

- 
Identify and eliminate systemic test debt and flaky tests before they impact engineering teams.

- 
Build shared testing utilities and frameworks adopted across the engineering organization.

- 
Partner with Quality Advocates, product engineering teams, and SRE to continuously improve testing strategy and platform reliability.

- 
Evaluate emerging AI testing tools and drive adoption where they create measurable engineering impact.

About You: 

- 
Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience writing, debugging, and maintaining production application code.

- 
Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, or similar technologies.

- 
Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky or failing test suites.

- 
Experience building or maintaining shared developer tooling, testing infrastructure, or engineering platforms — comfort with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), containerized environments, and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) is a plus.

- 
Experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar to accelerate engineering workflows while applying sound engineering judgment.

- 
Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation through production support.

- 
Experience mentoring engineers and helping raise engineering quality across teams.

- 
Strong spoken and written English, as you'll collaborate daily with engineering leaders and managers across multiple teams and present technical priorities to executive stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

- 
Experience building test harnesses for AI-powered features, including health checks, circuit-breakers, adversarial testing, or resilience testing.

- 
Experience building or maintaining autonomous or agentic AI systems.

- 
Experience evaluating AI-powered developer tools and integrating them into engineering workflows.

- 
Experience building observability and quality metrics into testing platforms.

- 
Experience working with large-scale developer platforms supporting multiple engineering teams.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. 

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com . For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. 

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging . More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations , and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk .

title: Integrations Engineer
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique 

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact: 

Thailand is one of Cloudbeds’ largest and most important markets, and Thai hoteliers run on an integration stack most of the world never sees. Hundreds of our largest Thai properties depend on these connections every day, and when one breaks, a front desk agent stops being a host and servicing guests.

As our Integrations Developer in Thailand, you’ll be the engineer who makes that stack reliable. You’ll work hand in hand with our long-standing local integration partner, MecX Tech, and with Cloudbeds’ Integrations Product and Engineering teams, to diagnose and fix integration issues at the code level, harden the integrations our customers rely on most, and design and build new integrations for the Thai market.

This is a hands-on build role with a customer-facing edge. You’ll own the hardest technical escalations, ship the fixes, and then build the tooling, monitoring and documentation that stop the same problem from coming back. You’ll champion our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission by using AI-assisted development and automation to move fast, so more of your time goes to the problems that genuinely need an engineer.

Our Integrations Team 

Cloudbeds connects to hundreds of partners across payments, accounting, distribution, access control, guest experience and government reporting. Our Integrations Product and Engineering teams design those connections, our partners build on our Open API, and our Customer Success team makes sure hoteliers get the outcome they were promised. You’ll sit at the center of all three for the Thai market, with a direct line into how integrations are prioritized, built and supported across APAC.

What You Bring to the Team 

- Own the Thai Integration Stack Technically: Become the engineering subject matter expert on our Thailand integrations, starting with the MecX Tech portfolio: accounting (Carmen, FlowAccount), government guest reporting (TM30 / RR4), local payment gateways, door locks, ID and passport readers, and POS.

- Fix It at the Source: Investigate integration failures end to end, across Cloudbeds APIs and webhooks, partner services, logs and data, and ship code-level fixes rather than workarounds. Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Support and Onboarding on these integrations.

- Partner Engineering Liaison: Work day-to-day with MecX Tech and other Thai development partners as a technical peer: joint debugging, code and design reviews, shared issue logs, release coordination, and clear technical specs for partner-built work.

- Harden and Modernize: Help bring the most business-critical integrations onto Cloudbeds-managed infrastructure and source control, with proper deployment, logging, monitoring, and alerting, so issues are caught before a hotelier has to report them.

- Debug and Diagnose: Use your knowledge of C# to debug and diagnose issues within existing integrations, validate fixes with real customers, and build monitoring and tooling to keep things working smoothly.

- Build Support Tooling: Create the diagnostic tools, runbooks, and dashboards that let Support and Onboarding resolve common integration issues without escalating to you.

- Close the Loop with Product: Turn recurring field issues into well-evidenced bug reports, API improvement requests and product feedback. Advocate for the Thai market inside Cloudbeds.

- Document Everything: Keep technical documentation, architecture notes, and knowledge base content current in both English and Thai.

What Sets You Up for Success 

- Real Integration Engineering Depth: 4+ years building and supporting production integrations between third-party systems: REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON/XML payloads, data mapping, retries and error handling.

- Solid Backend Skills: Professional experience with C# and MySQL is a must. Python, JAVA, PHP, JS are a big plus. You must be comfortable reading and debugging code you didn’t write.

- Production Ownership: Experience with cloud hosting (AWS preferred), Git-based workflows, CI/CD, logging and monitoring. You’ve been on the hook for something that had to keep running.

- Show Strong AI Smarts: You use AI coding and debugging tools as part of how you work, pick up unfamiliar systems quickly, and look for ways to automate the repetitive.

- Hospitality: Experience with hotel technology, such as PMS, channel managers, payment gateways, POS, door locks or hotel accounting systems. Understanding night audit, revenue posting and how a hotel closes its day is a major plus.

- Thai Market Fluency: Native or business-fluent Thai plus strong professional English . You can debug with a Thai partner’s developers in the morning and write a clear technical design for a global engineering team in the afternoon.

- Works Independently: You are comfortable as the senior technical person in your time zone, set your own priorities, and know when and how to escalate.

- Clear Communicator: Able to explain technical root causes and trade-offs to engineers, product managers, support agents, and non-technical hotel staff alike.

- Inclusive Outlook: Comfortable working alongside people from diverse cultures and backgrounds across many time zones.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out 

- Direct experience with Carmen Software, FlowAccount, or another hotel back-office or accounting platform.

- Hands-on experience with TM30 / RR4 or other government guest reporting integrations.

- Experience integrating Thai or APAC payment gateways (for example, 2C2P, KBank, SCB, KTB, PromptPay).

- Experience with Windows-hosted services, desktop agents, or on-premises hardware integrations (door locks, ID readers, POS).

- Prior experience at or with a Thai hospitality technology partner, reseller, or system integrator.

- Experience with the Cloudbeds Open API or another PMS API.

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us 

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com 

Cloudbeds Awards :

Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)

Discover our Benefits:

PTO in accordance with local labor requirements

Fully Paid Parental Leave

- 
Home office stipend based on country of residency

Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion 

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location. Cloudbeds is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

title: Staff Backend Software Engineer
description:
About Notabene 

Notabene is on a mission to make crypto a part of the everyday economy. Leading crypto organizations use our tools to reduce transaction risk and make crypto transfers safe. Working across three continents in eight countries, the Notabene team serves our fantastic community of 100+ customers, including financial institutions, fintechs, exchanges, and more. Our co-founders spearheaded foundational Self Sovereign Identity protocols and use-cases. This technology is key to the internals of our cutting edge tech stack.

We’re proud to have the support of leading investors, including Y Combinator, Jump Capital, Castle Island, Green Visor Capital, and more.

We’re at an exhilarating moment in our journey, as regulation technologies (reg-techs) are fast becoming recognized as a vital enabler of the crypto ecosystem. Notabene is growing fast—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry!

The Impact You'll Have: 

Every crypto transfer we touch moves between institutions that run their own systems, answer to different regulators, and have no reason to trust each other. The software in the middle has to be right every time. A message processed twice, a lost update, or a record shown to the wrong tenant is a compliance failure for our customers.

You’ll work on the core platform that carries this data between institutions around the world, written in Go.

As a Staff Engineer on the team you’ll build the hardest parts of it, contribute to its design, and help the engineers around you do their best work.

What You'll Do 

- 
Design and build core parts of our transaction platform.

- 
Build for correctness under failure, with the isolation and auditability a regulated product needs.

- 
Scale the platform as transaction volume and the number of institutions per node grow, keeping latency predictable and the database healthy.

- 
Write design docs for what you build, and give sharp, useful reviews on other people’s designs and code.

- 
Build with AI agents every day, and help improve the specs, context and review practices that make agent-written code safe to ship in a regulated product.

- 
Work with product, compliance and customer-facing teams to turn regulatory and customer needs into working software.

- 
Own what you ship in production, from tracing and alerts to incident follow-ups.

- 
Mentor engineers on the team.

- 
Work on an on call rotation

Must Haves 

- 
Systems design depth. You’ve designed and owned distributed systems where correctness matters more than features. You know asynchronous processing well and can reason about what happens when parts of it fail.

- 
Strong Go, or deep production experience in another statically typed backend language (Java, Kotlin, Rust, C#) and the appetite to be shipping Go within your first weeks.

- 
PostgreSQL in depth: schema design, query plans, locking and isolation levels, migrations on live systems, and multi-tenant data.

- 
End-to-end ownership in the cloud. Working knowledge of AWS or GCP: IAM, networking, managed databases, queues and storage. You can read and change Terraform and debug production from traces and logs.

- 
AI-native engineering. You use coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and can show how. You write the specs and context, break work down for them, and review their output as hard as a human pull request. You know where they fail.

- 
Staff-level experience. A track record of delivering large, technically hard projects end to end and helping the engineers around you get better. Typically 8+ years building backend systems.

- 
Clear, concise writing in a remote company that makes decisions in documents and async threads.

- 
Security fundamentals for sensitive data: encryption in transit and at rest, key handling, minimising personal data, and least-privilege access.

Nice-to-Haves 

- 
Applied cryptography: encryption, signing and key management.

- 
Decentralized identity: DIDs, verifiable credentials, DIDComm.

- 
Regulated finance, payments or compliance: Travel Rule, AML, ISO 20022.

Building and running software under SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls.

- 
Crypto and blockchain knowledge: chains, addresses, assets, CAIP identifiers.

Node.js and TypeScript.

Queue and workflow systems, and modern observability tooling.

Benefits

Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

title: Senior Software Engineer - OpenCRQ
description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. 

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is curious about the modeling problem underneath cyber risk and wants to help shape a young product.

You will join OpenCRQ as its fourth engineer and work across the data model, backend and product surface. Many foundations are still being defined, giving you meaningful influence beyond the features you directly own.

You will shape these decisions with the squad and experienced engineering and product leaders across Filigran. We value constructive disagreement, clear reasoning and shared outcomes, and we expect everyone to ask for context, challenge assumptions and learn from one another.

🧩 The problem you would be working on

Ask a CISO what a cyber risk could cost, and the answer often still begins with a color: red, amber or green, often produced by a spreadsheet disconnected from current evidence.

OpenCRQ replaces that color with a financial estimate and a traceable chain of evidence: which threat actors are active, which assets they can reach, which controls have proven effective and what the remaining exposure could cost.

Every step is computed from live data and must withstand a simple question from a board: “Where does that figure come from?” That is what makes this an engineering problem rather than a reporting one.

OpenCRQ is Filigran’s cyber risk quantification product. It combines threat intelligence from OpenCTI, exposure and control validation from OpenAEV, and agentic workflows through XTM One. As these products become more connected, the squad will define what agents can ask of the risk model, which evidence they can use and how their answers remain safe and explainable.

🛠️ What you would work on

- 
End-to-end product ownership. Take product problems from early ideation and technical design through implementation, end-to-end testing and validation with users. You will have the autonomy to drive the work, while using the squad to challenge assumptions and improve the outcome.

- 
The quantification engine. Turn threat frequency, control effectiveness and asset value into probabilistic loss distributions. Build general-purpose quantitative models that can evolve as assumptions and available evidence change, without losing reproducibility or explainability.

- 
The correlation layer. Model complex relationships across OpenCRQ, OpenCTI, OpenAEV and customer systems. Map threat intelligence, including intrusion sets, techniques, campaigns and observations, to assets, vulnerabilities, exposures and control coverage. This includes adapting OpenCRQ to open standards and schemas such as STIX and OCSF, without coupling the product to a single representation.

- 
Reliable ingestion at scale. Process hundreds of thousands of findings per tenant through delta syncs, long-running backfills and feeds with imperfect timestamps. You will help design observable, recoverable pipelines while extending tenant isolation as the domain grows.

- 
The agentic surface. Design the contracts used by XTM One agents and the plain-language explanations behind risk figures. Together, the squad will define what models can safely do in a product whose outputs inform board-level decisions.

🏆 What success could look like

Priorities will evolve with the product, but within your first 6 to 12 months you could have:

- 
Taken a meaningful product problem from early ideation through implementation, end-to-end testing and validation with users.

- 
Shaped a core part of OpenCRQ’s interconnected data model or quantification engine and documented the trade-offs behind it.

- 
Made a major ingestion or calculation path more observable, recoverable and reproducible.

- 
Defined or implemented a durable contract between OpenCRQ and another Filigran product or an open standard, without making the internal model brittle.

- 
Helped ship risk results that users can trace back to the evidence that produced them.

- 
Contributed to the open-source release and to engineering practices the growing squad can build on.

🌐 Open source, like the rest of Filigran

OpenCRQ is about to become Open source, alongside OpenCTI and OpenAEV. You will contribute visibly to a product whose risk calculations can be inspected, challenged and improved by the organizations running it.

👥 The squad

You will join two senior engineers and a staff engineer, reporting to OpenCRQ’s Engineering Manager. The squad is small enough for you to influence its direction, without working in isolation.

You will collaborate with the VP of Technology, CTO and Principal Engineers on technical standards, and with the OpenCTI, OpenAEV and XTM One teams on cross-product contracts and integrations. These relationships bring domain knowledge and broader technical context into the squad’s decisions as it grows.

✨ What will help you succeed

We do not expect you to arrive with expertise in cyber risk or every standard named below. We are looking for a strong software engineer who can learn quickly, work autonomously and use the squad to challenge and improve decisions.

- 
A track record of taking complex product problems from an ambiguous idea to a validated outcome: framing the problem, making technical decisions, implementing the solution, testing it end to end and checking that it solves the user’s need.

- 
Strong experience with a modern TypeScript stack and practical knowledge of PostgreSQL beyond the ORM. You treat failure modes and observability as part of the design.

- 
The ability to reason about complex relationships across systems and design interconnected data models that remain coherent as concepts and integrations evolve.

- 
Comfort turning quantitative concepts into maintainable software. Formal training in statistics is not required, but you should be willing to work with probability distributions, orders of magnitude and models whose assumptions evolve over time.

- 
Thoughtful use of coding agents: you know where they accelerate engineering and where their output needs careful verification.

- 
Fluent English is required. 

💡 Useful, but not required

Any of the following would help, but none is expected:

- 
Experience in cybersecurity, GRC or risk quantification.

- 
Familiarity with STIX/TAXII, OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK or other open cybersecurity standards and frameworks.

- 
Experience shipping features involving LLM agents, RAG or MCP.

⚙️ The stack

TypeScript end to end: React, Vite and TanStack Router on the frontend; Node.js, Fastify and tRPC on the backend; PostgreSQL with a code-first schema and Drizzle, all in one monorepo.

OpenCRQ ships as a container, both as SaaS and on customer-managed infrastructure. We use OpenTelemetry for traces, metrics and logs, alongside Prometheus and continuous profiling.

A significant part of the design work happens at the boundaries between OpenCRQ, the rest of Filigran’s product suite and customer security tooling. You will work directly with the teams that own those systems rather than having to navigate those boundaries alone.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. 

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger 

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next 

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders 

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE 

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect 

- 
Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

- 
Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

- 
25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

- 
Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

- 
Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

- 
Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity 

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture. 

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us? 

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

title: Senior AI Developer
description:
At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

We're looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our ClickUp Engineering team, with a focus on AI evaluations . You'll own how we measure and improve the quality of ClickUp's AI: building the eval systems that tell us how well our AI is performing, the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals. You'll work on backend systems that make AI-powered capabilities scalable, reliable, and secure, while working hands-on with LLMs to solve real user problems and drive product innovation.

Key Responsibilities: 

- 
Design, build, and own ClickUp's AI evaluation system , including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and automated scorers, regression detection, and quality tracking across AI features.

- 
Build and evolve the core agent harness , and the AI that performs well on those evals, partnering closely with product and engineering to define what "great" looks like.

- 
Build self-improvement loops where agents modify other agents or prompts, rerun evals, and iterate automatically.

- 
Benchmark new models as they're released and own model selection, routing, and fallback strategies across providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-weight), balancing quality, latency, and cost.

- 
Architect, design, and implement scalable AI platform services that support the deployment, orchestration, and lifecycle management of LLMs and other AI models.

- 
Build and maintain robust APIs and backend systems that integrate AI-powered features into ClickUp's core platform.

- 
Develop infrastructure for model serving, monitoring, logging, and automated evaluation to ensure high reliability and performance of AI services in production.

- 
Drive best practices in AI privacy, security, and compliance, including data anonymization, secure data handling, and regulatory adherence.

- 
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, frontend, and data teams to deliver seamless, reliable, and user-centric AI experiences.

Qualifications: 

- 
5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or ML systems.

- 
Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation systems in production (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, judge calibration, offline and online evals), tied to real product quality.

- 
Strong experiment design and statistical rigor, including A/B testing, offline vs. online metrics, and separating real regressions from noisy or variable results.

- 
Proven track record of applying LLMs and AI models to real-world, customer-facing product features.

- 
Proven experience integrating and managing multiple LLMs, including benchmarking, routing, and cost/latency/quality tradeoffs.

- 
Deep expertise in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure).

- 
Strong programming skills in Python (preferred), Go, TypeScript, or similar languages used for backend and AI platform development.

- 
Proficiency in orchestration frameworks and workflow engines (e.g., LangGraph, Airflow, Ray, or similar).

- 
Familiarity with search and retrieval technologies and their integration into AI-driven applications.

- 
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of working effectively in cross-functional teams.

- 
Passion for staying at the forefront of AI and applying new technologies to solve real-world problems at scale.

Nice to Have: 

- 
Background in data science, applied science, or machine learning engineering.

- 
Experience with eval tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Weave, Arize, or in-house frameworks).

- 
Experience with model routing, AI gateways, or inference optimization.
