title: Developer - Web Development & UX
description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined. 

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans , so please apply for only one position and only once a year —if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans , we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers , don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Developer – Web Development & UX, you will join an award-winning creative, marketing, and advertising agency supporting a diverse portfolio of multi-industry client accounts across digital experiences, print, web, email, and analytics.Operating across varied technical environments, you will serve as the hands-on technical engine delivering everything from new custom website builds, landing pages, and campaign microsites to responsive HTML email templates and marketing automation integrations.

This is not a visual page-builder or no-code role. You will step into a dynamic agency setting requiring genuine computer science fundamentals, strong legacy code comprehension, and sharp troubleshooting skills. You will take ownership of maintaining and modernizing inherited codebases—including sites built over a decade ago—while collaborating with creative and design teams to ensure that technical execution reflects high standards of usability, responsive architecture,and user experience.

Accountability 

As a Developer – Web Development & UX, your success will be defined by your ability to reliably engineer, launch,maintain, and troubleshoot performant, responsive digital solutions across diverse client technical stacks and CMS platforms. 

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Website Development, CMS Architecture & New Builds

- Translate approved creative concepts, business requirements, and design specifications into clean, responsive, and maintainable web pages and websites.

- Build custom landing pages, campaign-specific microsites, and reusable component architectures across varied project scopes.

- Architect and maintain custom WordPress implementations using custom themes, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF),and Gutenberg blocks, while supporting existing page-builder instances (Divi, Elementor).

- Develop, configure, and maintain Drupal content structures, custom content types, taxonomy fields, and core modules.

- Support HubSpot CMS development, including custom landing pages, interactive forms, and marketing automation components.

- Execute pre-deployment testing, cross-browser validation, and responsive device testing to ensure launch readiness and seamless post-launch fixes.

Legacy Codebase Maintenance, Debugging & Troubleshooting

- Review, understand, and debug complex, unfamiliar inherited client codebases and legacy systems dating back over ten years.

- Investigate broken functionality, technical defects, layout regressions, and CMS-related conflicts without destabilizing existing features.

- Implement targeted patches, updates, and architectural refactors while preserving full backward compatibility with older hosting and software environments.

- Support ongoing site maintenance schedules, security updates, and plugin/module upgrades across an extensive multi-client roster.

- Maintain rigorous documentation around legacy system quirks, architectural dependencies, and technical remediation steps.

HTML Email Development & Campaign Integrations

- Code responsive, cross-client HTML email templates built from scratch to render consistently across major desktop and mobile email clients.

- Develop, test, and maintain email assets across specialized platforms including Stripo, Mailchimp, Constant Contact,and HubSpot Email.

- Troubleshoot rendering anomalies, client-specific CSS quirks, and formatting issues inherent to email platforms.

- Implement dynamic content, forms, and tracking mechanisms aligned with campaign requirements.

API Connections, Enterprise Coordination & UX Collaboration

- Connect websites and digital properties to external systems, CRMs, and third-party web services via REST APIs.

- Troubleshoot data flows, form endpoints, and webhook connections, documenting integration behavior and data mapping.

- Interface with external implementation partners and support scoping, dependencies, and technical oversight for enterprise platforms (including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CRM, Adobe Experience Manager, and TYPO3).

- Partner with UI/UX designers and creative leads during project scoping to evaluate technical feasibility, identify potential usability roadblocks, and advocate for practical UX, intuitive navigation, and accessibility standards.

Multi-Client Technical Operations & Quality Assurance

- Manage multiple concurrent development tasks and shifting deadlines across distinct client environments with high autonomy.

- Conduct comprehensive end-to-end QA, functional testing, form validation, and performance audits to optimize page load speeds and responsiveness.

- Coordinate clear, structured technical handoffs and status tracking across project management tools to ensure operational continuity.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Chief Operating Officer and the Technical Director overseeing developer and studio operations, while coordinating closely with the Technical Requirements Lead to align on platform priorities and architecture. On a day-to-day basis, you will collaborate with cross-functional agency teams—including UI/UX designers,production artists, copywriters, project managers, and data analysts—while liaising with external platform specialists.

At Oceans , you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans , we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Developer – Web Development & UX, your vertical strength will be foundational web development and legacy CMS architecture, while your horizontal capabilities should span practical UX design collaboration, cross-platform technical troubleshooting, and multi-client project delivery.

To excel in this role, you should have:

- 
Foundational Experience : 4+ years of hands-on web development experience, demonstrating deep proficiency with HTML5, CSS3/SASS, JavaScript, and modern responsive design principles. Experience within an agency or multi-client setting is strongly preferred.

- 
Legacy Code & CMS Mastery: Demonstrated experience understanding, modifying, and debugging inherited or legacy codebases without documentation. Strong hands-on development expertise in WordPress (custom themes,ACF, Gutenberg) and practical exposure to Drupal.

- 
Email & Landing Page Platforms: Proven ability to hand-code responsive HTML emails across Stripo, Mailchimp,Constant Contact, and HubSpot, understanding platform-specific email client constraints.

- 
Systems, APIs & Integrations: Practical experience integrating third-party APIs, troubleshooting data connections,and managing forms across CMS and CRM ecosystems.

- 
Tooling & Workflow: Familiarity with collaborative tools and project management systems such as Microsoft Teams, Notion, Workfront, or Wrike, paired with structured version control workflows.

- 
Mindset & Problem-Solving: High autonomy, intellectual curiosity, patience when diagnosing obscure technical defects, and strong communication skills to explain technical realities to non-technical partners. Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools as an accelerator while maintaining complete independent ownership over code validity and debugging.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

- 
Legacy Code Debugging & Problem-Solving: How do you approach navigating, diagnosing, and fixing broken functionality in an undocumented codebase built over a decade ago?

- 
CMS Architecture & Custom Development: What is your methodology for building custom, maintainable WordPress themes and Drupal configurations beyond pre-built page builders?

- 
HTML Email Engineering: How do you handle cross-client rendering constraints, responsive styling, and fallback logic across varied email platforms?

- 
UX & Design Alignment: How do you collaborate with creative designers during scoping to balance visual ambition with technical feasibility, accessibility, and intuitive usability?

- 
Multi-Client Execution & Prioritization: How do you manage concurrent development priorities across multiple client accounts while ensuring delivery rigor and clean handoffs?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans . You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role , where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans 

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

title: Specialist Implementation Manager
description:
Company overview

Veracross is a private-equity-backed leading SaaS EdTech company that has grown 4x in size in 3 years and has consistent industry-leading high retention rates. We serve front line educators with the only market disrupting open API single record architecture in the greater than $5B EdTech market. To date we have configured and deployed our product at over 1,000 leading private K-12 schools in over 20 countries.

Role summary

A Specialist Implementation Manager independently leads all aspects of successful implementations of Veracross or Digistorm software. The role calls for a strong understanding of Veracross or Digistorm software, excellent project management skills, and effective communication (written and verbal). Projects are executed on time and on budget, while fostering trusting relationships with implementing schools and their staff. Specialist Implementation Managers build deep expertise in one or more products and help grow that capability across the team.

This role is based in Australia and supports schools across the APAC region.

Job Responsibilities

- Guide customer implementation projects across one or more Veracross or Digistorm products/modules. The process includes:

- 
Department discovery: working with each implementing department to understand their workflows and needs, and how they connect across school operations.

- 
Platform transition options consulting: discovery-infused platform setup options presented, demoed, revised, and finally agreed upon.

- 
Change management: orchestrate successful change management, where tailored configurations are office-tested, revised, approved, and deployed, with care given to each department's daily operations.

- 
Department workflow consulting: model and document the ways the school's different departments will use the Veracross or Digistorm product(s) across their first operational year.

- Develop, coordinate, and execute project plans, task schedules, and resource activities to ensure on-time and effective project delivery

- Work with the Lead Project Manager to build implementation plans covering configuration, data migration and go-live readiness

- Advise schools on best-practice configuration and how their data and processes connect across products and integrated systems

- Lead direct training engagements for multiple school departments, and ensure school personnel complete required self-paced trainings

- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure all phases of the implementation are executed as necessary

- Act as an internal subject matter expert in one or more Veracross or Digistorm products, coaching other Implementation Managers and helping build team capability

- Develop tailored support handoffs after go-live and contribute to internal documentation and best practices for implementations

- Gather client feedback and work with internal teams to improve the implementation process and product offerings

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

- 2+ years of experience in technical project management, implementing Veracross or Digistorm, or other SaaS-based software solutions, ideally including data conversion

- Experience working in or with an independent school a plus

- Experience with school information systems or other school-facing software a plus

- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including comfort with public speaking, presentation delivery, and presenting to school leaders and department heads

- Ability to make complex decisions and recommendations under limited direction, using a high degree of initiative and independent judgement

- Ability to learn complex, enterprise-level software systems at a level that supports teaching others

- Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

- Problem-solving skills with ability to perform root cause analysis

- Highly organised, with the ability to self-manage in a remote environment

- Ability to travel up to 15% of the time, primarily within Australia and New Zealand

Benefits

The best tools to get the job done! 

When you join Veracross , you get a Macbook Pro, and assistance in your home set up.

Growth opportunities! 

Veracross is growing fast, allowing you to own your role and grow with us! Operating within a global team, there are opportunities for professional development allowing your skills to grow as the business grows.

Work/life balance 

Management encourages taking hour-long lunches and finishing on time and understands that you have a life outside of work. You can take the day off for your birthday and get a $100-a-year allowance for well-being. Massage, anyone?

Parental leave policy 

As part of Veracross parental leave policy, you’re eligible for paid leave as a primary parent and secondary parent when you welcome a new child into your family. This is available after 12 months in a full-time role.

Make a difference 

Our work makes a positive contribution to our schools, their students and their families around the world!

Snacks, drinks & coffee 

Digistorm’s ( Veracross ) Gold Coast HQ offers a coffee machine, snack bar and fully stocked drinks fridge to keep energy levels high! Vege chips, kombucha, almond milk, cookies; you name it, they have it.

Culture 

The Veracross team is fun, relaxed, and sociable, reflected in the casual dress code and social events. The office has an open floor plan, which allows for cross-team communication and a collaborative environment. Join some staff for lunchtime surfing or hit up nearby food spots for a burger by the beach.

title: Software Trainer
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Leads and participates in the development of the Company’s software training curriculum and programs, and designs, conducts, facilitates, and evaluates systems training programs for the Company’s team members. JOB DESCRIPTION 

- Conducts and facilitates software training programs by making appropriate travel arrangements, preparing and packaging participant and facilitator materials, coordinating the registration and set-up process, and updating and revising training programs as necessary to ensure the curriculum meets the training needs of the Company. 

- Creates new or revises existing training programs by researching systems and software functionality, authoring participant and facilitator training materials, designing instructions, practice and other learning activities, and developing other support materials, including PowerPoint presentations, audiovisuals, graphics, job aids, and other documents. 

- Acts as a performance improvement resource to managers by following up to provide individual coaching and one-on-one training, conducting remedial and refresher training, and suggesting education and training alternatives and options based on specific situations. 

- Provides help desk support by troubleshooting and responding to user requests and questions, researching and correcting systems problems, and following up with the end users to ensure satisfaction resolution of systems-related issues. 

- Evaluates and reports on training program effectiveness by developing pre- and post tests, surveys, and/or other methods and tools to assess learner understanding, and by reviewing other Company reports to link training to overall performance and results. 

- Assists on take-over and transition teams for newly-acquired properties by completing systems and data conversions, setting up new users for systems access, and conducting training for new team members on the Company’s property management and other software applications. 

- Works with third-party vendors, contractors, and other business partners to support training or system maintenance needs, and provides customer service by working with senior management to develop and produce training and communication materials.

About Aretum 

Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. We believe in investing in our people and creating a culture where collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth are at the forefront. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a motivated Junior Systems Analyst to support our content management and systems engineering efforts across multiple IT environments. This remote role is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in supporting enterprise content management systems (CMS) like Drupal, WordPress, and OpenText. Most of our systems are hosted on Linux platforms, and many have database backends. The ideal candidate has experience as a Systems Analyst or Web Master and understands service desk-type environments and tier 1, tier 2, and tier 3 support, as well as meeting SLA requirements. This remote position primarily provides tier 1 and tier 2 software and application support for web-based systems tailored to our federal client's needs. We strive to provide high-quality and unparalleled user support, user management, and customer service. This role may require after-hours system support and testing. 

Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements. 

Responsibilities 

- Respond to and troubleshoot user experience issues; support user questions 

- Enhance and maintain existing web-based applications/systems/web sites

- Help administer and maintain the web system and infrastructure

- Perform other short-term and long-term tasks and duties as assigned by management

- Test software for responsiveness and efficiency

- Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software as required

- Monitor system uptime, performance, and health

- Create, implement, and validate security and data protection settings

- Draft/update technical documentation

- Attend and participate in client meetings 

Requirements

- Bachelor’s Degree

- Minimum of 2 years of overall experience

- At least 1 year must be in web development, application administration, or Linux administration

- Understanding of service desk-type environments and SLA requirements

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Linux administration

- Experience with supporting enterprise content management systems (CMS)

- Experience with supporting databases

- Experience with productivity systems like GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins

- Experience with business systems and automation

Travel Requirements

This is a remote position; however, occasional travel may be required based on project needs, client meetings, team collaboration events, or training sessions. Travel is expected to be less than 10% and will be communicated in advance whenever possible. 

EEO Statement

Aretum is committed to fostering a workplace rooted in excellence, integrity, and equal opportunity for all. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Aretum complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.

If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process due to a disability, please contact for assistance. 

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

This position supports a federal government contract and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability Determination, depending on the agency’s background investigation requirements. Sponsorship is not available.

Senior Data Scientist What you will be doing:

The Senior Data Scientist is a Subject Matter Expert that advises on both structured and unstructured analytic models to solve complex data problems in a way that ensures consistency, reusability, and quality across the organization.

This position will have responsibility for the development, delivery, enhancement, integration, integrity, maintenance, and support of the operation of information technology (IT) infrastructure, data, products, solutions, and services to support client operations and business activities. This position will be a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert for strategic initiatives around data exploration, data analysis, and complex, high dimensional datasets.

- Data Modeling

- Application Methodology Development

- AI, Machine Learning, and statistical modeling

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1– 35%

Development and Implementation

• Collaborates with Data Science leadership, Product Management, Development, and Research teams in the creation and implementation of machine learning algorithms and statistical models.

• Leads the design and implementation of complex data solutions across teams while maintaining consistency within Premier methodology (e.g. prediction, probabilistic data matching, identifying outliers, confidence scoring, etc.)

• Work with developers and architects to translate prototypes into new products, services, and feature, and provide guidelines for large scale implementation.

• Use a flexible, analytical approach to design, develop, and evaluate predictive models, ML, AI, NLP and advanced algorithms that lead to optimal value extraction from the data.

Strategy and Design

• Develop features and stories based on requirements to feed product backlogs

• Conduct impact assessments across all existing applications, integration and data warehouses resulting from the solution implementation

Responsibility #4 – 10%

Knowledge Sharing

• Provide data, data relationships, and data science practice advice, demonstrations and presentations to colleagues, clients, and management. Conduct research, as needed

• Provide mentoring and training

Responsibility #5 – 10%

Data Operations

description:
Current Employees:

If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami , please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet.

The University of Miami /UHealth Department of Public Health has an exciting opportunity for a full time Lead Research Analyst to work remote.

The Lead Research Analyst serves as the senior technical resource for FCDS cancer registry record linkage activities, including the development, evaluation, implementation, validation, documentation, training, and continuous improvement of probabilistic, deterministic, and hybrid linkage methodologies, software applications, data integration processes, and supporting technical infrastructure. Supports and contributes to FCDS special studies, research initiatives, surveillance modernization efforts, and emerging data integration projects designed to enhance cancer surveillance, data quality, and public health research capabilities. Participates in the analysis, interpretation, dissemination, training, and communication of research and surveillance findings through scientific publications, technical reports, presentations, and other professional and public-facing activities that advance cancer surveillance practice and knowledge.

Core responsibilities:

- Analyzes data from multiple datasets using advanced statistical methods. 2. Develops, maintains, and monitors the organization of individual level data and documentation. 

- Prepares results for progress reports, presentations, and peer-reviewed publications. 

- Serves as co-author on peer-reviewed manuscripts.

- Presents results of statistical analyses to study investigators. 

- Collaborates with other relevant stakeholders on planning and provides statistical consultation to project staff and collaborators. 

- Removes barriers to analyses by collaborating with other methodologists and statisticians. 

- Adheres to University and unit-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets. 

Department Specific Functions: 

- Develops and maintains reproducible linkage procedures, quality assurance processes, technical documentation, best practices, and training materials.

- Conducts linkage training and education and provides support to FCDS staff for these activities.

- Conducts evaluation and testing of emerging linkage technologies and approaches. 

- Performs and supports complex linkage studies involving multiple data sources and challenging matching scenarios. 

- Collaborates with FCDS staff, the Florida Department of Health, University of Miami Information Technology, researchers, and other stakeholders to support the modernization, reliability, accuracy, and effective use of cancer registry record linkage systems and related data resources. 

- Participates in the planning, development, implementation, testing, analysis, and evaluation of special projects, including but not limited to cancer biology and molecular marker initiatives, administrative and electronic patient data integration efforts, cancer recurrence data collection and analysis projects, pilot studies, data validation activities, and other innovative research or surveillance activities. 

- Collaborates with FCDS staff, researchers, stakeholders, the Florida Department of Health, and others to assess project feasibility, develop methodologies, analyze findings, and support translating project outcomes into operational cancer registry practices.

- Collaborate with other technical/research staff in coordinating the development, maintenance and implementation of the FCDS educational and curriculum initiative for Florida registrars. 

- Perform statistical and analytical functions for the FCDS Research Division and for extramural researchers as needed.

- Respond to all routine and ad hoc research requests from external researchers and the Florida Department of Health, which include research collaboration. 

- Contributes to the preparation of scientific manuscripts, technical reports, abstracts, posters, presentations, educational materials, and other dissemination products; presents findings at scientific, professional, and public health meetings; and supports communication of research and surveillance findings to the broader cancer surveillance, epidemiology, and public health communities.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary. 

Core Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in relevant field required. Master’s Degree in relevant field preferred.

- Minimum 4 years of relevant experience required . Minimum 10 years experience preferred.

- Learning Agility: Ability to learn new procedures, technologies, and protocols, and adapt to changing priorities and work demands.

- Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively with others and contribute to a team environment.

- Technical Proficiency: Skilled in using office software, technology, and relevant computer applications.

- Communication: Strong and clear written and verbal communication skills for interacting with colleagues and stakeholders.

- Skill in record linkage (entity resolution).

- Skill in collecting, organizing, and analyzing data.

- Ability to recognize, analyze, and solve a variety of problems.

- Ability to exercise sound judgment in making critical decisions.

- Skilled in Python and Julia programming language

- Expert in STATA, SAS, R or other statistical software tools

The University of Miami offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, tuition remission and more.

UHealth- University of Miami Health System, South Florida's only university-based health system, provides leading-edge patient care powered by the ground breaking research and medical education at the Miller School of Medicine. As an academic medical center, we are proud to serve South Florida, Latin America and the Caribbean. Our physicians represent more than 100 specialties and sub-specialties, and have more than one million patient encounters each year. Our tradition of excellence has earned worldwide recognition for outstanding teaching, research and patient care. We're the challenge you've been looking for.

About Pearl Talent 

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.

Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for:
Watch here: 

About the Client

A fast-growing US healthcare technology company offering direct-to-consumer and B2B laboratory testing is looking for an Operations Coordinator to deliver highly responsive customer support, document scalable processes, and build AI-powered workflows that reduce manual work.

The company runs an out-of-pocket testing model with no insurance pre-authorizations and has scaled its customer base significantly in recent months, with four client implementations running in parallel. Its support operation already deflects about 70% of cases through AI, and the team is pushing that number higher.

About the Role

Day-to-day, you will work in Slack, Intercom, and Notion, splitting your time across customer support (about 40%), process documentation (30%), AI automation (25%), and B2B partner operations (5%). This is a Wednesday to Sunday role, so you will keep operations moving through the weekend when the rest of the team is offline. Success means fast and consistent response times, documentation others can follow without help, and a measurable increase in case deflection and automation rates within your first 90 days.

Core Responsibilities

Customer Support & Communication

- Respond to B2C lab testing customer inquiries in Intercom and Slack within set response-time targets

- Own Saturday and Sunday support coverage so no customer issue waits until Monday

- Resolve testing, scheduling, and results-related issues, and escalate edge cases with full context

- Handle patient information in line with HIPAA requirements (training provided)

Process Creation & Documentation

- Document existing customer and partner workflows as step-by-step SOPs in Notion

- Build new processes to support multiple concurrent client implementations

Position Summary:

The primary focus is to lead the successful implementation of Veracross Accounting & Student Billing Modules focusing on more complex and demanding projects that require an understanding of accounting, student billing systems. These projects must be executed on time and on budget, while fostering trusting relationships with client Business Offices. 

Responsibilities:

- Orchestrate successful Business Office change management, where the tailored configurations, once approved, are documented, socialized, and deployed.

- Business Office workflow consulting: Create documented models to support the ways the school's Business Office can best leverage the Veracross Accounting & Student Billing modules to support their operation.

- Develop and orchestrate tailored Accounting & Student Billing support handoffs. 

- Mentor clients in their chart of accounts design as needed. 

- Coach Implementation Managers from basic Accounting consulting proficiency to moderate Accounting consulting proficiency. 

- Write and update internal documentation to support continuous improvement of a standardized, best practice, Accounting & Student Billing implementation process, including training and adoption. 

- Lead direct training engagements for strategic and high-complexity Accounting offices.

- Develop and maintain Student Billing & Accounting module product feedback that emerges from direct consultations.

- Achieve consultation success on time, and on budget.

- Participate with Marketing and Sales in 2-3 Independent School Business Office conferences a year.

Requirements

- Accounting degree or relevant qualification.
- 4+ years of experience implementing Student Billing & Accounting software, including data conversion; experience with SaaS a plus. 
- Experience in leading Veracross Full Accounting Implementations, or similar SaaS accounting implementation experience preferred 
- Experience as part of an independent school business office running a SaaS accounting platform a plus.
- A solid understanding of the fundamental accounting equation; the general journal; the chart of accounts; general ledger reporting (balance sheet, trial balance, profit & loss statements); fiscal period and fiscal year closing; budgeting; reconciliations; and sub-ledger processing (e.g. accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash processing, purchases journal, fixed assets, project accounting) 
- Skilled user of technology, comfortable learning and using the many types of systems that support a technical workspace 
- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including comfort with public speaking, presentation delivery, etc. 
- Ability to make complex decisions and recommendations under limited direction and using a high degree of initiative and independent judgement 
- Ability to learn complex, enterprise level software systems at a level that supports teaching others 
- Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment 
- Problem-solving skills with ability to perform root cause analysis 
- Highly organised with the ability to self manage in a remote and/or hybrid work 
environment 
- Ability to nationally travel if needed 
Benefits

The best tools to get the job done! 

When you join Veracross , you get a Macbook Pro, a 32-inch monitor, and an adjustable desk and chair for the office. 

Growth opportunities! 

Veracross is growing fast, allowing you to own your role and grow with us! Operating within a global team, there are opportunities for professional development allowing your skills to grow as the business grows.

Snacks, drinks & coffee

Job Description: Convergint is looking for a full-time, enthusiastic, results driven and forward-thinking Director of AI - Powered Selling to join our amazing culture. As an Director of AI - Powered Selling, you are a part of a dynamic sales organization that allows you to grow as Convergint grows. 

Who You Are

You build. You experiment. You find a clever way to make something work, and want to show people. AI is your playground. You like turning rough ideas into useful tools, pushing past the obvious and making complicated things feel simple. You can explain what you built, take feedback and make it better. You bring curiosity, integrity and follow-through. You want room to create, people to collaborate with and a real audience for your work.

Convergint’s mission is to be our customers’ best service provider. Our company was built upon a foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs, which guide our culture and our commitment to customers, colleagues and communities. We take pride in protecting lives and assets through our technology solutions and services. We’re now bringing fresh AI thinking to how our Account Executives find opportunities, prepare for customer conversations and grow customer relationships.

As Director of AI Powered Selling, you’ll report directly to the leader of Global Sales Operations and work closely together to co-create practical AI tools for Account Executives worldwide. We bring deep selling experience. You bring AI expertise, fresh ideas and the drive to build.
Our ambition: “creating tools which teach users their own use.”
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.
· Build: Turn concepts into practical AI tools. Experiment, prototype and demonstrate what’s possible.
· Refine: Incorporate feedback, test approved concepts and make tools reliable, intuitive and ready to use.
· Teach: Create and launch the AI Power Selling curriculum covering Market Identification & Lead Generation, Conversation Preparation & Planning, and Account Expansion.
· Showcase: Deliver demonstrations, training and supporting materials that help colleagues understand and use the tools.
· Improve: Gather user feedback and explore emerging AI capabilities to keep the tools and curriculum current.
You’ll have access to AI platforms and resources, with limited technical support. You’ll need to be resourceful and comfortable figuring things out.

What You’ll Need
· Strong, demonstrated expertise in building practical tools with generative AI, preferably ChatGPT.
· Examples of your work: tools, experiments, prototypes or demonstrations.
· Strong communication, presentation and teaching skills.
· The ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems and deliver finished work.
· The ability to collaborate, incorporate feedback and manage competing priorities.
· Curiosity, creativity and a commitment to Convergint’s Values and Beliefs.

· Company Holidays and Paid Time Off

· Life Insurance & Disability Plan
· Wellness Program
· 401K Matching Plan
· Colleague Assistance Program
· Tuition Reimbursement
· Competitive Salary and Compensation Plan
· Corporate Social Responsibility Day
· And much more

Requirements
· Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
· Experience: Demonstrated hands-on AI tool-building experience. Sales experience is not required; technical, creative and unconventional backgrounds are welcome.
· Location: Must reside in the United States.

title: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

About the Role 

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities 

- Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.

- Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.

- Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.

- Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.

- QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.

- Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.

- Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.

- Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.

- Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.

- Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications 

Required 

- At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.

- Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.

- Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.

- Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.

- A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.

- Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.

- Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

- Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred 

- Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.

- Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.

- Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).

- Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.

- Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

- Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current 

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

title: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.

This is a non-attorney role. You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.

As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations, you will: 

- Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.

- Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions. Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure. 

- Build Defensible Documentation: Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.

- Collaborate Across Functions: Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.

- Communicate Findings Clearly: Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.

Success in this role looks like: 

- In your first 90 days , you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.

- By 6 months , you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.

- By 12 months , you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.

You should get in touch if: 

- Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes & investigative experience: You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care. You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.

- You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs: You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work. 

- Strong communication skills: You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Bonus points if: 

- 

- You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide.

- You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance.

- You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan.

- You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC.

Benefits Overview :

- Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

- Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

- Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. 

- Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks: 

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

- Reimbursement for office setup expenses

- Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

- Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams

- Paid parental leave for all new parents

- And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

$150,000 — $240,000 USD

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join: 

BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience. 

The Difference You Will Make: 

As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality. 

A Typical Day: 

- Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect

- Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time

- Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge

- Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead

- Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows

- Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution

Your Expertise: 

- 3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch)

- 3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Processing
description:
Headquarters: Remote 

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

Position: Senior Software Engineer, Processing

Location: Remote

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.

The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.

What you'll do: 

- Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services

- Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces

- Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt

- Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements

- Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way

- Participate in the team on-call rotation

- Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering

- Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager

What you'll bring: 

- 8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments

- Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills

- Experience driving large cross-functional projects across engineering, product, and operations teams

- A proven commitment to empathy and inclusion

- Excellent communication skills

- Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve is a must

- An interest in fintech and the payments space is preferred

The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to our NYC office in Soho. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Connectivity
description:
Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

Be Part of Building the Future 

Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com. 

About the role 

Dremio's Connectivity team builds the high-performance connectivity solutions that help customers bring data to Dremio and connect Dremio to the broader data ecosystem. The team works across client drivers, protocols, connectors, interoperability, distributed systems, and the reliability and supportability of production data access.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll independently own multiple medium-to-large features or service components within a Connectivity and Clients area. You'll define the approach for a substantial team-area scope, turn ambiguous goals into clear milestones, make sound feature and service-level design decisions, and drive work through reliable production delivery. You will bring deep expertise in at least one area, such as JDBC or ODBC drivers, Apache Arrow ADBC, Arrow Flight SQL, BI interoperability, source connectivity, or connectivity reliability, while contributing effectively across adjacent areas. You will also mentor engineers and influence partner teams through strong technical judgment and execution.

What you'll be doing 

- Own substantial connectivity work: Lead multiple medium-to-large features or service components from problem definition through design, implementation, validation, release readiness, and operational handoff.

- Turn ambiguity into an execution plan: Define reviewable milestones, acceptance measures, dependencies, estimates, and risks for complex customer, product, and engineering goals.

- Design scalable, maintainable systems: Produce technical designs and architecture diagrams, explain trade-offs, and make feature and service-level decisions across drivers, protocols, client libraries, connectors, and distributed services.

- Diagnose complex failures: Lead root-cause analysis across client/server, protocol, network, authentication, metadata, and distributed-system boundaries using logs, telemetry, profiles, benchmarks, and production evidence.

- Build compatibility and reliability: Maintain API and protocol stability; create automated compatibility, interoperability, performance, scale, reliability, observability, and diagnostics coverage; and define practical migration paths for supported and legacy clients.

- Collaborate and influence: Partner with Product, Query Execution, QA, Support, SRE, Documentation, and external technology partners to resolve dependencies and improve certification, customer experience, and supportability.

- Raise the engineering bar: Participate actively in code and design reviews, mentor and coach engineers, improve team practices, and contribute to relevant upstream open-source projects when aligned with Dremio priorities.

- Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly: Apply Dremio-approved AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation while protecting proprietary and customer data and validating results through review, testing, and sound engineering judgment.

What we're looking for 

- Staff-level ownership: 8+ years of production software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through sustained ownership of complex systems and multiple substantial team-area features.

- Programming expertise: Deep proficiency in Java, C++, Rust, Go, or another systems or services language, with the ability to work effectively in adjacent languages and frameworks.

- Connectivity and systems depth: Experience designing and debugging APIs, protocols, client libraries, drivers, or distributed services, with strong knowledge of data structures, concurrency, asynchronous programming, networking, and failure handling.

- Problem-solving ability: Able to identify and solve non-obvious problems across client/server and distributed-system boundaries and turn findings into durable fixes and regression coverage.

- Quality mindset: Experience building comprehensive unit, integration, compatibility, performance, or reliability tests and working with production CI/CD, packaging, release, certification, and engineering quality controls.

- Communication and influence: Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, surface risks early, align contributors across teams, and influence without formal authority.

- Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers and improve the effectiveness and engineering practices of the team around you.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees and equivalent industry experience are welcomed.

Bonus points if you have 

- Experience developing JDBC, ODBC, ADBC, or other database drivers.

- Experience with Apache Arrow or Arrow Flight SQL.

- Experience with SQL engines, databases, data platforms, or source connectors.

- BI interoperability experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools, including collaboration with partner engineering teams.

- Knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, TLS, enterprise authentication, metadata discovery, or query pushdown.

- Cross-platform native build, packaging, release engineering, compatibility certification, or upgrade support experience.

- Observability, production diagnostics, customer escalation, long-running data transfer, cancellation, keepalive, timeout, or proxy experience.

- Contributions to Apache Arrow or other relevant open-source projects.

What we value 

At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife. 

Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor. 

Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice. 

Important Security Notice for Candidates 

At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here . 

Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.
